--- 롤 배틀액션
--- 점령전 간부 빨간 모자 아라벨 (villain_redhood) 역할 기술
local local_class = newclass('ConquestRoleVillainRedhoodBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.finished_time_passed then
			self.state.finished_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 선딜
	prepare_duration = nil,
	--- 점프 시간
	jump_duration = nil,
	--- 후딜
	delay_duration = nil,
	--- 이동 속도
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 판정 시점
	hit_timing = {},
	--- 판정 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 충돌 비헤비어
	crash_behaviour = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_battle_action
	obj:init(param)

	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')

	self.prepare_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'PrepareDuration')
	self.jump_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpDuration')
	self.delay_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DelayDuration')

	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')

	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	self.crash_behaviour = CS.Oak.PassChargeCrashBehaviour(false, true)
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.dash_speed * self.jump_duration * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	self.owner.OverrideCrashBehaviour = nil

	--- cancel jump
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if old_time_passed < self.prepare_duration and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
		--- update direction
		self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.prepare_duration) then
		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(-360, self.jump_duration)
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 1.75, self.jump_duration, self.jump_duration * 0.75)
		self.owner.OverrideCrashBehaviour = self.crash_behaviour

		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'jump')
	end

	if self.prepare_duration <= time_passed and old_time_passed < self.prepare_duration + self.jump_duration then
		local real_dt = dt

		if old_time_passed < self.prepare_duration then
			real_dt = time_passed - self.prepare_duration
		end

		if self.prepare_duration + self.jump_duration < time_passed then
			real_dt = real_dt - (time_passed - (self.prepare_duration + self.jump_duration))
		end

		--- 대시 거리를 구함
		local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * real_dt

		CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameStageLogic.ExecuteMove(self.owner, self.dir_vector, dash_dist)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			if index == 1 then
				battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
			end

			local explosion_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

			--- instantiate explosion fx
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', explosion_pos)

			--- play explosion sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			--- modifier 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
				self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, #self.hit_timing
			)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(explosion_pos, self.radius)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing] + 0.25) then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
	damage_info.type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 기본 사운드 mute
	damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 이벤트 발행
	command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
end


--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_battle_action, params
	)

	role_util.setup_role_action(cs_battle_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 역할 액션이 available하고 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return battle_util.role_is_available(self.cs_battle_action) and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(
		self.cs_battle_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		--- append target
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_battle_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopDefenseBossDashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1) -- 돌진 데미지
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1.0)
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDuration', 1.35)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1.5)
	self.charge_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 20)
	self.charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)
	local damage_term = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageTerm', 0.35)
	self.cast_fx_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareFxDelay', 0.5)

	local ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo()
	ailment_info.Ailment = CS.Oak.Ailment.Aerial
	ailment_info.AilmentGauge = 100
	self.ailment_info = ailment_info

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		charge = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(unity_class.vector3.zero, unity_class.vector2(self.charge_distance, self.charge_width), CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.CubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero -- 돌진 시작 시점에 업데이트
	info.DamageTerm = damage_term
	info.Duration = self.charge_duration
	info.Extents = unity_class.vector3.zero -- 돌진 시작 할 때 방향에 따라 갱신
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, false, 0, 0)
	self.attack_info = info

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end


function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	-- 타겟 상관 없이 그냥 보는 방향으로 돌진하므로 체크 안함
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 보는 방향으로 커맨드 생성
	local direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithDirection(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, direction)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_direction = info:GetDirectionAt(0)

	self.dir_to_look = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction)

	if self.dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action, self.dir_to_look)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리 (none 은 exit 할 것 없음)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 준비 상태 종료
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		if next_state ~= self.state.charge then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		end

		if not is_unity_null(self.cast_fx) then
			self.cast_fx:Dispose()
		end
		self.cast_fx = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 종료
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = nil
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.charge_fx) then
			self.charge_fx:Dispose()
			end

		self.charge_fx = nil

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		-- 후처리 종료
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		-- 준비 상태 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.target_direction)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('cast', nil)
		self.cast_fx_on = false

	elseif next_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 시작
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position

		-- 돌진 공격 판정 사이즈 수정: 돌진 방향으론 캐릭터 바운드와 같게, 수직축은 돌진 너비와 같게
		local ex = self.character.Bounds.extents
		ex.y = ex.y * 2
		if self.dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or self.dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			ex.z = self.charge_width / 2
		elseif self.dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.Up or self.dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
			ex.x = self.charge_width / 2
		end
		self.attack_info.Extents = ex

		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.hit_sfx_played = false
		self.hit_sfx_played_2 = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('dash')
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('dash', nil)
		self.charge_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('dash_'..direction_util.to_str(self.dir_to_look),
				self.character.Position, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.shot_complete = false
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation('post')
	else
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.cast_fx_delay and self.cast_fx_on == false then
			self.cast_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('cast_'..direction_util.to_str(self.dir_to_look),
					self.character.Position, self.target_direction, self.character.Transform)
			self.cast_fx_on = true
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		-- 돌진 위치 업데이트 & 충돌 데미지
		if self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
			local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
			move_info.direction = self.target_direction
			move_info.magnitude = self.charge_distance / self.charge_duration * dt

			local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_direction), false)
			message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

			self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
			local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
			for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
				local fo = objects[index]

				-- 몬스터와 플레이어 캐릭터 모두 타격
				if not is_unity_null(fo) and not character_util.is_dead(fo)
						and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, fo)
						and lua_helper.type_compare(fo, CS.Oak.Character) then

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = fo
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)

					-- 적 (유저) 캐릭터일 경우에만 상태 이상
					if CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions.IsHittableTo(self.character.EntityGroup, fo.EntityGroup) then
						damage_info:FillAilmentGauge(self.ailment_info, 1)
						damage_info.forceAilment = true

						if not self.hit_sfx_played then
							self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit_hero', fo.Position)
							self.hit_sfx_played = true
						end

					else
						if not self.hit_sfx_played_2 then
							self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('hit_monster', fo.Position)
							self.hit_sfx_played_2 = true
						end
					end

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
			objects:Dispose()
		else
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if e:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				local blocked = false

				-- 부딫힌 대상이 타워/거점(==EntityGroups.AllyObject)이라면 대미지를 준다.
				if (blocker.EntityGroup & CS.Oak.EntityGroups.AllyObject) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.AllyObject then
					blocked = true

					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
					damage_info.sender = self.character
					damage_info.target = blocker
					damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
					damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, blocker)

					command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
				end

				if blocked == true or blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then
					-- 충돌 이펙트
					self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('crash', self.character.Bounds.center, unity_class.vector3.zero)
					self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx('crash', nil)
					stage.StageCamera:Shake(0.2, 0.5)

					-- 후처리 스테이트로 전환(sync command)
					local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
					trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, info)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	-- 위치 싱크
	if self.cs_battle_action.IsActive then
		self.character.Position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	end

	-- 상태 싱크
	if self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		self:change_state(self.state.post)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel()

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.charge_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil
	self.charge_distance = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.target_direction = nil
	self.shot_complete = nil

	if self.attack_range ~= nil then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil

	self.attack_calculator = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopExpeditionChargeAggroSyncBattleAction')

--필수 구현
-- 일반적인 돌진 + 특정 개체와 충돌 시 CC게이지 획득. 해당 개체 파괴시 CC 게이지를 추가받음
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StunDuration', 3)

	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TraceDuration', 0.8)

	--- 돌진 거리, 넓이
	self.charge_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 10)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)

	--- 대시 속도
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeSpeed', 2)
	self.charge_duration = self.action_duration / self.charge_speed

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = CS.Utils.GetDamageTypeFromDictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType', CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params, level)

	self.rock_stun_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockStunRatio', 3)
	self.wall_stun_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WallStunRatio', 1)
	self.turn_angle_limit = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TurnAngleLimit', 2)

	--해당 시간동안 어그로수치 변경 이벤트가 들어올 경우 타겟을 변경해 준다.
	self.target_search_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TargetSearchDuration", 2)

	self.show_target_arrow = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowTargetArrow", true)

	self.is_broken_rock = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "IsBrokenRock", true)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
		stun = 5,
		stun_rock = 6,
	}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
		unity_class.vector3.zero,
		unity_class.vector2(self.charge_length, charge_width),
		CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward
	)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.IsCenterToSide = true

	-- 바운드 사이즈 고정이 아니라 캐릭터 사이즈에 맞춰서 높이 변경되도록 수정
	local bound_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.character)
	info.Size = vector(charge_width, bound_size.y, charge_width)
	self.calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--coop expedition용 어그로타겟변경
	self.synced_target_dir = nil
	self.is_target_seach = false
	self.character_direction = nil

	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare and self.time_passed < self.target_search_duration then
		if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
			self.target = e.Target
			self.local_dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
			if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(self.local_dir_vector)) then
				self.local_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
			end
			self.sync_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
			self.current_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
			--- 어택 레인지도 바로 바꿈
			local pos = character_util.get_position(self.character)
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.current_dir_vector)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

			--TODO: 일반몬스터용 이벤트 생성 뒤 처리할 것
			--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
			if self.show_target_arrow then
				coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_length
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 최초 트리거 시점에 대상 갱신
function local_class:start(info)

	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.character)
	--- 연출은 모두 여기에 동기화 시킨다.
	self.local_dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(self.local_dir_vector)) then
		self.local_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.time_passed = 0

		--self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.prepare_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.time_passed = 0
		--self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.action_duration

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
	else

	end

	-- Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		--- 어택 큐 시작
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--- 로컬 기준으로 어택레인지의 방향과 위치 갱신
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.trigger_pos, self.local_dir_vector)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.current_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
		self.current_angle = unity_class.vector3.Angle(self.local_dir_vector, vector_util.forward)
		local cross_product = unity_class.vector3.Cross(self.local_dir_vector, vector_util.forward)
		if cross_product.y > 0 then self.current_angle = -self.current_angle end

		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('charge')
		self.fx_charge = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('charge', self.character.Position, self.current_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('charge', self.character.Position)

		--- 충돌체 캐릭터를 관통해서 밀치고 지나갈 수 있도록 설정
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)

		--- 대상을 바라보도록 세팅
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.current_dir_vector))
		--- 공격 범위 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, character_util.get_position(self.character))

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 일반 충돌 스턴 (벽? 근데 스펙 제거됨.)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stun then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stun')

		self:apply_self_cc(self.wall_stun_ratio)
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('crash_wall', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stun')

		self:apply_self_cc(self.rock_stun_ratio)
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('crash_rock', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('crash', self.character.Position)


	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.time_passed = 0
	end

	--- 싱크 정확하게 하기 위해서, 여기서 시간을 각 state 별 time만큼 정확하게 빼준다
	--- self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local old_time = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		--- 방향 갱신을 해준다.
		if self.target and self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self.target, self.local_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.local_dir_vector)
			--- 추적 시간(즉 연출 중)에는 동기화된 벡터로 처리
			self.sync_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
		end

		if self.sync_dir_vector then
			self:update_attack_ranges(dt)
		end

		--- 추적 시간 마지막으로 한번 더 방향을 동기화 해준다.
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time, self.time_passed, self.trace_duration) and battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
				-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
				command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
			end

			--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			--- 돌진 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
			--- 돌진할 방향 정보
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.current_dir_vector)
			--- 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end

		--- 돌진 할 타이밍엔 돌진할 방향을 결정한다.
		if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) and self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.local_dir_vector)

			if not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)) then
				-- 대상이 변경되었음을 커맨드로 공유
				command_util.publish_change_target(self.character, self.target)
			end

			--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			--- 돌진 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
			--- 돌진할 방향 정보
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.local_dir_vector)
			--- 변경할 상태
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.action)

			--- 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			--- 안부딪히고 시간이 만료되었다.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

		-- 돌진 업데이트
		self:update_charge(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stun_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stun_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_ranges(dt)
	--- 실 대상과 현재 벡터의 차이
	local angle_diff = unity_class.vector3.Angle(self.sync_dir_vector, self.current_dir_vector)
	--- 각도 차가 거의 없다면 아무것도 하지 않는다.
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(angle_diff) then return end

		--- 위 차이를 제한값으로 클램핑
	local clamped_angle = angle_diff <= self.turn_angle_limit and angle_diff or self.turn_angle_limit

	--- 좌우 회전인지 알아내기
	local cross_product = unity_class.vector3.Cross(self.sync_dir_vector, self.current_dir_vector)
	if cross_product.y > 0 then clamped_angle = -clamped_angle end

	--- 이번 프레임의 각도
	self.current_angle = self.current_angle + clamped_angle
	--- 이번 프레임의 방향 벡터
	self.current_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.current_angle, 0) * vector_util.forward

	--- 어택 레인지 회전
	local pos = character_util.get_position(self.character)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.current_dir_vector)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	--if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then return end

	if  self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(self.time_passed / self.charge_duration, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.character)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = diff.normalized
		move_info.magnitude = diff.magnitude

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)


		--- 판정 체크
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

			--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
			if #hit_targets > 0 then
				for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
					self:apply_damage(target)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 네트웍으로 갱신될 정보
function local_class:sync(info)
	self.target = battle_ai_util.get_ai_target(self.character)

	--- 변환할 state 정보가 있다면 state 처리용
	if trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		--- 네트워크상 동기화 된 벡터
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
		--- 돌진을 종료할 위치
		self.end_pos = self.trigger_pos + self.charge_length * self.sync_dir_vector
		-- 위치 싱크
		if self.cs_action.IsActive then
			self.character.Position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		end

		local state = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

		self:change_state(state)
	else	--- 어택 레인지의 마지막 방향 갱신 = 최종 돌진 방향
		--- 돌진 시작 위치
		self.trigger_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		--- 네트워크상 동기화 된 벡터
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.on_aggro_change_event_func ~= nil then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent), self.on_aggro_change_event_func)
		self.on_aggro_change_event_func = nil
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then

					--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
					local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
					--- 돌진 위치
					trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
					--- 돌진할 방향 정보
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.local_dir_vector)

					if self.is_broken_rock and string.match(blocker.Name, 'rock') then
						--- 변경할 상태
						trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.stun_rock)
						--- [추가 필요] "일반 벽"이면 CC 소량 부여
						--- 파괴 가능한 바위면 CC 대랑 뷰여
						--- 정지시킨 바위에게 충돌 피해 전달
						self:apply_gimmick_damage(blocker)

					else
						--trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.stun)
					end

					--- 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 돌진 피격 대상 일반 피해
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = self.local_dir_vector
	--- dir_vector == 진행 방향
	--- target_dir == 대상과 공격자의 사이의 방향
	--- 두 벡터 사이 합을 확인
	local target_dir = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.character.Position)
	local knock_back_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.local_dir_vector + target_dir)

	--- 0 이란 의미는 뒤에서 박았단 의미인데, 사실상 불가능, 어쟀던 겹쳐있거나 한상태니 그냥 넉백방향도 운동방향과비슷하게 처리
	if knock_back_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
		knock_back_dir = self.local_dir_vector
	end

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end

--- 자신에게 CC 피해
function local_class:apply_self_cc(stun_ratio)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, stun_ratio)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 바위에게 파괴 트리거 전송
function local_class:apply_gimmick_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopExpeditionChargeBattleAction')

--필수 구현
-- 일반적인 돌진 + 특정 개체와 충돌 시 CC게이지 획득. 해당 개체 파괴시 CC 게이지를 추가받음
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)
	self.stun_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'StunDuration', 3)

	self.trace_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TraceDuration', 0.8)

	--- 돌진 거리, 넓이
	self.charge_length = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDistance', 10)
	local charge_width = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeWidth', 2)

	--- 대시 속도
	self.charge_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeSpeed', 2)
	self.charge_duration = self.action_duration / self.charge_speed

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = CS.Utils.GetDamageTypeFromDictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType', CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'KnockbackForce', 1)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DamageModifier', 1)
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params, level)

	self.rock_stun_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'RockStunRatio', 3)
	self.wall_stun_ratio = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WallStunRatio', 1)
	self.turn_angle_limit = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'TurnAngleLimit', 2)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4,
		stun = 5,
		stun_rock = 6,
	}

	-- 어택레인지 생성
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateRect(
		unity_class.vector3.zero,
		unity_class.vector2(self.charge_length, charge_width),
		CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward
	)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 공격 계산기 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.RotatableCubeCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = self.character.Position
	info.Duration = self.action_duration
	info.IsCenterToSide = true

	-- 바운드 사이즈 고정이 아니라 캐릭터 사이즈에 맞춰서 높이 변경되도록 수정
	local bound_size = bounds_util.get_size(self.character)
	info.Size = vector(charge_width, bound_size.y, charge_width)
	self.calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, 0, 1)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if not is_unity_null(target) then
		return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.charge_length
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.FieldObjectActionExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)
	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 최초 트리거 시점에 대상 갱신
function local_class:start(info)

	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	if self.target == nil then
		return
	end

	self.trigger_pos = character_util.get_position(self.character)
	--- 연출은 모두 여기에 동기화 시킨다.
	self.local_dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, self.target)
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(self.local_dir_vector)) then
		self.local_dir_vector = direction_util.to_vector3(self.character.Direction)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.time_passed = 0

		--self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.prepare_duration
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.time_passed = 0
		--self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.action_duration

		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil


	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.time_passed = 0
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
	else

	end

	-- Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		--- 어택 큐 시작
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))

		--- 로컬 기준으로 어택레인지의 방향과 위치 갱신
		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.trigger_pos, self.local_dir_vector)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.prepare_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		self.current_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
		self.current_angle = unity_class.vector3.Angle(self.local_dir_vector, vector_util.forward)
		local cross_product = unity_class.vector3.Cross(self.local_dir_vector, vector_util.forward)
		if cross_product.y > 0 then self.current_angle = -self.current_angle end

		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('charge')
		self.fx_charge = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('charge', self.character.Position, self.current_dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('charge', self.character.Position)

		--- 충돌체 캐릭터를 관통해서 밀치고 지나갈 수 있도록 설정
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PassCharacterCrashBehaviour.Instance
		battle_util.attach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)

		--- 대상을 바라보도록 세팅
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.current_dir_vector))
		--- 공격 범위 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, character_util.get_position(self.character))

		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 일반 충돌 스턴 (벽? 근데 스펙 제거됨.)
	elseif next_state == self.state.stun then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stun')

		self:apply_self_cc(self.wall_stun_ratio)
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('crash_wall', self.character.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('stun')

		self:apply_self_cc(self.rock_stun_ratio)
		self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('crash_rock', self.character.Position)
		self.cs_action:PlaySfx('crash', self.character.Position)


	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.detach_crash_behaviour(self.cs_action, self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour)
		self.cs_action.CrashBehaviour = nil

		self.attack_range:Hide()
		self.time_passed = 0
	end

	--- 싱크 정확하게 하기 위해서, 여기서 시간을 각 state 별 time만큼 정확하게 빼준다
	--- self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	local old_time = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		--- 방향 갱신을 해준다.
		if self.target and self.time_passed < self.trace_duration then
			self.target, self.local_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.local_dir_vector)
			--- 추적 시간(즉 연출 중)에는 동기화된 벡터로 처리
			self.sync_dir_vector = self.local_dir_vector
		end

		if self.sync_dir_vector then
			self:update_attack_ranges(dt)
		end

		--- 추적 시간 마지막으로 한번 더 방향을 동기화 해준다.
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time, self.time_passed, self.trace_duration) then
			--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			--- 돌진 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
			--- 돌진할 방향 정보
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.current_dir_vector)
			--- 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end

		--- 돌진 할 타이밍엔 돌진할 방향을 결정한다.
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.local_dir_vector)

			--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
			--- 돌진 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
			--- 돌진할 방향 정보
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.local_dir_vector)
			--- 변경할 상태
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.action)

			--- 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			--- 안부딪히고 시간이 만료되었다.
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end

		-- 돌진 업데이트
		self:update_charge(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stun_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.stun_rock then
		if self.time_passed >= self.stun_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
			return
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_attack_ranges(dt)
	--- 실 대상과 현재 벡터의 차이
	local angle_diff = unity_class.vector3.Angle(self.sync_dir_vector, self.current_dir_vector)
	--- 각도 차가 거의 없다면 아무것도 하지 않는다.
	if float_util.is_almost_zero(angle_diff) then return end

		--- 위 차이를 제한값으로 클램핑
	local clamped_angle = angle_diff <= self.turn_angle_limit and angle_diff or self.turn_angle_limit

	--- 좌우 회전인지 알아내기
	local cross_product = unity_class.vector3.Cross(self.sync_dir_vector, self.current_dir_vector)
	if cross_product.y > 0 then clamped_angle = -clamped_angle end

	--- 이번 프레임의 각도
	self.current_angle = self.current_angle + clamped_angle
	--- 이번 프레임의 방향 벡터
	self.current_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.current_angle, 0) * vector_util.forward

	--- 어택 레인지 회전
	local pos = character_util.get_position(self.character)
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, pos, self.current_dir_vector)
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

end

function local_class:update_charge(dt)
	--if not battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then return end

	if  self.time_passed < self.charge_duration then
		--- 진행도
		local progress = math.min(self.time_passed / self.charge_duration, 1)
		--- 진행도에 따른 새로운 위치
		local new_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.trigger_pos, self.end_pos, progress)
		--- 새로운 위치까지의 diff
		local diff = new_pos - character_util.get_position(self.character)

		local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
		move_info.direction = diff.normalized
		move_info.magnitude = diff.magnitude

		local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(move_info.direction), false)
		message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)


		--- 판정 체크
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.sync_dir_vector)

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

			--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 생략함
			if #hit_targets > 0 then
				for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
					self:apply_damage(target)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

--- 네트웍으로 갱신될 정보
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 변환할 state 정보가 있다면 state 처리용
	if trigger_info_util.contains_integer(info) then
		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		--- 돌진을 종료할 위치
		self.end_pos = self.trigger_pos + self.charge_length * self.sync_dir_vector
		-- 위치 싱크
		if self.cs_action.IsActive then
			self.character.Position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		end

		local state = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

		self:change_state(state)
	else	--- 어택 레인지의 마지막 방향 갱신 = 최종 돌진 방향
		--- 돌진 시작 위치
		self.trigger_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
		--- 네트워크상 동기화 된 벡터
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.MoveBlockedEvent) then
			local blocker = e.Blocker
			if blocker ~= nil then
				if blocker.CrashBehaviour:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour) then

					--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
					local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
					--- 돌진 위치
					trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.character))
					--- 돌진할 방향 정보
					trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.local_dir_vector)

					if string.match(blocker.Name, 'rock') then
						--- 변경할 상태
						trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.stun_rock)
						--- [추가 필요] "일반 벽"이면 CC 소량 부여
						--- 파괴 가능한 바위면 CC 대랑 뷰여
						--- 정지시킨 바위에게 충돌 피해 전달
						self:apply_gimmick_damage(blocker)

					else
						--trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.state.stun)
					end

					--- 커맨드 발행
					command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

--- 돌진 피격 대상 일반 피해
function local_class:apply_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
	damage_info.direction = self.local_dir_vector
	--- dir_vector == 진행 방향
	--- target_dir == 대상과 공격자의 사이의 방향
	--- 두 벡터 사이 합을 확인
	local target_dir = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.character.Position)
	local knock_back_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.local_dir_vector + target_dir)

	--- 0 이란 의미는 뒤에서 박았단 의미인데, 사실상 불가능, 어쟀던 겹쳐있거나 한상태니 그냥 넉백방향도 운동방향과비슷하게 처리
	if knock_back_dir:IsAlmostZero() then
		knock_back_dir = self.local_dir_vector
	end

	damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_back_dir
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
	damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
	end

--- 자신에게 CC 피해
function local_class:apply_self_cc(stun_ratio)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = self.character
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, stun_ratio)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- 바위에게 파괴 트리거 전송
function local_class:apply_gimmick_damage(target)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopExpeditionDefenseAuraBattleAction')

--필수 구현
-- 일반적인 돌진 + 특정 개체와 충돌 시 CC게이지 획득. 해당 개체 파괴시 CC 게이지를 추가받음
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_battle_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ActionDuration', 1)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	--- 부여할 방어력 버프
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	self.time_passed = 0
end


function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	-- 커맨드 생성
	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.owner, self.owner)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 최초 트리거 시점에 대상 갱신
function local_class:start(info)
	self.target = self.owner

	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then return	end

	-- Exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.prepare_duration
		self.owner:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_action)
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.owner))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.time_passed = self.time_passed - self.action_duration

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		if not is_unity_null(self.fx_charge) then
			self.fx_charge:Dispose()
		end
		self.fx_charge = nil
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.time_passed = 0
	else

	end

	-- Enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:PublishSync(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.owner, self.prepare_duration))

		self.cs_action:SetCharacterAnimation('cast')
		---self.cs_action:PlaySfx("cast", self.character.Position)
		---self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('cast', self.owner.Position, vector_util.zero, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true

		--- 카메라 쳐다보면서 애니메이션 하도록 설정
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.Direction.Down)

		--- 피해 감소 버프 적용
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_info)
		--- [연출] 쉴드나 오라 생기는 연출
		---self.fx_charge = self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('loop', self.owner.Position)

	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_action.IsActive = true
		---self.cs_action:InstantiateEffect('end', self.owner.Position, vector_util.zero, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	else
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

		end
	end

end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	return false
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CoopExpeditionSlashBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0.1)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.76)
	self.tracking_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "TrackingDuration", 0)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1.5)

	self.attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 5)
	self.hittable_distance = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "HittableDistance", 3)
	local attack_angle = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackAngle", 145)
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackForce", 1.0)
	self.knock_back_factor = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, "KnockBackFactor",
			CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.Direction = unity_class.vector3.right
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = 0.2
	info.Radius = self.attack_radius
	info.Angle = attack_angle
	info.Height = 3
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, self.attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateArc(unity_class.vector3.zero, self.attack_radius, attack_angle,
			CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.on_aggro_change_event_func = function(e)
		self:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	end
	CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.MostAggroChangedEvent),
			self.on_aggro_change_event_func)

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return false
	end

	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.character, target) <= self.hittable_distance
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 트리거 정보 생성하기 위해 AI 타겟 가져옴
	local target = CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.GetAITarget(self.character)

	if target == nil then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateWithTarget(self.character, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.character.Position)
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	local target = info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if is_unity_null(target) then
		return
	end

	self.target = target
	self.character.Position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)

		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))

		battle_range_util.hide(self.attack_range)
		battle_range_util.publish_end(self.character, self.attack_range)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.attack_calculator:End()
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare")

		local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.dir_vec = vector_util.normalized(diff)
		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vec)
		self.character.Direction = direction

		battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.dir_vec, self.character.Position.y)
		battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range, self.prepare_duration + self.attack_delay)
		battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)

		self.target_locked = false
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action2")

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.attack_calculator.Direction = self.dir_vec
		self.attack_calculator:Start()

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('slash', self.character.Position, self.dir_vec)
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed < self.tracking_duration then
			local diff = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
			self.dir_vec = vector_util.normalized(diff)
			local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vec)
			self.character.Direction = direction
			battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.dir_vec, self.character.Position.y)
			battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
		elseif not self.target_locked and battle_util.is_local_fo(self.character) then
			local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vec)
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_battle_action, sync_info)
		elseif self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
				damage_info.damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knock_back_factor = self.knock_back_factor
				damage_info.knock_back_dir = knock_direction
				damage_info.knock_back_force = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.knock_back_force

				local has_value, sfx_info = self.cs_battle_action.SfxInfos:TryGetValue('hit')
				if has_value then
					damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, sfx_info.sfxName)
				end

				command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:sync(info)
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		return
	end

	self.target_locked = true
	self.dir_vec = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vec)
	self.character.Direction = direction
	battle_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.attack_range, self.character.Position, self.dir_vec, self.character.Position.y)
	battle_range_util.publish_update(self.character, self.attack_range)
end

function local_class:on_aggro_change_event(e)
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.prepare then
		return false
	end

	if self.time_passed >= self.tracking_duration then
		return false
	end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.character, e.Subject) and not lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, e.Target) then
		self.target = e.Target
		--타겟표시용 UI를 위해서 타겟이 변경되면 변경된 타겟을 보내 줌
		if self.show_target_arrow then
			coop_expedition_util.send_target_marker_event(self.character, self.target)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:cancel()

	self.critical_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CriticalDamageScale', 1)
	self.current_damage_scale = 0

	self.cast_key = 'cast'
	self.ice_pillar_marker_prefix = 'perfect_wave_ice_marker_'
	self.ice_pillar = nil
	self.cast_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'CastDuration', 3)

	--wave
	self.wave_key = 'wave'

	self.wave_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'WaveKnockBackForce', 0.25)

	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(vector_util.zero, self.wave_radius, CS.Oak.AttackRangeShowType.OverlayForward)

	--explode

	self.explode_knock_back_force = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionKnockBackForce', 1)
	self.explode_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ExplosionModifier', 1)

	--post
	self.post_key = 'post'
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

		explode = 3,
		post = 4,
	}

	self.time_passed = 0

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)
	info:AppendNumber(random_util.get_random_value() < self.critical_chance and 1 or 0)

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, info)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)

	if info:GetNumberAt(0) == 1 then
		self.current_damage_scale = self.critical_scale + 1
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CoopExpeditionBossCriticalAttackEvent.Create(self.character))
	else
		self.current_damage_scale = 1
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.cast)
end

function local_class:update_wave(dt)
	local objects = self.wave_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
	for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local fo = objects[index]

		self.is_hit = true
		local dir = vector_util.normalized(self.character.Position - fo.Position)

		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = fo
		damage_info.modifier = self.wave_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
		damage_info.direction = dir
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.wave_knock_back_force
		damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_bluedragon_hit_01')
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:explode()
		self.wave_calculator:Start()

		local objects = self.wave_calculator:UpdateFrame(0)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			local dir = vector_util.normalized(self.character.Position - fo.Position)

			self.is_hit = true
			local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
			damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
			damage_info.sender = self.character
			damage_info.target = fo
			damage_info.modifier = self.explode_modifier * self.current_damage_scale
			damage_info.direction = dir
			damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
			damage_info.knockBackDirection = dir
			damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.explode_knock_back_force
			damage_info.hitSfxInfo = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_bluedragon_hit_01')
			command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		self.wave_calculator:End()
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wave then
		self.wave_calculator:End()

		if self.wave_fx ~= nil then
			self.wave_fx:Dispose()
			self.wave_fx = nil
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then

	end


	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state

	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.cast_duration))
		battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.character.Position)
		self.attack_range:Show(self.cast_duration)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wave then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.wave_calculator.Position = self.character.Position
		self.wave_calculator:Start()
		self.wave_fx = self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect(self.wave_key, self.character.Position)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.wave_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect('explosion', self.character.Position)
		self:explode()

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false

		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
	end
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state == self.state.cast then
		if self.time_passed > self.cast_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.wave)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.wave then
		if self.time_passed > self.wave_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.explode)

			self:update_wave(dt)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.explode then

		end

		end

	end

end

	--return bool

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then

		self.slash_calculator:Start()

	end

	self.time_passed = 0

	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_slash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.slash)
			return
		end
		self.target_dir = vector_util.normalized(self.target.Position - self.character.Position)
		self.character.Direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.slash then
		if self.time_passed > self.slash_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.prepare_charge)
			return
		end

		self:update_slash(dt)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.prepare_charge then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.charge)
		end

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.charge then
		if self.time_passed > self.charge_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
			return
		end
		self:update_charge(dt)
