	local move_info = CS.Oak.MoveOneFrameInfo()
	move_info.direction = self.target_dir
	move_info.magnitude = dt * self.charge_speed

	local move_event = CS.Oak.AtomicMoveEvent.Create(move_info, vector_util.to_direction(self.target_dir), true, false, CS.Oak.AfterCrashType.None, unity_class.vector3.zero)
	message_system:SendSync(self.character, move_event)

	self.charge_calculator.Position = self.character.Bounds.center
	self.charge_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
	local objects = self.charge_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local target = objects[i]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.modifier = self.charge_atk_mod
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.charge_knockback_factor
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = vector_util.normalized(target.Position - self.charge_calculator.Position)
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.charge_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:update_slash(dt)
	self.slash_fx.transform.position = self.slash_fx.transform.position + self.target_dir * (dt * self.slash_proj_speed)
	self.slash_calculator.Position = self.slash_fx.transform.position
	self.slash_calculator.Direction = self.target_dir
	local objects = self.slash_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)

	for i = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
		local target = objects[i]
		local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
		damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
		damage_info.sender = self.character
		damage_info.target = target
		damage_info.modifier = self.slash_atk_mod
		damage_info.knockBackFactor = self.slash_knockback_factor
		damage_info.knockBackDirection = self.target_dir
		damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce * self.slash_knockback_force
		command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
	end
	objects:Dispose()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil

	self.slash_fx = nil
	self.slash_calculator = nil

	self.charge_calculator = nil

	self.state = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

local local_class = newclass('CunningAreaHealBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PrepareDuration', 3)

	self.prepare_key = 'prepare'
	self.heal_key = 'heal'
	self.area_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HealDistance', 4)
	self.buff_id = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BuffId', -1)
	self.buff_level = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'BuffLevel')
	self.heal_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'HealDuration', 1)
	self.heal_amount = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'HealAmount', 100)

	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'PostDuration', 1)

	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		heal = 3,
		post = 4,
	}
	self.current_state = self.state.none
	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.Create(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName)
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:force_cancel()
	self:cancel()
end

function local_class:cancel()
	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	--exit
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.heal then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_battle_action)
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
	end

	self.current_state = next_state
	--enter
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.prepare_key)

	elseif self.current_state == self.state.heal then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation(self.heal_key)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx(self.heal_key)
		local fo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInRadius(self.character.Position, self.area_radius)
		for i = 0, fo_list.Count - 1 do
			if battle_util.is_friendly_target(self.character, fo_list[i]) then
				self:heal_target(fo_list[i])
				if self.buff_id ~= -1 then
					buff_manager:AddBuff(self.character, CS.Oak.EquipmentSlot.None, fo_list[i], self.buff_id, self.buff_level, true, false)
				end
			end
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
end

function local_class:heal_target(target)
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = CS.Oak.HealType.Normal
	heal_info.sender = self.character
	heal_info.target = target
	heal_info.heal = self.heal_amount
	heal_info.isRevive = false

	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if self.time_passed > self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.heal)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.heal then
		if self.time_passed > self.heal_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed > self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

-- 배틀액션 외부 (*BattleAI?)에서 이동할 좌표 직접 입력 받아 이동하는 배틀액션
local local_class = newclass('CustomTeleportBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	self.cs_battle_action = cs_battle_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	-- 파라미터 파싱
	self.damage_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DamageModifier", 1)
	self.prepare_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PrepareDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDuration", 0.5)
	self.action_delay_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "ActionDelayDuration", 0.2)
	self.post_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "PostDuration", 1)

	self.lock_direction = CS.Utils.GetDirectionFromDictionary(params, "LockDirection")
	self.side_only = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "SideOnly")
	self.show_attack_range = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "ShowAttackRange", false)

	self.disable_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "DisableDelay", 0.3)
	self.enable_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "enableDelay", 0.1)

	self.is_effect_bounds_center = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "EffectBoundsCenter", false)

	local attack_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackRadius", 1)
	local attack_delay = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDelay", 0)
	local attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, "AttackDuration", self.action_duration)

	-- 공격 계산기 (최대 1히트 하도록 DamageTerm 및 maxHit 설정
	local info = CS.Oak.CylinderCollisionInfo()
	info.Center = unity_class.vector3.zero
	info.DamageTerm = -1
	info.Duration = attack_duration
	info.Radius = attack_radius
	info.Height = 2
	info.IsCenterToBottom = true
	self.attack_calculator = CS.Oak.AreaBattleCollision(self.character, info, true, attack_delay, 1)

	-- 공격 범위(이동위치) 표시
	self.attack_range = CS.AttackRange.CreateCircle(unity_class.vector3.zero, attack_radius)
	self.attack_range:Hide()

	self.use_dissolve = CS.Utils.GetBoolFromDictionary(params, "UseDissolve", false)

	-- 내부 스테이트
	self.state = {
		none = 1,
		prepare = 2,
		action = 3,
		post = 4
	}

	self.is_disabled = false

	-- 상태 초기화
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	if self.use_dissolve then
		self.dissolver_path = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverPath', 'asset_bundle_parent_folder_path')
		self.dissolver_container = CS.Utils.GetStringFromDictionary(params, 'DissolverContainer', 'dissolve_material_container')

		self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = function(e)
			self:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
		end
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Subscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent),self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
	end

end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.routine_load_dissolver, self))
end

function local_class:routine_load_dissolver()
	if not self.use_dissolve then
		return
	end

	self.dissolver = CS.Oak.StageLuaScript.GetOrCreateGlobalTable('utils/SpineCharacterDissolver')
	self.dissolver:load_async(self.dissolver_path, self.dissolver_container)
end

function local_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	-- 목적지 입력 되어 있어야 사용 가능
	return self.dest_pos ~= nil
end

function local_class:set_destination(input_pos)
	self.dest_pos = input_pos
end

function local_class:trigger()
	if self.current_state ~= self.state.none then
		return false
	end

	if not CS.Oak.ICharacterBehaviourExtensions.CanTriggerBattleAction(self.character.CharacterBehaviour) then
		return false
	end

	-- 목적지 외부에서 입력 되었는지 확인
	if self.dest_pos == nil then
		return false
	end

	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithPosition(self.character, self.cs_battle_action.HandleName, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.dest_pos))
	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)
	self.dest_pos = nil
	return true
end

function local_class:start(info)
	self.target_position = info:GetPositionAt(0)
	self.is_disabled = false
	self:change_state(self.state.prepare)
end

function local_class:cancel(is_dispose)
	--dispose에서 불렸을 경우 SetActive()관련 동작은 하지 않는다.
	if is_dispose ~= true then
		character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
	end

	if self.use_dissolve then
		self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)
end

function local_class:change_state(next_state)
	if next_state == self.current_state then
		return
	end

	-- 현재 스테이트 exit 처리
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueEndEvent.Create(self.character))
		self.attack_range:Hide()
		-- 취소 되지 않았을 경우 attackrange end event 는 뒤로 미룸
		if next_state ~= self.state.action then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		self.attack_calculator:End()
		CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeEndEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		if next_state ~= self.state.post then
			self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
			self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		self.character:RemoveAnimation(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action)
		self.character:RemoveEmotion(self.cs_battle_action)
	end

	-- 다음 스테이트 enter 처리
	if next_state == self.state.prepare then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 특정 방향 보고 쓰는 액션이라면 방향 설정.
		local dir_to_look = self.lock_direction
		if self.side_only and dir_to_look == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			dir_to_look = vector_util.to_side_dir(self.target_position - self.character.Position)
		end

		if dir_to_look ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			self.character:SetLockedDirection(self.cs_battle_action, CS.Oak.LockDirectionRequest.Create(dir_to_look, CS.Oak.LockDirectionPriorities.BattleAction))
		end

		if self.show_attack_range then
			battle_range_util.setup_by_position(self.attack_range, self.target_position)
			battle_range_util.show(self.attack_range)
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackRangeUpdateEvent.Create(self.character, self.attack_range))
		end
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.AttackQueueStartEvent.Create(self.character, self.prepare_duration))
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("prepare")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("prepare", self.character.Position)

		if self.use_dissolve then
			self.character.SpineController:AddColor('dissolve', unity_class.color.black, 1, 0)
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_material(self.character)
		end

		--순간이동 위치 이펙트
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("blink", self:get_effect_pos(self.character), unity_class.vector3.zero)
	elseif next_state == self.state.action then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true

		-- 이펙트 생성 및 순간이동 처리
		self.character.Position = self.target_position
		self.cs_battle_action:InstantiateEffect("dest", self:get_effect_pos(self.character), unity_class.vector3.zero)
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("blink", self.target_position)

		-- 공격 계산기 초기화
		self.attack_calculator.Position = self.target_position
		self.attack_calculator:Start()
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("action")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("action")
	elseif next_state == self.state.post then
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = true
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterAnimation("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:SetCharacterEmotion("post")
		self.cs_battle_action:PlaySfx("post")

		if self.use_dissolve then
			self.character.SpineController:RemoveColor('dissolve', 0)
			self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)
		end

	else
		self.cs_battle_action.IsActive = false
	end

	self.time_passed = 0
	self.current_state = next_state
end

function local_class:get_effect_pos(target)
	local effect_pos = target.Position
	if self.is_effect_bounds_center then
		effect_pos = target.Bounds.center
	end

	return effect_pos
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.current_state == nil or self.current_state == self.state.none then
		return
	end

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 각 스테이트 별 업데이트
	if self.current_state == self.state.prepare then
		if not self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.disable_delay and not self.use_dissolve then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "disabled")
			self.is_disabled = true
		end

		if self.use_dissolve then
			local progress = self.time_passed / self.prepare_duration
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(self.character, progress)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.prepare_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.action)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.action then
		-- 공격범위 계산기 업데이트 하면서 데미지 처리
		local objects = self.attack_calculator:UpdateFrame(dt)
		for index = 0, objects.Count - 1 do
			local fo = objects[index]

			-- 타격 가능한 대상 인지 확인
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, fo) then

				local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.character, fo)
				local knock_direction = direction

				if direction:IsAlmostZero() then
					knock_direction = direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.character))
				end

				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Melee
				damage_info.sender = self.character
				damage_info.target = fo
				damage_info.modifier = self.damage_modifier
				damage_info.direction = direction
				damage_info.knockBackFactor = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.FactorStrong
				damage_info.knockBackDirection = knock_direction
				damage_info.knockBackForce = CS.Oak.DamageKnockBackConstants.StandardForce

				command_util.publish_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
		objects:Dispose()

		if self.is_disabled and self.time_passed >= self.enable_delay and not self.use_dissolve then
			character_util.set_active_state(self.character, "enabled")
			self.is_disabled = false
		end

		if self.use_dissolve then

			local progress = 1 - self.time_passed / self.action_duration
			self.dissolver:set_dissolve_progress(self.character, progress)
		end

		if self.time_passed >= self.action_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.post)
		end
	elseif self.current_state == self.state.post then
		if self.time_passed >= self.post_duration then
			self:change_state(self.state.none)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- Lua Action은 Dispose 시점에 직접 Cancel/ForceCancel 실행
	self:cancel(true)

	if self.use_dissolve then
		if self.on_stage_loaded_event_func ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.MessageSystem.Instance:Unsubscribe(typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), self.on_stage_loaded_event_func)
			self.on_stage_loaded_event_func = nil
		end

		self.dissolver:remove_dissolve_material(self.character)
	end

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_battle_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil

	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil
	self.time_passed = nil

	self.damage_modifier = nil
	self.prepare_duration = nil
	self.action_duration = nil
	self.post_duration = nil

	self.lock_direction = nil
	self.side_only = nil

	if not is_unity_null(self.attack_range) then
		CS.UnityEngine.Object.Destroy(self.attack_range)
	end
	self.attack_range = nil
	self.attack_calculator = nil

	self.dest_pos = nil
	self.target_position = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_battle_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 수속성 탱커 (adela_noble) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpAdelaNobleBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	self.sub_scale = 1 - self.main_scale

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	---  스메쉬공격 에니메이션 연출 시작
	self.smash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SmashTiming')

	--- 공격 연출에서 판정 범위의 위치를 방향값에 맞추어 이동시키는 파라메터
	self.calc_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'CalcOffset')

	--- 대시 거리
	self.dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정체 목록
	self.calculator = {}

	---순차적으로 재생할 이펙트
	self.fx_name = {}
	table.insert(self.fx_name, 'explosion')

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		self.hit_timing[idx] = self.hit_timing[idx]

		if self.initial_hit_timing == nil then
			self.initial_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[idx]
		end

		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius[idx], height, nil, nil, nil)
		--- 판정 계산기 생성
		table.insert(self.calculator, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1))
	end

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.dash_dist + self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self:apply_cwp_option(param, level)
end

function action_state_class:apply_cwp_option(param, level)

	self.activate_cwp_option = false

	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		self.buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(option_param, 'DefenseBuffName')
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	if self.target then
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.target)
		self.target_pos = vector(self.target_pos.x,bounds_util.get_center(self.owner).y, self.target_pos.z)
	else
		self.target_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * (self.search_range + 0.5)
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성 및 재생
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- 캐스트 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		self.dir_vector
		--spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')

	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'smash')

	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff(self.owner, self.owner, self.buff_name, 0)
	end

end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx)

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then

		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil, nil, 0
		)

	end

	--- 이후 로직은 모두 바닥에서 수행하는 걸 가정.
	local attack_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner))

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.smash_timing) then

		local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
		--- 오른쪽,아래면 정방향으로 출력
		local key = (direction == direction_util.right or direction == direction_util.down) and 'smash' or 'smash_rev'
		self.slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action,
			key,
			attack_pos,
			self.dir_vector
			--spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.smash_timing, self.initial_hit_timing) then

		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		if not is_unity_null(self.slash_fx) then
			effect_util.update_object(self.slash_fx, attack_pos, self.dir_vector)
		end

	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator[idx],
			--- 판정 위치
				attack_pos + self.calc_offset * self.dir_vector,
				self.dir_vector
			)

			if idx == 1 then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.35)
			end

			--- 판정한 대상이 없다면 반환함
			if #hit_targets == 0 then
				return
			end

			local scale = idx == 1 and self.sub_scale or self.main_scale

			--- 각각 적중한 대상들에게 피해 적용
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, scale)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration - 0.25) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier
	) * scale

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_mute_sfx_info()

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range + 3)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 해군 대장 마리나(admiral) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpAdmiralBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	attack_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 가능 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 발사 간격
	fire_term = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	limit_fire = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 전용 애니메이션 여부
	has_anim = nil,
	--- 범위 이펙트 생성 타이밍
	artillery_timing = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	fire_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 강제 캔슬 여부
	forced_cancel = nil,
	--- 판정이 시작되었는가?
	routine_start = nil,
	--- 범위 이펙트
	range_fx = nil,
	--- 이번 시퀸스에 공격한 타겟
	hit_targets = {},
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * self.action.level
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubDamageScale')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- parsing each info
	battle_util.parse_action_param_and_apply(self.action, self.cs_action, param)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 타겟 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 발사 간격
	self.fire_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FireTerm')
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.limit_fire = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'LimitFire')

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
	--- 전용 애니메이션 여부
	self.has_anim = spine_util.has_animation(self.owner, self.action.animation_info['cwp'].name, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	--- 타이밍
	local t = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'MainTiming' or 'SubTiming')
	--- 범위 이펙트 생성 타이밍
	self.artillery_timing = t[1] / 30
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.fire_timing = t[2] / 30

	if self.fire_timing > self.action_duration then
		self.action_duration = self.fire_timing
	end
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return  battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.search_range
end

function action_state_class:force_cancel()
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	self.forced_cancel = true

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.range_fx , true)
	self.range_fx = nil
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	--- 강제 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.forced_cancel = false

	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

	if (direction & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) == CS.Oak.Direction.None then
		direction = direction_util.get_cw_turn(direction, 1)
	end

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, direction)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon and self.has_anim then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cwp')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cwpbackup')
	end

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.65, 0.3)
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.3)
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	self.routine_start = false

	--- 상황에 맞는 스크린 이펙트를 출력한다.
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'screen' or 'screenfallback')
	--- 스테이지 내의 모든 플레이어에게 연출되므로 2D로 재생한다.
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_parent(self.action, 'screen', nil)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.2, self.fire_term * 0.75)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 도중에 캔슬된 경우
	if self.routine_start == false then
		if self.range_fx then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.range_fx , true)
			self.range_fx = nil
		end

		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 범위 이펙트 생성 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.artillery_timing) then
		--- 이펙트 생성을 위한 sync 정보
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		trigger_info_util.append_number(info, 1)

		--- sync info
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.fire_timing) then
		self.routine_start = true

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.owner, util.cs_generator(self.fire_routine, self, 0))
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:fire_routine(label, wait_duration)
	if CS.Oak.SuperBaseActionExtensions.IsUsableRoutine(self.owner) == false then return end

	if self.forced_cancel then return end

	if wait_duration then
		wait_for_sec(wait_duration)
	end

	if self.forced_cancel then return end

	--- 지난 타겟을 공격하는 것이 가능한가?
	local can_hit_last_target = false
	--- 새로운 타겟
	local new_target

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.search_range, 3)

	--- 가장 먼 타겟 부터 순회
	for index = ifo_list.Values.Count - 1, 0, -1 do
		--- 범위 내의 개별 객체
		local ifo = ifo_list.Values[index]

		--- 대상을 공격하는 것이 가능한가?
		--- [재탐색] 부쉬 대응
		if battle_util.is_targetable(self.owner, ifo) then
			--- 지난 타겟과 동일한지
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(self.target, ifo) then
				--- 플래그 전환
				can_hit_last_target = true
			else
				--- 새로운 타겟 갱신
				new_target = ifo
				break
			end
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 타겟이 없고 이전 타겟을 공격할 수 있다면
	if new_target == nil and can_hit_last_target then
		--- 새로운 타겟은 이전 타겟
		new_target = self.target
	end

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, label)

	if new_target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, new_target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, new_target and
		self:get_offset_position(new_target.Position) or
		self:get_random_position(self.owner.Position, label))

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
end

function action_state_class:get_offset_position(target_pos)
	local r = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0.2, 1.1)
	local a = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 360)

	return target_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, a, 0) * vector(0, 0, r)
end

function action_state_class:get_random_position(trigger_pos, index)
	local r = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(1, self.search_range)
	local a = CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(0, 180) * (index % 2 == 1 and 180 or 0)

	return trigger_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, a, 0) * vector(0, 0, r)
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 이번 시퀸스에서 Force Cancel 되었다면, Sync 루틴을 중지함
	if self.forced_cancel then return end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		--- shake camera
		stage_camera:Shake(0.15, self.fire_term * 0.75)

		--- 타겟 갱신
		self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
		--- 몇 번째 발사인지
		local label = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)
		--- 대상 위치
		local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)

		--- 대상 위치에 판정
		self:on_explosion(battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos))

		if label == 0 then
			self.routine_start = true

			--- 스테이지 내의 모든 플레이어에게 연출되므로 2D로 재생한다.
			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_parent(self.action, 'explosion', nil)
		end

		--- 최대 포격을 한 상태라면 더이상 루틴을 진행하지 않음
		if label + 1 >= self.limit_fire then
			battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
		else
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.owner,
				util.cs_generator(self.fire_routine, self, label + 1, self.fire_term))
		end
	else
		self.range_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'range', self.owner.Position, nil, self.owner.Transform
		)
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_explosion(hit_position)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(hit_position, self.radius, 3)

	--- ifo 순회
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
		--- 대상이 공격가능한지 체크
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
			break
		end

		--- 상황에 맞는 계수
		local scale = self.hit_targets[target] and self.sub_damage_scale or self.main_damage_scale
		self.hit_targets[target] = true

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	until true end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', hit_position)
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.5
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_hit_big_01')

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 불가능함
	return false
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 바라보는 방향
	local look_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, direction_util.to_vector3(look_direction))

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.action_state:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.level = nil
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(state_key, new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state_machine[state_key]
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.state_machine[state_key] = new_state

	--- 시간 리셋
	new_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine.current and self.state_machine.current.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return target_dist <= self.offset + self.max_radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 길드성 등에서 어색한 연출을 없애기 위해 적당히 서치함
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 타겟 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.action)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- 후딜에 대시가 있어서 강제로 리셋
	local current_state = self.owner.CharacterBehaviour.CurrentState
	if current_state and lua_helper.type_compare(current_state, CS.Oak.ShortDashState) then
		self.owner:OnEvent(CS.Oak.CharacterBehaviourResetEvent.Instance)
	end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	if not trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, dir_vector, 0.4, 0.2, self.dash_duration)

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, nil, -dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)
	else
		for key in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
			self.hit_targets[key] = nil
			self.hit_counts[key] = nil
		end

		self.explosion_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.explosion_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.explosion)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for key, _ in pairs(self.state_machine) do
		if self.state_machine[key] and self.state_machine[key].update then
			local old_time_passed = self.state_machine[key].time_passed
			self.state_machine[key].time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

			self.state_machine[key].update(self, old_time_passed, self.state_machine[key].time_passed, dt)
		end
	end
end

--region action state

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set cast anim
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'castbackup')
	end

	--- set cast emo
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector
	)

	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Skill1)

		stage_camera:Shake(0.25, 0.1)
	end
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	if self.cast_fx then
		--- 캐스트 이펙트 해지
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil
	end

	--- 뒤로 흔드는 연출을 해지
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.sync_target = nil
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.hit_timing then
		if self.sync_target then
			self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
				self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
			)
		end

		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector)
	end

	--- 백 대시
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 표정 삭제
		battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		if self.cast_fx then
			--- 캐스트 이펙트 해지
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
			self.cast_fx = nil
		end

		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector)
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.sync_dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 차지 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region explosion state

--- Explosion 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_explosion_state(_)
	local init_pos = self.explosion_pos - bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
	--- instantiate explosion fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', init_pos, self.explosion_dir_vector)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', self.explosion_pos)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.explosion_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.explosion_dir_vector)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)
end

--- Explosion 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_explosion_state(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- Explosion 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_explosion_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	local diff = self.max_radius - self.min_radius
	local progress = math.min(time_passed / (self.expand_duration), 1)

	self.collision_info.Radius = math.min(self.min_radius + diff * progress, self.max_radius)

	--- 원형 판정
	self:update_collision(area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0), time_passed)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
	end
end

function local_class:update_collision(ifo_list, time_passed)
	--- 판정 리스트 순회
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		repeat
			--- 적대 플래그가 켜진 대상인가?
			if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
				break
			end

			--- 한번이라도 데미지를 준 대상일 때
			if self.hit_targets[target] then
				--- 최대 타격 횟수를 초과했다면 판정하지 않음
				if self.hit_counts[target] >= self.max_hit then
					break
				end

				--- 아직 데미지 간격이 유효하지 않다면 판정하지 않음
				if self.hit_targets[target] + self.damage_term > time_passed then
					break
				end
			end

			--- 첫 판정인가?
			local first_hit = self.hit_targets[target] == nil

			--- 상황에 맞는 계수
			local scale = first_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
			local hit_count = first_hit and 0 or self.hit_counts[target] + 1

			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(target, self.explosion_pos, scale)

			--- 갱신
			self.hit_targets[target] = time_passed
			self.hit_counts[target] = hit_count

			break

		until(false)
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--endregion

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, '02_magic_hit_02')

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 바케네코 미케 (bakeneko) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpBakenekoBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 확인해야 하는 버프 이름
	role_buff_name = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 마지막 판정
	last_hit_timing = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,

	--- 베는 이펙트
	slash_fx = nil,
	--- 광역기 이펙트
	aoe_fx = nil,

	--- 첫 타 체크를 위한 해시셋
	hit_targets_set = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 최대 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 체크할 버프 이름 확인
	self.role_buff_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'BuffName')

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍만 캐싱
	self.last_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[self.max_hit]

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 원형 실린더 판정
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)
	--- 첫 타 체크를 위한 해시셋
	self.hit_targets_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()

	--- 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- enhance 스킬인가?
	self.is_enhance = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 0) == 1
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성 및 재생
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, self:get_enhance_name('screen', self.is_enhance))

	--- 시전 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self:get_enhance_name('cast', self.is_enhance), bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 시전 효과음 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, self:get_enhance_name('cast', self.is_enhance))

	--- 발도 효과음 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'batto')

	--- set upper animation
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- dispose fx
	if self.slash_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx, true)
		self.slash_fx = nil
	end

	if self.aoe_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aoe_fx, true)
		self.aoe_fx = nil
	end

	if self.aoe_sfx_holder then
		sfx_util.fade_out(self.aoe_sfx_holder, 0.4)
		self.aoe_sfx_holder = nil
	end

	self.hit_targets_set:clear()

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.hit_timing[1] then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 공격 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		local target_pos

		--- 대상이 유효하고 거리 내에 있다면 대상의 위치로 설정함
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then
			target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
		else
			target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- set upper animation
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'slash' or 'slashfallback1')

		--- 이펙트 생성
		self.slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			self:get_enhance_name('slash', self.is_enhance),
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			vector_util.to_4way_vector_ver2(self.dir_vector)
		)

		self.aoe_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, self:get_enhance_name('aoe', self.is_enhance), target_pos)

		--- 효과음 출력
		self.aoe_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, self:get_enhance_name('aoe', self.is_enhance), target_pos)

		--- 판정 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, target_pos)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if false == battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 비 전용무기 전용 연출
		if not self.is_exclusive_weapon and idx > 1 then
			--- set upper animation
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, (idx % 2 ~= 0) and 'slashfallback1' or 'slashfallback2')
		end

		if idx == self.max_hit then
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx, false)
			self.slash_fx = nil

			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.aoe_fx, false)
			self.aoe_fx = nil

			--- 효과음이 페이드아웃 되지 않도록 할당 해제함
			self.aoe_sfx_holder = nil
		end

		if self.is_enhance then
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.2)
		else
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.17)
		end

		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
		--- 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local damage_scale = self.hit_targets_set:add(fo) and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, damage_scale)
		end
	until true end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:dispose()
	if self.hit_targets_set then
		self.hit_targets_set:dispose()
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)
	--- 효과음 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, self:get_enhance_name('hit', self.is_enhance))

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- enhance 붙이기 위한 간단한 함수
function action_state_class:get_enhance_name(name, is_enhance)
	if true == is_enhance then
		return name .. "_enhance"
	end

	return name
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- enhance 여부를 체크하기 위해 버프 상태를 봐야 한다.
	if self.action_state.role_buff_name ~= nil and character_util.has_active_buff_consider_remove(self.owner, self.action_state.role_buff_name) then
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, 1)
	end

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 배틀볼 소녀 리에 (battleball_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpBattleballGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,

	--- 애니메이션 출력 시간
	anim_duration = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

---- parsing battle action data

	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍

	--- 전용 무기 여부

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 바라보는 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 애니메이션 출력
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Skill1)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
