	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- fire 이펙트 출력 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.3) then

		local fire_offset = self.dir_vector * 1.8

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'fire',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + fire_offset,
			self.dir_vector
		)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
	end

	--- slash 이펙트 출력 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.35) then

		local dir = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)

		local slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'slash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			vector_util.to_4way_vector_ver2(self.dir_vector)
		)

		local check_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down | CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		if false == self.is_exclusive_weapon and (dir & check_dir) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None then
			slash_fx.transform.localScale = vector(1, 1, 1)
		end
	end

	--- 투사체 발사 타이밍에 맞추어 싱크를 쏜다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		self.action:start_field_state();
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.anim_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보

	--- 투사체 3번 발사 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,

	--- max hit

	--- 현재 발사한 개수
	current_hit = 1,

	--- 마지막 쐈던 위치
	last_shoot_target_pos = nil,
	proj_shoot_length = 0,

	--- 투사체 shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- 투사체 helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- 투사체 스펙
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기

	--- 현재 지나간 시간

field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	--- 투사체 3번 발사 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 투사체 발사 총 개수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 발사 개수 초기화
	self.current_hit = 1

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 중돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 투사체 최대 길이
	self.proj_shoot_length = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
end

function field_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 발사 개수 초기화
	self.current_hit = 1

	--- 시작하자마자 마지막 타겟 위치를 계산해서 갱신해주자.
	self.last_shoot_target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(
		character_util.get_position(self.owner) +
		self.proj_shoot_length * direction_util.to_4way_vector3_ver2(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 발사 타이밍 마다 1개씩 발사 시도
	if self.current_hit <= self.max_hit then
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[self.current_hit]) then
			--- 가장 가까운 상대 우선
			local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

			local target_pos = nil

			if target then
				--- 타겟이 유효하다면 타겟의 포지션을 기반으로 쏘는 위치와 착탄지점 계산, 갱신
				target_pos = character_util.get_position(target)
				self.last_shoot_target_pos = target_pos

			else
				--- 그렇지 않다면 마지막 쐈던 위치로
				target_pos = self.last_shoot_target_pos
			end

			local shoot_pos = target_pos + vector_util.up * self.proj_shoot_length

			--- 싱크 정보 생성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			--- 발사 위치 싱크
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)

			--- 착탄 위치 싱크
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target_pos)

			--- 싱크 정보 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

			--- 1개 발사했다.
			self.current_hit = self.current_hit + 1
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[self.max_hit]) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	--- 상태이상 부여
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 부여
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 싱크 정보 가져옴
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	--- 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1],
		shoot_pos,
		vector_util.down,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		target_pos
	)
end

function field_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if hit_info.hitType ~= projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		return false
	end

	--- 피탄 위치 캐시
	local hit_pos = hit_info.position

	--- 투사체 폭발 랜덤 회전용 변수
	local rand_angle = unity_class.random.value * 360

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.2)
	--- 투사체 폭발 시 fx 재생
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, rand_angle, 0) * vector_util.right)
	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- 판정 위치 세팅
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, hit_pos)
	--- 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	--- 판정 체크
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 투사체의 atk modifier 을 기반으로 modifier 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hit)

	--- loop ifo
	for _, target in pairs(fo_list) do repeat
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			break
		end

		--- 데미지 처리
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, 1 / self.max_hit)
	until true end

	return true
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	--- darken state
	self.darken_state = darken_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- darken state machine
	self.darken_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.darken_state.machine = self.darken_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		self.darken_machine:change(nil)
		self.darken_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
		self.darken_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded() and self.field_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
	self.darken_machine:change(self.darken_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	self.darken_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:start_field_state()
	if not self.field_state then
		return
	end

	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.field_state then
		return
	end

	self.field_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.darken_machine then
		self.darken_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- field state가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.field_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.field_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 중국 3주년 윤 (blue_dragon) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpBlueDragonBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그
	force_cancel = false,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 데미지 정보
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainScale')

	--- 상태 이상
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 정보
	--- 높이
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 최대 길이
	self.min_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MinLength')
	self.max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainWidth')

	--- 확장
	self.expand_start = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpendStart')
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpendDuration')
	self.expand_end = self.expand_start + self.expand_duration
	--- 축소
	self.reduce_start = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceStart')
	self.reduce_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceDuration')
	self.reduce_end = self.reduce_start + self.reduce_duration

	--- 판정 지속시간동안 1회만
	local collision_size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.width)
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		collision_size, self.reduce_end - self.expand_start, 0, true
	)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, nil, 1)

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성 위치 설정
	local explosion_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionCount')
	local target_index = math.max(explosion_count - 1, 0)
	local begin_offset = 1
	local total = self.max_length - 2
	local offset_step = total / target_index
	local time_step = self.expand_duration / explosion_count
	--- 지면 폭발 fx에 대한 오프셋
	self.explosion_offsets = {}

	for idx = 0, target_index do
		self.explosion_offsets[0.1 + time_step * idx] = 1 + offset_step * idx
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.trigger_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	self.ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.trigger_pos)
	self.ground_y = self.ground_pos.y
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 초기화
	self.force_cancel = false

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 캐스트 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)

	self.expand_progress = 0
	self.reduce_progress = 0
	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	self.explosion_fx_time = 0
	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 공격 이전에 캔슬되었을때
	if self.current_time_passed <= self.expand_end then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_main)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_main_trail)
	self.fx_main = nil
	self.fx_main_trail = nil

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_start) then
		local fx_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		self.fx_main = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'center', fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
		self.fx_main_trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', fx_pos, self.dir_vector)

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.trigger_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.4)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_start, self.expand_end) then
		self.expand_progress = math.min(math.max((time_passed - self.expand_start), 0) / self.expand_duration, 1)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_end) then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_main)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_main_trail)
		self.fx_main = nil
		self.fx_main_trail = nil
	end

	--- 연출
	for target_time, offset in pairs(self.explosion_offsets) do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, target_time) then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action,
				'explosion',
				self.ground_pos + self.dir_vector * offset,
				self.dir_vector
			)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.reduce_start, self.reduce_end) then
		self.reduce_progress = math.min(math.max((time_passed - self.reduce_start), 0) / self.reduce_duration, 1)
	end


	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		local start_pos = self.trigger_pos + self.max_length * self.reduce_progress * self.dir_vector
		local final_pos = self.trigger_pos + self.max_length * self.expand_progress * self.dir_vector
		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(final_pos, self.ground_y)

		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_main, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_main_trail, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)


		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, start_pos)

		local diff = vector_util.magnitude(final_pos - start_pos)
		self.collision_info.Size = vector(diff, self.height, self.width)

		local hit_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier) * self.main_scale

		if #hit_list > 0 then
			for _, target in pairs(hit_list) do
				--- 데미지 적용
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, self.main_scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 높이
	height = nil,
	--- 최대 길이
	max_length = nil,
	--- 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 확장 시간
	expand_duration = nil,
	--- 줄어드는 타이밍
	reduce_timing = nil,
	--- 줄어드는 시간
	reduce_duration = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 판정 시간
	attack_duration = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 공격 시작 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 공격 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {}
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level

	self.sub_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')
	--- 상태 이상
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 시간값 재 계산용 필드 state 시작 시간
	local field_start_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpendStart') + cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')

	self.expand_start = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubExpendStart') - field_start_timing
	self.expand_end = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubExpendEnd') - field_start_timing
	self.expand_duration = self.expand_end - self.expand_start

	--- 판정 정보
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	self.max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	local main_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainWidth')
	self.min_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubMinWidth')
	self.max_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubMaxWidth')
	self.width_diff = self.max_width - self.min_width


	--- 중심 축으로부터 좌우 박스의 거리
	self.sub_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubOffset') + main_width / 2 / 2

	--- 좌우 판정
	local collision_size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.min_width)

	self.collision_info_left = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		collision_size, nil, nil, true
	)
	self.calculator_left = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info_left, nil, nil, 1)

	self.collision_info_right = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		collision_size, nil, nil, true
	)
	self.calculator_right = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info_right, nil, nil, 1)

	self.hit_list = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()
end

function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 공격 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 공격 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- 판정 상태 진입
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 대상 방향의 직교 벡터
	self.left_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * self.dir_vector
	self.right_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * self.dir_vector
end

--- 판정 상태 탈출
function field_state_class:exit(_)
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_left)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_right)

	self.hit_list:clear()
end

function field_state_class:dispose()
	if self.hit_list then self.hit_list:dispose() end
end

--- 판정 상태 갱신
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_start) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.27)

		local key = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'right' or 'left'
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, key, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.position), self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'second')

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_left, self.position + self.left_dir * self.min_width)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator_left, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_left)

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_right, self.position + self.right_dir * self.min_width)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator_right, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_right)

		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_start, self.expand_end) then
		local progress = math.min(math.max((time_passed - self.expand_start), 0) / self.expand_duration, 1)

		local left_pos = self.position + self.min_width / 2 * self.left_dir + self.width_diff / 2 * progress * self.left_dir + self.left_dir * self.sub_offset
		local right_pos = self.position + self.min_width / 2 * self.right_dir + self.width_diff / 2 * progress * self.right_dir + self.right_dir * self.sub_offset

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_left, left_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_right, right_pos)

		self.collision_info_left.Size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.min_width + self.width_diff * progress)
		self.collision_info_right.Size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.min_width + self.width_diff * progress)

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier) * self.sub_scale

		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_left, dt)) do
			if self.hit_list:add(target) then self:apply_damage(target, modifier) end
		end

		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator_right, dt)) do
			if self.hit_list:add(target) then self:apply_damage(target, modifier) end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.expand_end) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.15)

		--- 판정 처리 후 셀프 제거
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action,'hit')

	--- 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, self.sub_scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 판정 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.field_state)
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then
		return
	end

	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.field_state:sync(info)
	--- 판정 머신 동작
	self.field_state_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.field_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	--- 판정 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.field_state_machine then self.field_state_machine:update(dt) end
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 해변의 레이서 레이첼 (boatracing_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpBoatracingGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 대시 공격 타이밍
	self.dash_hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'DashHitTiming')

	--- max hit
	self.dash_max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')
	--- 대쉬 충돌체 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 대쉬 충돌체 길이
	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 term
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 대쉬 충돌체 크기
	local dash_collision_size = vector(length, height, width)
	--- 대쉬 충돌체 정보
	local dash_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(dash_collision_size, self.dash_duration, damage_term)
	--- 대쉬 충돌체 계산기
	self.dash_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, dash_collision_info, nil, nil, self.dash_max_hit)

	--- 메인 데미지 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / self.dash_max_hit

	--- waterpool 이펙트 조건여부 체크해야하는 타이밍
	self.waterpool_timing = 0.15

	--- waterpool 이펙트 조건 여부
	self.is_show_waterpool = false

	--- 대시 카메라 쉐이크 타이밍
	self.dash_shake_timing = {
		0.4, 0.5
	}

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 적용 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 적용시
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 무옵 버프 정보
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'Buff')
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 타겟 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 무옵 보유 시 무옵 버프 적용
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.cwp_buff_info)
	end

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- dash 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 초기 대시방향 초기화
	self.dash_dir_vector = self.dir_vector

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 깃발 이펙트 생성
	self.fx_flag = battle_util.instantiate_effect( self.action, 'flag', self.target_pos + vector_util.up * 5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- flag 해제
	if self.fx_flag then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_flag)
		self.fx_flag = nil
	end

	--- dash 해제
	if self.fx_dash then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_dash)
		self.fx_dash = nil
	end

	--- contrail 해제
	if self.fx_contrail then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_contrail)
		self.fx_contrail = nil
	end

	if self.is_show_waterpool and self.current_time_passed < self.hit_timing + self.waterpool_timing then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'flag_ground', self.target_pos)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	if self.dash_calculator then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.dash_calculator)
	end

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- 최초 시작 부터 히트타이밍까지 깃발 떨궈줘야 함
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 현재 fx 위치
		local fx_pos = self.fx_flag.transform.position

		--- 남은 시간 체크
		local remain_time = math.max(self.hit_timing - time_passed, 0)

		--- 다음 lerp 도달점
		local next_lerp = 0

		if remain_time <= 0 then
			next_lerp = 1
		else
			next_lerp = math.min(dt / remain_time, 1)
		end

		--- 현재 위치
		local next_pos = vector_util.lerp(fx_pos, self.target_pos, next_lerp)

		--- 이펙트 포지션 업데이트
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_flag, next_pos)
	end

	--- 깃발 떨어지고 대시 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then

		--- instantiate screen fx
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.15)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 있다면
		if 0 < #fo_list then
			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 데미지 부여
			for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)
			end
		end

		--- dash 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')

		--- 대쉬 이펙트 생성
		self.fx_dash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'dash',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dash_dir_vector,
			self.dash_dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- contrail 이펙트 생성
		self.fx_contrail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'contrail',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) - (self.dash_dir_vector * 0.5),
			self.dash_dir_vector
		)

		--- 대쉬 거리 기반으로 속도를 역계산
		local dash_distance = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)).magnitude
		local dash_speed = battle_util.short_dash_speed_for_distance(dash_distance, self.dash_duration)

		--- 대상 위치로 대쉬
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			nil,
			self.dash_dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			dash_speed,
			dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 대쉬 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.dash_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 대쉬 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.dash_calculator, self.dash_dir_vector)
		--- 대쉬 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.dash_calculator)

		self.is_show_waterpool = self:get_is_dash_reachable()

		--- ground 이펙트 우선 생성
		if not self.is_show_waterpool then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'flag_ground', self.target_pos)
		end
	end

	--- 깃발 땅에 떨어지는 이펙트 재생 필요시
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing + self.waterpool_timing)
		and self.is_show_waterpool then

		--- 이펙트 재생
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'waterpool', self.target_pos)

		--- 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'waterpool')
	end

	--- 대시 시 카메라 쉐이킹 타이밍
	for idx = 1, #self.dash_shake_timing do repeat
		--- 판정 시점이 아니라면 생략함
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_shake_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.08, 0.08)
	until true end

	--- 대시 시간 중 contrail 이펙트 위치 갱신
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing, self.action_duration) then
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_contrail, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) - (self.dash_dir_vector * 0.5), self.dash_dir_vector)
	end

	--- 대시 판정 체크
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.dash_calculator) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.dash_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.dash_calculator, self.dash_dir_vector)

		--- 판정 체크
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.dash_calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then

			--- 액션 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale)
			end

			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
		end

		--- 충돌체 계산기가 종료된 시점
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.dash_calculator) then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.dash_calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 현재 대시 정보를 기반으로 해당 self.target_pos 까지 도달 할 수 있는지를 반환하는 함수
function action_state_class:get_is_dash_reachable()

	--- entity extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	--- bounds extension cache
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 최대 거리
	local final_dist = vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - character_util.get_position(self.owner)).magnitude
	--- 검사할 마스크
	local mask = {
		--- 충돌 마스크
		entity_group_extension.CollisionMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		--- 때리기 마스크
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)]
	}

	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_collided_by(bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), final_dist * self.dir_vector)

	--- ifo 순회
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat

		--- mask 순회
		for index = 1, #mask do repeat

			--- 지정해준 마스크가 아닌 애들은 거름
			if (target.EntityGroup & mask[index]) == CS.Oak.EntityGroups.None then
				break
			end

			--- 타겟이 존재하면 ray 를 쏴서 거리체크
			if target then
				local distance = bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(
					bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner), bounds_util.get_bounds(target), self.dir_vector
				)

				if 1 <= final_dist - distance then
					return false
				end
			end

		until true end

	until true end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	return true
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 조작 방향 가져오기
	local stick_direction = battle_util.get_stick_direction(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	local target
	local dir_vector
	local target_pos

	--- 대시 시작 전 현재 방향키 입력을 기반으로 대시 방향을 조정해준다.
	if vector_util.magnitude(stick_direction) > 0 then
		--- 조작 방향이 유효한 경우 해당 방향으로 지정
		dir_vector = stick_direction

	else
		--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
		target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

		--- 대상이 존재할 경우
		if target then
			trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)

			target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(target))
		end
	end

	--- 타겟 포지션이 없을 경우 dir vector 기반 위치를 넣음
	if not target_pos then
		target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + (dir_vector * self.action_state.search_range))
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- append target position
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, target_pos)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 크리스마스의 정령 캐럴(captain_rabbit) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpCaptainRabbitBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 베기 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 베기 판정 각
	angle = nil,
	--- 찌르기 판정 시작 시점
	thrust_timing = nil,
	--- 찌르기 판정 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 찌르기 판정 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 베기 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 베기 판정 각
	self.angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')

	--- 베기 판정 정보
	self.slash_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(self.radius, self.angle, height, self.dash_duration)
	--- 베기 충돌체 계산기
	self.slash_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.slash_info)

	--- 찌르기 판정 시작 시점
	self.thrust_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ThrustTiming')
	--- 찌르기 판정 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 찌르기 판정 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')

	--- 찌르기 판정 크기
	local size = vector(self.length, height, self.width)
	--- 찌르기 판정 시간
	local hit_duration = self.action_duration - self.dash_duration

	--- 찌르기 판정 정보
	self.thrust_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, hit_duration, nil, true)
	--- 찌르기 충돌체 계산기
	self.thrust_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.thrust_info)

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / #self.thrust_timing
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.05)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 베기 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.slash_calculator)

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 타이밍 직전까지
	if old_time_passed < self.thrust_timing[1] then
		--- 타겟 검증
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self.target = nil
		else
			self.dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)
		end
	end

	--- slash animation timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing - 0.1) then
		--- set slash animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'slash')

		--- instantiate screen effect
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- get center
		local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		--- get 4-way direction
		local vector_4way = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)

		--- instantiate slash effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'slash', center, vector_4way, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- play slash sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'slash')

		--- request short dash
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed, nil, nil, nil
		)

		--- 베기 계산기 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.slash_calculator, center)
		--- 베기 계산기 방향 세팅 (4-way)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.slash_calculator, vector_4way)
		--- 베기 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.slash_calculator)

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.1)
	end

	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.slash_calculator) then
		--- 데미지 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 베기에 메인 계수 적용
		modifier = modifier * self.main_damage_scale

		--- 베기 계산기 위치 갱신
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.slash_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.slash_calculator, dt)

		for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)
		end

		ifo_list:Dispose()
	end

	for index = 1, #self.thrust_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.thrust_timing[index]) then
			if index == 1 then
				--- 베기 계산기 종료
				area_collision_util.calc_end(self.slash_calculator)
			end

			--- set locked direction
			battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

			--- get center
			local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)

			--- remove animation
			battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

			--- set thrust animation
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'thrust')

			--- set ik
			spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

			--- instantiate thrust effect
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'thrust', center, self.dir_vector)

			--- play slash sfx
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'thrust' .. index)

			--- 찌르기 계산기 위치 세팅
			area_collision_util.set_position(self.thrust_calculator, center)
			--- 찌르기 계산기 방향 세팅
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.thrust_calculator, self.dir_vector)
			--- 찌르기 계산기 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.thrust_calculator)

			--- 데미지 계수 계산
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 베기에 메인 계수 적용
			modifier = modifier * self.sub_damage_scale

			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.thrust_calculator, 0)

			for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
				self:apply_damage(t, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale, true)
			end

			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 찌르기 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.thrust_calculator)

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.12)
		end
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale, apply_knock_back)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	-- 충돌 시작했을 때
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.collision_calculator) and
		not area_collision_util.is_finished(self.collision_calculator) then

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))

		--- 충돌된 리스트
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then

	if self.hit_targets[target] == nil then
		self.hit_targets[target] = true

		scale = self.main_damage_scale
	else
		scale = self.sub_damage_scale
	end

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.1)

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	-- 데미지 전달 커맨드 실행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
