--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 무녀 검객 사야(exorcist_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpExorcistGirlBattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 투사체 shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- 투사체 helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- 투사체 스펙
	proj_spec = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	self.trace_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'TraceTiming')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 타이밍 테이블
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	self.max_shoot_count = #self.shoot_timing

	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

	--- 대미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainScale')
	self.sub_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)
		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
			--- 적중시 감소할 재사용 시간
			self.reduce_cool_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ReduceCoolTime')

			self.proj_hit_table = {}
		end

	until true end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 발사체 마다 최초 적중 여부 초기화
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		for idx = 1, self.max_shoot_count do
			self.proj_hit_table[idx] = false
		end
	end

	--- lock dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 이동 가능하면서 공격 할 수 있음으로 upper_anim
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')
	--- 캐스팅 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	local direction = vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector)
	--- 오른쪽,아래면 정방향으로 출력
	local key = (direction == direction_util.right or direction == direction_util.down) and 'slash' or 'slash_rev'

	self.slash_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, key, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 롤액션 최초 캐싱
	if self.role_action == nil then
		--- 롤액션 탐색
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(self.owner)
	end

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	local label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	--- shoot projectile

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[label], shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.offset,
		dir_vector, label, nil, nil, true)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.slash_fx, self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing[self.max_shoot_count])
	self.slash_fx = nil

	---공격 마치고 공격한 방향을 쳐다봐서 훽 돌아가는 느낌 제거
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 추적 시간까진 계속 추적
	if old_time_passed < self.trace_timing then
		--- 대상 방향 갱신
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 발사
	for idx = 1, self.max_shoot_count do
		local shoot_timing = self.shoot_timing[idx]
		--- 각 발사마다 좌,우로 베기 연출
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, shoot_timing) then
			local anim_key = idx % 2 == 0 and 'attack1' or 'attack2'
			battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)
		end

		--- 발사 커맨드
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, shoot_timing) then
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

			trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, idx)

			--- 커맨드 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)


			--- 막타에만 강한 쉐이크
			if idx ~= self.max_shoot_count then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.1)
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.25)
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'last')
			end

			--- 막타 직전쯔음 발사하는 투사체라면 암전 뺀다.
			if idx == 3 then
				battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)
			end
		end
	end

	--- 휘적휘적 이펙트는 플레이어 계속 추적
	if self.slash_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.slash_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 라이프 사이클 만료로 자연 소멸
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then return true end

	--- 대상 관통, 지형지물 무시
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.field_object then
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
			local scale = label == self.max_shoot_count and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale

			self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier, scale)

			--- [전무] 투사체당 최초 히트시 롤액션 쿨감 처리
			if self.activate_cwp_option and not self.proj_hit_table[label] then
				self.proj_hit_table[label] = true
				CS.Oak.IRoleBattleActionExtensions.UpdateCooltime(self.role_action, self.reduce_cool_time)
			end

			return false
		end
	end

	return false
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 스턴 정보
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end
--endregion

--region local
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.action_state then return end

	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 액션이 유효할 경우에만 호출
	if not self.action_state then return true end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 제 1 군단장 (fallen_queen) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFallenQueenBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback')

	local container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, container, parent_follow_flag.position
	)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 스크린 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 전용 무기 고유 연출
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- instantiate spear fx
		self.spear_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'spear', container.position, nil, container, parent_follow_flag.position
		)
		--- 어태치먼트 세팅
		local attachment = self.spear_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachment))
		attachment.SpineController = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)

		--- 카밀라 전용 추가 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cwp')
	end

	--- 스프링 연출 요청
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 1, 0.1, self.shoot_timing, 30)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 튕기는 연출 취소
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	if self.spear_fx then
		--- 어태치먼트 해지
		local attachment = self.spear_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachment))
		attachment:ResetVariables()
		--- dispose blade fx
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.spear_fx)
		self.spear_fx = nil
	end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 사출 타이밍 까지는 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- get center
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- ik update
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	--- 사출 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, center)
		--- 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		if self.spear_fx then
			--- 어태치먼트 해지
			local attachment = self.spear_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachment))
			attachment:ResetVariables()
			--- dispose blade fx
			effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.spear_fx)
			self.spear_fx = nil
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region projectile state

local projectile_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 투사체 사출 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 폭
	width = nil,
	--- 시작 크기
	base_length = nil,
	--- 최대 크기
	max_length = nil,
	--- 증가할 크기
	expand_length = nil,
	--- 높이
	height = nil,

	--- 딜레이 시간
	hit_delay = nil,
	--- 확장 시간
	expand_duration = nil,
	--- 축소 타이밍
	reduce_timing = nil,
	--- 축소 시간
	reduce_duration = nil,

	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 이 상태가 끝나는 타이밍
	state_end_timing = nil,

	--- main damage scale
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- sub damage scale
	sub_damage_scale = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	-- explosion offset table
	explosion_offsets = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
projectile_state_class.mt = { __index = projectile_state_class }

--- create projectile state
function projectile_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function projectile_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 투사체 사출 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 폭
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 시작 크기
	self.base_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseLength')
	--- 최대 크기
	self.max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	--- 증가할 크기
	self.expand_length = self.max_length - self.base_length
	--- 높이
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 딜레이 시간
	self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')
	--- 확장 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')
	--- 축소 타이밍
	self.reduce_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceTiming')
	--- 축소 시간
	self.reduce_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceDuration')
	--- 판정 지속 시간
	local attack_time = self.reduce_timing + self.reduce_duration
	--- 총 지속 시간
	self.state_end_timing = self.hit_delay + attack_time

	--- 판정 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- max_hit
	local max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 크기
	local size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.width)
	--- 판정 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_time, damage_term, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, 0, max_hit)

	--- main damage scale
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- sub damage scale
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / max_hit

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성 위치 설정
	local explosion_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionCount')
	local target_index = math.max(explosion_count - 1, 0)
	local begin_offset = self.width * 0.5
	local total = self.max_length - self.width
	local offset_step = total / target_index
	local time_step = self.expand_duration / explosion_count
	self.explosion_offsets = {}
	for idx = 0, target_index do
		self.explosion_offsets[self.hit_delay + time_step * idx] = begin_offset + offset_step * idx
	end

	--- proj_spec 설정 전에 개화 파싱
	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.shoot_offset + projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

end

function projectile_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if myth_activate_option then
		self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'SearchRange')
		self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
		self.is_active_myth_option = true

		--- 파싱된 개화용 projectile 데이터
		self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param, nil, nil, 'MythProjectileInfo')
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function projectile_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- hittable check
function projectile_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function projectile_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 사출 위치
	self.proj_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- projectile state enter
function projectile_state_class:enter(_)
	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1],
		self.proj_pos + self.dir_vector * self.shoot_offset,
		self.dir_vector
	)

	--- 폭발 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.21, 0.6)
end

function projectile_state_class:exit(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- projectile state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function projectile_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_delay) then
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.proj_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 연출
	for target_time, offset in pairs(self.explosion_offsets) do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, target_time) then
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action,
				'explosion',
				self.proj_pos + self.dir_vector * offset + vector_util.down * self.height * 0.5,
				self.dir_vector
			)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 딜레이를 제외한 현재 프레임의 time_passed
		local attack_time_passed = time_passed - self.hit_delay

		--- 진행도 계산
		local expand_progress = math.min(attack_time_passed / self.expand_duration, 1)
		local reduce_progress = math.min(math.max((attack_time_passed - self.reduce_timing), 0) / self.reduce_duration, 1)

		--- 거리 계산
		local expend_dist = self.base_length + self.expand_length * expand_progress
		local reduce_dist = self.max_length * reduce_progress

		--- 충돌체 계산기 갱신
		local calc_pos = self.proj_pos + reduce_dist * self.dir_vector
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, calc_pos)
		self.collision_info.Size = vector(expend_dist - reduce_dist, self.height, self.width)

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 폭발은 서브 스케일로 적용한다.
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 처리 완료했으면 상태를 이탈한다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_end_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function projectile_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 대상 공격 가능 여부 체크
	local target = hit_info.target
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
		--- 대미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		--- 투사체 히트는 메인 스케일로 적용한다.
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)
	end

	return false
end

function projectile_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	if self.is_active_myth_option then
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit_myth')
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- projectile state
	self.projectile_state = projectile_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- projectile state machine
	self.projectile_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.projectile_state.machine = self.projectile_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.projectile_machine:change(nil)
		self.projectile_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.projectile_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.projectile_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.projectile_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.projectile_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- projectile state가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.projectile_state then return end

	self.projectile_state:sync(info)
	self.projectile_machine:change(self.projectile_state)
end

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 콜라보 페른 (fern) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFernBattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	damage_modifier = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- ai 체크용 충돌체 정보
	hittable_info = nil,
	--- 보정용 충돌체 정보
	assist_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	calculator_info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 캐스팅 이펙트
	cast_fx = nil,
	--- 레이저 이펙트
	laser_fx = nil,
	--- 레이저 소멸 이펙트
	end_fx = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.damage_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	self.max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	self.ailment_scale = 1 / self.max_hit

	self.damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier / self.max_hit

	local length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	self.character_size_half = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).x / 2

	local size = vector(length + self.offset + self.character_size_half, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width)

	--- ai 체크용 충돌체 정보
	self.hittable_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		size * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale, nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 보정용 충돌체 정보
	self.assist_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		vector((length + self.offset) * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, width * 1.5),
		nil, nil, true
	)

	--- 판정 길이
	self.attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 시작 시간
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 판정 종료 시간
	self.end_timing = self.attack_timing + self.attack_duration

	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, nil,nil, true)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)
		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
			--- 공격력 증가 버프
			self.atk_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param)
		end

	until true end
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 충돌체 정보 갱신
	assist_util.update_collision_info(
		self.hittable_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	)

	return assist_util.is_hittable(self.cs_action, self.hittable_info, target)
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	--- 레이저 시전 체크
	self.is_laser_stared = false
	--- 레이저 종료 체크
	self.is_laser_end = false

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	self.cast_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	battle_util.play_voice_in_weight(self.cs_action, 10,
		character_voice_type.special_1, 5,
		character_voice_type.special_2, 5
	)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.07)

	--- 이펙트 위치
	local center_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', center_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

	--- [전무] 시전시 공증 버프
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, self.owner, self.atk_buff_info)
	end
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 캔슬된 경우
	if self.is_laser_stared and not self.is_laser_end  then
		--- 카메라 연출 취소
		battle_util.cancel_camera_shake('cwp')
		battle_util.cancel_camera_shake('sub_cwp')

		--- 캔슬 된 경우 별도로 틀어준다. trigger_time_limit이라 해제해도 재생은됨
		local center_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser_end', center_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 레이저 소멸 잔잔한 쉐이킹
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.2)
	end

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser_fx, true)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.end_fx)

	self.end_fx = nil
	self.cast_fx = nil
	self.laser_fx = nil

	-- 캐스팅 효과음 할당이 남아있다면 fade_out
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.cast_sfx_holder, 0.5)
	self.cast_sfx_holder = nil

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

	--- 마지막으로 공격한 방향 바라보도록 세팅
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	local center_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	local fx_pos = center_pos + self.offset * self.dir_vector

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- fx 연출
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
		--- instantiate laser effect
		self.laser_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'laser', center_pos + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))

		self.is_laser_stared = true

		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 캔슬목적 쉐이킹 네이밍 지정
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, self.attack_duration, 'cwp')
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.35, 0.18)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, center_pos - self.dir_vector * self.character_size_half, self.dir_vector)

			--- 공격력 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_modifier)

			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.end_timing) then
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
		effect_util.update_object(self.laser_fx, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_timing) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		self.is_laser_end = true
		--- 레이저 fx 즉시 제거 후 소멸 이펙트를 별도 처리
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser_fx, true)
		self.laser_fx = nil
		self.end_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'laser_end', fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 소멸 레이저 잔잔한 쉐이크
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.3)
	end

	--- 연출 종료 까지는 트래킹
	if self.end_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.end_fx, fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

		--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가 (기본 힛 사운드 뮤트)
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, self.ailment_scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 여러명이 맞는 경우 쉐이킹 강도 올리기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)
end


--endregion

--region local
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return false

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		self.action_state.assist_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	)

	--[[local dir_vector
	--- 조작 방향을 가져옴 (4 방향)

	--- 조작 방향이 없을 경우

		--- 보는 방향
		direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름

		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	-- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	-- 상태 이상
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	-- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params)

	-- 전체 액션 시간
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	-- 부메랑이 존재할 시간
	self.boomerang_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'BoomerangLifeTime')

	-- 대상 찾아내는 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	-- 캐스팅하는 시간
	self.cast_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CastTime')

	-- 캐스팅하는 반지름
	self.cast_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CastRadius')

	-- 처음 부메랑 던질 때의 데미지 비율 (돌아오는 것은 알아서 계산)
	self.damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageScale')

	-- 데미지 안 받는 충돌 범위 반지름
	self.exclusion_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExclusionRadius')

	-- 데미지 받는 충돌 범위 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'InclusionRadius')

	-- 충돌 범위 각도
	self.angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Angle')

	-- 이펙트 최소 반지름
	local fx_min_radius = 0.5

	-- 이펙트 최대 반지름
	local fx_max_radius = 0.9

	-- 이펙트 최대 거리
	self.fx_range = self.radius - fx_max_radius

	-- 이펙트 펼쳐지는 각도의 offset을 self.angle의 값에 따라서 유동적으로 대응하기 위한 값.
	-- 실제 사용은 self.fx_angle_offset으로 사용
	local dist = vector_util.distance(unity_class.vector3.forward * self.fx_range,
		unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.angle * 0.5, 0) * unity_class.vector3.forward * self.fx_range)
	self.fx_angle_offset = fx_max_radius / dist * self.angle * 0.5

	-- 부메랑이 끝까지 가는 시간
	self.boomerang_cycle = (self.boomerang_duration - self.cast_time) * 0.5

	-- 부메랑이 돌아오는 시점
	self.return_point = self.boomerang_cycle + self.cast_time

	-- 부메랑 처음 크기
	self.init_size = unity_class.vector3.one * fx_min_radius

	-- 부메라 최종 크기
	self.target_size = unity_class.vector3.one * fx_max_radius

	-- ease 함수들
	self.init_ease_func = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic
	self.return_ease_func = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic

	-- 지나간 시간
	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 부메랑 생성된 위치
	self.boomerang_start_pos = nil

	-- 부메랑이 돌아오는 위치들
	self.boomerang_end_pos_table = {}

	-- 공격 진행할 방향
	self.dir_vector = nil

	-- 움직일 부메랑 이펙트
	self.fx_boomerang_table = {}

	-- 캐스팅할 때, 데미지 입은 대상들
	self.cast_targets = {}

	-- 부메랑이 날라가기 시작했는지
	self.is_thrown = false

	-- progress가 cap만큼 남아있으면 판정 범위에서 제외하는 범위를 0으로 만들어준다.
	self.progress_cap = 0.25

	-- 데미지 받는 충돌 범위
	self.collision_info = CS.Oak.PieCollisionInfo()
	self.collision_info.Radius = self.radius
	self.collision_info.Angle = self.angle
	self.collision_info.Height = bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y
	self.collision_info.Duration = CS.System.Single.MaxValue
	self.collision_info.DamageTerm = -1

	self.collision_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, self.collision_info)

	-- 부메랑이 돌아오고 있는가?
	self.is_returning = false

	-- force cancel이 됐는지에 대한 플래그
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	-- 전용 무기 애니메이션이 존재하는지와 스파인이 이 애니메이션 가지고 있는지?
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.character) and
		spine_util.has_animation(self.character, self.animation_info['cast'].name, CS.Oak.Direction.Right)

	-- States
	self.state = {
		none = {
			id = 1,
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, dt) end
		},
		action = {
			id = 2,
			enter = self.enter_action_state,
			exit = self.exit_action_state,
			update = self.update_action_state
		}
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	-- 캐스팅 시간에만 컨트롤
	return self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 때리는 것이 가능한가?
--- @return boolean 가능 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, target) <= self.radius * 0.8
	--return bool
end

--- 장비 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션 작동 시작 요청
--- @return boolean 작동 가능 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
	--return bool
end

--- 배틀 액션 실제 작동 시작
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self.time_passed = 0

	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(self.dir_vector)

	self.is_returning = false
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

--- 배틀 액션 동작 취소
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed

	-- 부메랑이 완전히 돌아왔을 때
	func_util.call_if(self.on_exit, self.time_passed > self.boomerang_duration and self.is_thrown, self)

	-- 부메랑 관련 로직들
	if not self.is_returning and self.time_passed > self.return_point then
		-- 돌아오는 타이밍 체크
		self.is_returning = true
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
		area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.fx_boomerang_table do
		-- 부메랑 전진
		func_util.call_if(self.update_boomerang,
			self.time_passed > self.cast_time and self.time_passed < self.return_point,
			self, self.fx_boomerang_table[index], self.time_passed - self.cast_time,
			self.boomerang_cycle, self.boomerang_start_pos, self.boomerang_end_pos_table[index], self.init_size,
			self.target_size, self.init_ease_func, dt)

		-- 부메랑 후진
		func_util.call_if(self.update_boomerang, self.time_passed > self.return_point,
			self, self.fx_boomerang_table[index], self.time_passed - self.return_point,
			self.boomerang_cycle, self.boomerang_end_pos_table[index], self.boomerang_start_pos, self.target_size,
			self.init_size, self.return_ease_func, dt)
	end

	func_util.call_if(self.on_check_collision,
		self.time_passed > self.cast_time and self.time_passed < self.return_point and self.is_thrown, self, dt)
	func_util.call_if(self.on_check_collision, self.time_passed > self.return_point and self.is_thrown, self, dt)

	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- State Update
	func_util.call_if(self.current_state.update, self.current_state.update ~= nil and
		self.cs_action.IsActive, self, old_time_passed, dt)

end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	self.is_force_canceled = true
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	self:reset_boomerangs(true)

	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- 부메랑의 위치 및 크기 등을 업데이트 시켜줌
function local_class:update_boomerang(boomerang, time_passed, duration, start_pos, end_pos, init_size, target_size,
	ease_func, dt)
	-- Easing으로 위치 크기 조정
	local progress = ease_func(time_passed, 0, 1, duration)
	boomerang.proj.transform.position = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)
	boomerang.proj.transform.localScale = vector_util.lerp(init_size, target_size, progress)

	boomerang.trail.transform.position = vector_util.lerp(start_pos, end_pos, progress)

	-- 갈 때와 돌아올 때 범위 업데이트
	if not self.is_returning then
		self.collision_info.Radius = progress * self.radius

		-- 처음 및 끝 progress의 기준은 progress_cap이 결정
		-- 처음 progress or 처음 프레임에서 제외하는 부분 없음
		if progress < self.progress_cap or time_passed < dt then
			self.collision_info.HoleRadius = 0
		else
			self.collision_info.HoleRadius = progress * self.exclusion_radius
		end
	else
		self.collision_info.Radius = (1 - progress) * self.radius

		-- 끝 progress or 마지막 프레임에서도 제외하는 부분 없음
		if (1 - progress) > self.progress_cap or time_passed + dt < duration then
			self.collision_info.HoleRadius = (1 - progress) * self.exclusion_radius
		else
			self.collision_info.HoleRadius = 0
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_check_collision(dt)
	-- 데미지 충돌 계산 판정
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
			-- Get dps based modifier and direction for damage
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
			local dir = nil

			-- 갈 때와 올 때의 데미지 스케일은 다름
			if not self.is_returning then
				-- 캐스트할 때 맞았으면, 데미지를 입지 않고 넘어간다.
				if self.cast_targets[target] == nil then
					dir = (target.Position - self.boomerang_start_pos).normalized
					self:on_damage(target, modifier, self.damage_scale, dir)
				end
			else
				dir = (self.boomerang_start_pos - target.Position).normalized
				self:on_damage(target, modifier, 1 - self.damage_scale, dir)
			end
		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

-- 부메랑이 완전히 도착했을 때
function local_class:on_exit()
	self:reset_boomerangs(false)

	self.is_thrown = false

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'end', self.boomerang_start_pos)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- 대상에게 데미지 처리
function local_class:on_damage(target, modifier, scale, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.25, 0.1)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- 테이블들 해제
	self:reset_boomerangs(true)

	self.fx_boomerang_table = nil
	self.boomerang_end_pos_table = nil
	self.cast_targets = nil

	self.collision_calculator = nil

	self.init_ease_func = nil
	self.return_ease_func = nil

	-- json 기반 정보들 해지
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- action states

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	-- 방향 고정 및 이펙트 및 사운드들 재생
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'fallback')
	end
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'screen')

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'boomerang')

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character)

	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6, 0.2)

	-- 이전의 부메랑들이 남아있으면 여기서 해제해준다. 데미지 판정도 마찬가지
	self.is_thrown = false
	self:reset_boomerangs(true)
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, dt)
	func_util.call_if(self.cast_boomerang, battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, self.time_passed,
		self.cast_time) and not self.is_thrown, self)
	func_util.call_if(self.change_state, self.time_passed > self.action_duration, self, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

function local_class:cast_boomerang()
	-- 부메랑 이펙트 생성
	for index = 1, 3 do
		-- 날아가는 projectile 부분과 따라가는 trail을 묶어서 사용
		local proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, "boomerang", bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		local trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'contrail', proj.transform.position)

		self.fx_boomerang_table[index] = {
			proj = proj,
			trail = trail
		}
	end

	-- 부메랑들 처음 및 목표 위치 계산
	self.boomerang_start_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.character)

	self.boomerang_end_pos_table[1] = self.boomerang_start_pos + self.dir_vector * self.fx_range

	self.boomerang_end_pos_table[2] = self.boomerang_start_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.angle * 0.5 -
		self.fx_angle_offset, 0) * self.dir_vector * self.fx_range

	self.boomerang_end_pos_table[3] = self.boomerang_start_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -self.angle * 0.5 +
		self.fx_angle_offset, 0) * self.dir_vector * self.fx_range

	-- 충돌 계산
	self.collision_calculator.Position = bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	self.collision_calculator.Direction = self.dir_vector

	area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

	self.is_thrown = true

	stage_camera:Shake(0.065, 0.15)

	-- 캐스팅할 때 데미지 입히기 계산
	local ground_position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.character))

	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(ground_position, self.cast_radius,
		bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y)

	-- 부메랑 첫 타와 동일하게 적용하고, 캐스팅 데미지에 맞으면 첫 타에 맞지 않게 cast_targets에 추가
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
			local dir = (target.Position - self.boomerang_start_pos).normalized

			self.cast_targets[target] = true
			self:on_damage(target, modifier, self.damage_scale, dir)
		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

-- 부메랑 위치, 데미지 계산 등을 초기화
function local_class:reset_boomerangs(is_trail_immediate)
	for index = 1, #self.fx_boomerang_table do
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_boomerang_table[index].proj, true)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_boomerang_table[index].trail, is_trail_immediate)

		self.fx_boomerang_table[index].proj = nil
		self.fx_boomerang_table[index].trail = nil
		self.fx_boomerang_table[index] = nil
	end

	for index = 1, #self.boomerang_end_pos_table do
		self.boomerang_end_pos_table[index] = nil
	end

	for target in pairs(self.cast_targets) do
		self.cast_targets[target] = nil
	end

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 용의 화신 비슈바크(fire_bishop) 건틀렛 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFireBishop2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 오너의 스파인 컨테이너
	spine_container = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 반지름
	local hit_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 각
	local hit_angle = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Angle')
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 정보
	local hit_info = collision_info_util.create_pie(hit_radius, hit_angle, height)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, hit_info)

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = hit_radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.to_4way_vector(trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info))
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 상황에 맞는 에셋 키
	local asset_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback'

	--- 캐스트 애니메이션 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, asset_key)
	--- 캐스트 이모션 설정
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 캐릭터 흔들기
	character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.04, self.hit_timing)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- 스페셜 대사 재생
		battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Skill2)
	else
		--- play default voice
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)

	--- Side 방향인가?
	local is_side = (character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) & CS.Oak.Direction.Side) ~= CS.Oak.Direction.None
	--- 스프링 위치
	local spring_pos = is_side and -0.4 * self.dir_vector + 0.3 * vector_util.up or -0.4 * self.dir_vector

	--- 포지션 스프링 요청
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):DeviateLocal(
		spring_pos, self.hit_timing * 0.4, self.hit_timing * 0.58, self.hit_timing * 0.02
	)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, self.hit_timing * 0.8)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	local spine_controller = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)

	--- 그림자 위치 리셋
	spine_controller.ShadowTransform.localPosition = vector(0, 0.03, 0)
	--- 포지션 스프링 취소
	spine_controller:CancelDeviateLocal()

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	--- 캐릭터 흔들기 취소
	character_util.cancel_shake(self.owner)

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 현재 바닥 위치
	local ground =  battle_util.get_ground_pos(spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).localPosition)

	--- 그림자 위치 갱신
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).ShadowTransform.localPosition = ground + vector(0, 0.03, 0)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing) then
		--- 전용 무기가 아니라면
		if not self.is_exclusive_weapon then
			--- 공격 애니메이션 설정
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attackfallback')
		end

		--- 로컬 객체일 경우
		if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) then
			--- 폭발 연출
			self:instantiate_explosion_fx()

			--- 싱크 정보 생성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			---- 싱크 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end

		--- 공격 modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 충돌체 계산기 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator)

		--- ifo 순회
		for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(t, modifier)
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		--- 대상 할당 해제
		self.target = nil
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m

	--- 스턴 적용
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 넉백 적용
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, t)
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_melee_force * 1.6

	--- 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:instantiate_explosion_fx()
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'explosion', character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector
	)
	--- 폭발 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.23, 0.3)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(_)
	--- 로컬 객체인 경우
	if battle_util.is_local_fo(self.owner) then
		return
	end

	--- 폭발 연출
	self.action_state:instantiate_explosion_fx()
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
