local local_class = newclass('CwpFireBishopFlameOfDestructionBattleAction')

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 불의 신관 비슈바크(fire_bishop) 전용무기 필살기 FlameOfDestruction
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	self.attack_modifier = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	self.damage_type = CS.Utils.GetDamageTypeFromDictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType', CS.Oak.DamageType.None)
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info =
		battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 대상을 탐색할 범위
	self.search_range = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 차지 스테이트에 머무를 시간
	self.charge_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'ChargeDuration')
	--- 공격 스테이트에 머무를 시간
	self.attack_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'AttackDuration')

	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'SubDamageScale')
	--- 이번 phase에 실제 피격을 준 IFieldObject
	self.hit_targets = create_generic_hashset(CS.Oak.IFieldObject)

	--- Attack state가 몇 번 루프 될 것인가
	self.loop = CS.Utils.GetIntFromDictionary(params, 'Loop')

	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')

	--- fallback
	if self.dash_duration > self.attack_duration then
		self.dash_duration = self.attack_duration
	end

	--- 폭발 범위
	self.explosion_radius = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 플레이어로부터 폭발 위치까지 오프셋
	self.explosion_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(params, 'Offset')

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.sync_target = nil
	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil
	--- 싱크된 반복 횟수
	self.sync_loop = 0

	self.is_canceled = false

	--region state members region

	--- 내부 스테이트 정의
	self.state = {
		--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
		none = {
			id = 1,
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end
		},
		--- 차지 상태
		charge = {
			id = 2,
			enter = self.enter_charge_state,
			exit = self.exit_charge_state,
			update = self.update_charge_state
		},
		--- 대시 상태
		attack = {
			id = 3,
			enter = self.enter_attack_state,
			exit = self.exit_attack_state,
			update = self.update_attack_state
		}
	}

	--- 스테이트 인덱스 맵
	self.state_index_map = {}

	for key, value in pairs(self.state) do
		self.state_index_map[value.id] = key
	end

	---- 현재 스테이트
	self.current_state = self.state.none

	--- 현재 스테이트에서 지나간 시간
	self.time_passed = 0

	--endregion

	self:apply_cwp_option(params, level)
end

function local_class:apply_cwp_option(param, level)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 유효성 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 마나 반환 비율
		self.cwp_mana_refund_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ManaRefundScale')

		--- 최대 마나 반환 비율
		self.cwp_max_mana_refund_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MaxManaRefundScale')

		--- 현재 액션의 마나 코스트 캐싱
		self.cwp_mana_cost = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ManaCostBase') -
			cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ManaCostAdd') * level
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	for key in pairs(self.state) do
		for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
			self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
		end

		self.state[key] = nil
	end

	self.state = nil

	self.sync_target = nil

	self.hit_targets:Clear()
	self.hit_targets = nil

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지

	for index = 1, #self.animation_info do
		self.animation_info[index] = nil
	end

	for index = 1, #self.emotion_info do
		self.emotion_info[index] = nil
	end

	for index = 1, #self.preset_info do
		self.preset_info[index] = nil
	end

	for index = 1, #self.sfx_info do
		self.sfx_info[index] = nil
	end

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	--- 지나간 시간 리셋
	self.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state and self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5 * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local distance = bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction)

	return battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, target) <= distance + self.explosion_radius
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local trigger_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.owner)

	local target, direction =
		battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info:AppendTarget(target)
	end

	trigger_info:AppendDirection(direction)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.TriggerBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
		self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, trigger_info)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 타겟 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	--- 루프 횟수 리셋
	self.sync_loop = 0
	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_canceled = false
	--- 적중한 목록 리셋
	self.hit_targets:Clear()

	self:change_state(self.state.charge)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	self.is_canceled = true

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 어떤 이유로든 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_canceled then return end

	if CS.Oak.BattleActionTargetTypeExtensions.Contains(info.Type, CS.Oak.BattleActionTargetType.Position) then
		self:on_explosion(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0))

		local loop = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

		--- 첫 폭발에 screen fx를 생성
		if loop == 1 then
			--- instantiate screen fx
			battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner)
		--- 마지막 폭발 lava sfx 재생
		elseif loop == self.loop then
			battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'lava')
		end
	else
		--- 타겟 Sync
		self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		--- 방향 Sync
		self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		--- Loop Sync
		self.sync_loop = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)
		--- State Sync
		local state_name = self.state_index_map[trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 1)]
		---- Dist Sync
		self.sync_dash_dist = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 2)

		self:change_state(self.state[state_name])
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	if self.current_state and self.current_state.update then
		self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dt)
	end
end

--region charge state
function local_class:enter_charge_state(_)
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'charge')

	--- instantiate charge fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'charge', self.owner.Position, nil, self.owner.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	)
	--- play charge sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'charge')

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.7)

	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:exit_charge_state(next_state)
	if next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		self.sync_target = nil

		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 마나 회복
			self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana +
				self.cwp_max_mana_refund_scale * self.cwp_mana_cost
		end
	end
end

function local_class:update_charge_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
	self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector =
		battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 차지 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.charge_duration) then
		self:sync_attack_state()
	end
end
--endregion

--region attack state
function local_class:enter_attack_state(_)
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'attack')

	if self.sync_dash_dist > 0 then
		local speed = self.sync_dash_dist * 2 / self.dash_duration

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, nil, self.sync_dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, speed, speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'dash', self.owner.Position, self.sync_dir_vector, self.owner.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	)
end

function local_class:exit_attack_state(next_state)
	if next_state.id == self.state.none.id then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

		self.sync_target = nil

		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 남은 횟수
			local left_loop = self.loop - self.sync_loop

			if self.time_passed < self.dash_duration then
				left_loop = left_loop + 1
			end

			--- 계산된 마나 반환 비율
			local mana_refund_scale = math.min(left_loop * self.cwp_mana_refund_scale, self.cwp_max_mana_refund_scale)

			--- 마나 회복
			self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana +
				mana_refund_scale * self.cwp_mana_cost
		end
	end
end

--- Attack State의 업데이트 프레임
function local_class:update_attack_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
	self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector =
		battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- 대시가 완료된 시점에 폭발을 Sync
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_duration) then
		--- 폭발 정보
		local explosion_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.owner)

		explosion_info:AppendPosition(self.owner.Position + self.explosion_offset * self.sync_dir_vector)
		explosion_info:AppendNumber(self.sync_loop)

		--- 커맨드 생성
		local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
			self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, explosion_info
		)

		command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)

		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shortcharge')
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_duration) then
		--- 목표 반복 횟수에 도달
		if self.sync_loop == self.loop then
			--- 스테이트 리셋
			self:change_state(self.state.none)

			--- 배틀액션 비활성화
			self.cs_action.IsActive = false

			--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
			return
		end

		self:sync_attack_state()
	end
end

--endregion

--- Sync 정보를 만들어서 어택 스테이트를 Sync
function local_class:sync_attack_state()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.owner)

	--- 대상이 유효할 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.sync_target) then
		sync_info:AppendTarget(self.sync_target)

	--- 대상이 유효하지 않은 경우
	else
		--- 재탐색한 대상
		local targets, directions = battle_util.get_closest_target(
			self.cs_action, self.search_range, 1
		)

		--- 재탐색을 성공 했을 경우
		if #targets == 1 then
			--- append target
			sync_info:AppendTarget(targets[1])
			self.sync_dir_vector = directions[1]
		end
	end

	--- append target direction
	sync_info:AppendDirection(self.sync_dir_vector)
	--- append loop
	sync_info:AppendNumber(self.sync_loop + 1)
	--- append next state
	sync_info:AppendNumber(self.state.attack.id)

	local target = sync_info:GetTargetAt(0)

	if target then
		local dist = math.min(
			battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target), self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
		)

		--- appeend dash dist
		sync_info:AppendNumber(dist)
	else
		sync_info:AppendNumber(self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5)
	end

	--- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
		self.owner, self.cs_action.HandleName, sync_info)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.owner.Owner, cmd)
end

--region explosion

--- 실제 폭발 범위 내의 대상 판정
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_position)
	--- instantiate explosion fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', explosion_position)
	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = field:GetFieldObjectsInCylinder(
		explosion_position, self.explosion_radius, self.owner.Bounds.size.y
	)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			self:on_hit(target, explosion_position)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
end

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:on_hit(target, explosion_position)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier
	)
	local scale = self.hit_targets:Add(target) and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

	local normal_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(target.Bounds.center - explosion_position).normalized

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = normal_dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 불꽃의 정령 신틸라(fire_harpy) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFireHarpyBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')
	--- set emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- shake and play voice
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	local spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', spine_container.position, nil, spine_container, parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.4)

	--- set recoil
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.3, 0, 0.45, 15)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 중간에 캔슬되었을 경우
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- set animation
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration - 0.075) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	end

	--- set recoil
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration - 0.05) then
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.75, 0, 0.2, 50)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + vector_util.up)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 판정 길이
	hit_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 간격
	damage_term = nil,
	--- 길이
	length = nil,
	--- 너비
	width = nil,
	--- 높이
	height = nil,
	--- 확장에 걸리는 시간
	expand_duration = nil,
	--- 충돌체 정보
	info = nil,
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 이번 sequence 에 영향을 준 대상들
	hit_targets = {},
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	position = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param)
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 판정 길이
	self.hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')
	--- 판정 간격
	self.damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / math.floor(self.hit_duration / self.damage_term)

	--- 길이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 너비
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 높이
	self.height = 2
	--- 확장에 걸리는 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')

	self:apply_myth_option(param)

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(
		vector(self.length, self.height, self.width), self.hit_duration, self.damage_term, true
	)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info)
end

function area_state_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'Length')
end

function area_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

function area_state_class:force_cancel()
	self.forced_cancel = true
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.position)
	--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 발사 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'fire', self.position - vector_util.up, self.dir_vector)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'fire')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, self.hit_duration * 0.75)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 중간에 캔슬되었을 경우
	if self.current_time_passed < self.hit_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.1)
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number del
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 현재 프레임의 진행도
	local progress = math.min(time_passed, self.expand_duration) / self.expand_duration
	--- 현재 프레임의 판정체 크기
	self.info.Size = vector(self.length * progress, self.height, self.width)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	--- loop ifo
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 상황에 맞는 계수
		local scale = self.hit_targets[target] and self.sub_damage_scale or self.main_damage_scale

		--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
		self.action:apply_damage(target, scale)

		--- 영향을 준 타겟 체크
		self.hit_targets[target] = true
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- check unset darken timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.4) then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- 판정 시간이 끝났을때
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_duration) then
		self.action.area_state_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	self:apply_myth_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	self.is_active_myth_option = true
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.area_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_state_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 캔슬
	self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_state_machine then self.area_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	if not self.is_active_myth_option then
		local isMechaCostume = self.owner.Costume and self.owner.Costume.CostumeSpec.Id == 170032
		if isMechaCostume then
			damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_simple('02_hit_fire_01')
		else
			damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)
		end
	else
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit_myth')
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 바리 2차 (flower_girl2) 전용 무기 기술
--region state
local local_class = newclass('CwpFlowerGirl2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
    local obj = {}
    obj.state = state or nil
    obj.local_class = parent_class
    setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
    return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
    local prev_state = self.state

    if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
        prev_state:exit(new_state)
    end

    self.state = new_state

    if self.state then
        if self.state.current_time_passed then
            self.state.current_time_passed = 0
        end

        if self.state.enter then
            self.state:enter(prev_state)
        end
    end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
    if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
        return
    end

    local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
    self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

    if self.state.update then
        self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
    end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
    return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
    --- enter state
    enter = nil,
    --- exit state
    exit = nil,
    --- update state
    update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
    local obj = {}
    setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
    return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
    --- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
    machine = nil,
    --- 상위 클래스
    action = nil,
    --- 오너
    owner = nil,
    --- CS 클래스
    cs_action = nil,

    --- 탐색 범위
    search_range = nil,
    --- 액션 길이
    action_duration = nil,

    --- 현재 지나간 시간
    current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
    local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
    obj.action = parent_class
    obj.owner = parent_class.owner
    obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
    obj:init(param, level)

    return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
    --- 탐색 범위
    self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
    --- 액션 길이
    self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

    --- 투사체 사출 오프셋
    self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')
    --- cs projectile shooter
    self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
    --- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
    self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

    --- 투사체 발사 타이밍
    self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
    --- 투사체 생성 위치에 대한 오프셋 (발사 방향으로 거리)
    self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

    --- 적중 가능한 거리
    self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

    self.fx_height = vector(0, 2.4, 0)

    --- 전용 무기 여부 판단
    self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
    return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
    return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
    return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
    --- attackrange 기준으로 대상과 적중이 가능한지 판단한다.
    local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
    return target_dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
    self.force_cancel = false
    self.trigger_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
    --- 목표
    self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
    --- 목표 방향
    self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
    --- 배틀액션 활성화
    self.cs_action.IsActive = true

    battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

    --- 캐스팅 애니메이션 선택
    local anim_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'fallback'
    battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)
    --- 스크린 이펙트 생성
    battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

    local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

    battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, nil, nil, nil)
    battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

    local dir_4way = vector_util.to_4way_vector(self.dir_vector)

    battle_util.instantiate_effect(
        self.action, 'fire', character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.fx_height,
        dir_4way,
    spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
    )

    --- 보이스 출력
    battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
    --- camera darken
    battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.1)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
    --- 배틀액션 비활성화
    self.cs_action.IsActive = false

    character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
    ---character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

    --- remove animation
    battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
    --- remove locked dir
    battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)


    --- 발사전 캔슬 된 경우 암전 해제
    if self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
        battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
    end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
    --- 발사 전 까지 방향 갱신
    if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
        self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
    end

    --- 투사체 발사
    if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
        local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset

        --- 카메라 쉐이크
        battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)

        local shoot_position = self.trigger_pos + self.dir_vector * self.offset
        --- shoot projectile
        shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
            self.shoot_helper[1],
            shoot_position,
            self.dir_vector
        )

        battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')
    end

        --- 액션이 끝난 상황
    if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
        --- state reset
        self.machine:change(nil)

        --- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
        message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
    end
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
    --- 자연 소멸이거나 충돌로 인한 소멸일 경우
    if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate then return true end

    --- 싱크 정보 생성
    local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

    --- 위치 싱크
    trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)

    --- 싱크 정보 배포
    command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
    return true
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
    --- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
    machine = nil,
    --- 상위 클래스
    action = nil,
    --- 오너
    owner = nil,
    --- CS 클래스
    cs_action = nil,

    --- damage type
    damage_type = nil,
    --- atk modifier
    atk_modifier = nil,
    --- 데미지 배율
    main_damage_scale = nil,
    sub_damage_scale = nil,

    --- 상태이상 정보
    ailment_info = nil,

    --- 판정 계산기
    calculator = nil,
    --- 판정 타이밍
    hit_timing = nil,
    --- 판정 횟수
    max_hit = nil,

    --- 현재 지나간 시간
    current_time_passed = 0,
    --- 대상 위치
    target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
    local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
    obj.action = parent_class
    obj.owner = parent_class.owner
    obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
    obj:init(param, level)

    return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
    --- damage type
    self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
    --- atk modifier
    local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
    local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
    self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
    --- 상태 이상 정보
    self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

    --- 반지름
    local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
    --- 높이
    local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')
    --- 판정 정보
    local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(
        radius, nil, nil
    )
    --- 판정 계산기
    self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

    --- 판정 타이밍
    self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
    --- 판정 횟수
    self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

    --- 첫타 메인 계수
    self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
    --- 서브 계수
    self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
    --- 대상 위치 가져오기
    self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info))
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
    --- 충돌체 계산은 시작시 한번만 세팅. 업데이트중 세팅할 필요 없음.
    area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

    --- 바람 소용돌이 구체 연출
    battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
    battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
    battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
    --- 판정 처리
    for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
        if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
            local is_first_hit = idx == 1
            local is_last_hit = idx == self.max_hit

            --- 데미지 배율 획득
            local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

            --- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
            area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

            --- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
            for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
                self:apply_damage(target, modifier, is_last_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale)
            end

            --- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
            area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

            --- 막타 판정인 경우 아래꺼 사용
            if not is_last_hit then
                battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.28, 0.15)
            else
                battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)
                self.machine:change(nil)
            end
        end
    end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
    --- 데미지 정보 생성
    local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
    damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
    damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
    damage_info.sender = self.owner
    damage_info.target = target
    damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

    damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

    damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
    damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

    damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

    --- 데미지 커맨드 발행
    command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
    self.cs_action = cs_action
    self.owner = c
    self.level = level

    --- parsing each info
    self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

    --- 액션 스테이트
    self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
    --- 액션 스테이트용 머신 추가
    self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
    --- 스테이트 머신 지정
    self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

    --- 판정 상태
    self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
    --- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
    self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
    --- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
    self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
    --region state 해지
    do
        self.state_machine:change(nil)
        self.state_machine = nil

        battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

        self.action_state = nil
    end
    --endregion

    --region json 기반 정보들 해지
    do
        battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

        self.animation_info = nil
        self.emotion_info = nil
        self.preset_info = nil
        self.sfx_info = nil
    end
    --endregion

    --- 해제
    self.cs_action = nil
    self.owner = nil
    self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
    return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
    --- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
    return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
    return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
    return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
    return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
    --- 트리거 정보 구성
    local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

    --- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
    local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

    --- 대상이 존재할 경우
    if target then
        trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
    end

    --- append direction
    trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

    --- 트리거 커맨드 발행
    command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

    return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
    self.action_state:start(info)
    self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
    if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

    --- state reset
    self.state_machine:change(nil)

    --- publish cancel event
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
    if self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

    self.field_state:sync(info)
    self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
    --- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
    self.action_state.force_cancel = true
    battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

    --- 판정 스테이트 초기화
    self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
    if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
    if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
    return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
    --- projectile state가 유효할때만 처리
    if not self.action_state then return false end

    return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end
--endregion

return {
    create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
        return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
    end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 꽃집 아가씨 바리 1차 (flower_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFlowerGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 텀
	self.shoot_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTerm')
	self.fire_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FireTiming')

	--- 총 발사 개수
	self.limit_shoot = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LimitShoot')

	local max_hit = self.limit_shoot

	--- 대미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (max_hit - 1)

	--- 투사체 폭발 범위
	local radius = projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 중돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 전용무기 착용중인가.
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	self:apply_option(param, level)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param, level)
	--- 옵션 아이디
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 적용 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 적용시
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 캔슬시 쿨타임 반환 계수
		self.cwp_mana_refund_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ManaRefundScale')

		--- 최대 쿨타임 반환 계수
		self.cwp_max_mana_refund_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'MaxManaRefundScale')

		--- 현재 액션의 마나 코스트 캐싱
		self.cwp_mana_cost = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ManaCostBase') -
			cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ManaCostAdd') * level
	end
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	self.remain_proj_count = self.limit_shoot

	--- 액션 시작 시 cast 애니메이션 재생
	if true == self:is_animkey_exist('cast') then
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	else
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'castbackup')
	end

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		character_util.get_position(self.owner),
		nil,
		character_util.get_transform(self.owner)
	)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	--- lock dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- 카메라 쉐이크
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.3)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- remove upper animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	--- 남은 투사체가 존재한다면 즉시 cast 이펙트 해제, 일정량의 쿨타임 반환
	if 0 < self.remain_proj_count then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx, true)
		self.cast_fx = nil

		if true == self.activate_cwp_option then
			--- 계산된 마나 반환 비율
			local mana_refund_scale = math.min(self.remain_proj_count * self.cwp_mana_refund_scale, self.cwp_max_mana_refund_scale)

			self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana = self.owner.CharacterStatsBehaviour.Mana +
				mana_refund_scale * self.cwp_mana_cost
		end
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 존재할 때
	if self.target then
		--- 대상 및 대상 방향 갱신과 함께 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 몇 번째의 투사체인지에 따라 다르게 발사해주어야 한다.
	for idx = 1, self.limit_shoot do

		local shoot_timing = self.fire_timing + self.shoot_term * (idx - 1)

		--- 발사 이전 애니메이션 재생 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, shoot_timing - self.anim_term) then
			if true == self:is_animkey_exist('cwp') then
				battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cwp')
			else
				battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cwpbackup')
			end
		end

		--- 발사 타이밍
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, shoot_timing) then
			local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			--- 사출 위치 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- 사출 방향 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

			--- 커맨드 배포
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
	--- state reset
	self.machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 인자로 들어온 애니메이션 키가 적절한지의 여부 반환.
function action_state_class:is_animkey_exist(key)
	return self.is_exclusive_weapon
		and spine_util.has_animation(self.owner, self.action.animation_info[key].name, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info)

	local hit_pos = hit_info.position

	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], hit_pos)

	--- 판정 위치 세팅
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, hit_pos)
	--- 판정 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	--- 판정 체크
	local fo_list = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- loop ifo
	for _, target in pairs(fo_list) do repeat
		if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			break
		end

		--- 한번 때린애는 sub scale 로 계산한다.
		local scale = self.hit_targets[target] and self.sub_damage_scale or self.main_damage_scale
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 처리
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, hit_pos, scale)

		--- 영향을 준 타겟 체크
		self.hit_targets[target] = true
	until true end

	return true
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(t, m, hit_pos, scale)
	--- 대상으로의 방향
	local damage_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(t.Position - hit_pos).normalized

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type | CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m * scale

	--- 스턴 정보
	damage_info.stun_factor = projectile_spec_util.get_stun_factor(self.proj_spec[1])
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 넉백 정보
	damage_info.knock_back_factor = projectile_spec_util.get_knock_back_factor(self.proj_spec[1])
	damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force
	damage_info.knock_back_dir = damage_dir

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 남은 투사체 개수를 1개 까준다.
	self.remain_proj_count = self.remain_proj_count - 1

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, dir_vector)
end
--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 액션이 유효할 경우에만 호출
	if not self.action_state then
		return
	end

	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 액션이 유효할 경우에만 호출
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
