--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 숲의 파수꾼 에스텔 (forest_elf) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpForestElfBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = 0,
	--- 대시 속도
	dash_speed = 0,
	--- 대시 지속시간
	dash_duration = 0,

	--- 투사체 shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- 투사체 helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- 투사체 스펙
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = 0,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 투사체 최대거리
	local proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- hitabble distance
	self.hittable_dist = proj_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- reset force cancel flag
	self.force_cancel = false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 발사, 타겟 포지션
	local shoot_pos, target_pos = self:get_shoot_target_pos()

	--- 점프로 인한 y 축 보정을 위해 발사 이펙트 생성 포지션을 따로 잡아줘서 direction 을 정해야 한다.
	local shoot_fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		+ spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).localPosition.y * vector_util.forward

	--- instantiate cast fx
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		shoot_pos,
		(target_pos - shoot_fx_pos).normalized,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
		parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- cwp voice
	battle_util.play_voice_in_args(
		self.cs_action,
		1,
		character_voice_type.skill_1,
		character_voice_type.skill_2
	)

	--- cast sound
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- cast 해제
	if self.cast_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil
	end

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	--- 백대쉬를 했으니 보던 방향으로 돌려줌
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

function action_state_class:get_shoot_target_pos()

	--- 발사 포지션
	local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		+ spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).localPosition.y * vector_util.up

	--- 타겟 포지션. 타겟이 없다면 투사체 최대 거리를 기반으로 계산
	local target_pos = self.target and bounds_util.get_center(self.target) or
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	return shoot_pos, target_pos
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 대시 직전 타겟, 방향 고정
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 발사, 타겟 포지션
		local shoot_pos, target_pos = self:get_shoot_target_pos()

		--- 점프로 인한 y 축 보정을 위해 발사 이펙트 생성 포지션을 따로 잡아줘서 direction 을 정해야 한다.
		local shoot_fx_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
			+ spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).localPosition.y * vector_util.forward

		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, shoot_pos, (target_pos - shoot_fx_pos).normalized)
	end

	--- 발사 타이밍에 투사체 발사
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then

		--- cast 해제
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
		self.cast_fx = nil

		--- 발사 애니메이션
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)

		--- 발사, 타겟 포지션
		local shoot_pos, target_pos = self:get_shoot_target_pos()

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)
		--- 발사 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, target_pos)
		--- 발사 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, (target_pos - shoot_pos).normalized)

		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 역대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			nil,
			-self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝날 때까지 aim point 세팅
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		spine_util.set_aim_point(
			self.owner,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector,
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
		)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 싱크를 통한 무기기술 투사체 발사
function action_state_class:sync(info)

	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 투사체의 발사 vfx, sfx 생성
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, dir_vector)

	--- 투사체 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[1],
		shoot_pos,
		dir_vector,
		nil,
		nil,
		nil,
		true,
		nil,
		target_pos
	)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- 자연 소멸이거나 충돌로 인한 소멸일 경우
	if hit_info.hit_type == projectile_hit_type.force_eliminate then
		return true
	end

	--- 싱크 정보 생성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 위치 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(hit_info.position))

	--- 싱크 정보 배포
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	return true
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍
	last_hit_timing = nil,

	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- damage scale
	damage_scale = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍
	self.last_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[self.max_hit]

	--- 최소 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 판정 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true
	)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- damage scale
	self.damage_scale = 1 / self.max_hit
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 목표 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

	--- explosion sound
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.25)

	--- 판정 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < 0.1 then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- field state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.17)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, 1 / self.max_hit)
		end

	until true end

	--- 판정이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.last_hit_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	--- 넉백 추가
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 피격시 sfx 정보 생성
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- field 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.field_state)

		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 원거리 기반 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_proj(
		self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range, false, true
	)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.action_state or self.action_state.force_cancel then
		return
	end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		self.action_state:sync(info)
	else
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.action_state then
		return
	end

	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 장판 스테이트머신 리셋
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- projectile state가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then
		return true
	end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 「천년을 넘게 산 마법사」 프리렌 (frieren) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFrierenBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region 공통 인자

--- 투사체 유형
local projectile_type = {
	first = 1,
	proj = 2,
	field = 3
}

--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 사출 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 사출 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,

	--- 사출 횟수
	shoot_count = nil,
	--- main damage scale
	main_damage_scale = nil,

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- fallback anim keys
	fallback_keys = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 사출 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')
	--- 사출 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootOffset')
	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 사출 횟수
	self.shoot_count = #self.shoot_timing

	--- main damage scale
	local main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- each main damage scale
	self.main_damage_scale = main_damage_scale / self.shoot_count

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.shoot_offset + projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
	--- fallback anim keys
	self.fallback_keys = {}
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	-- 강제 캔슬 플래그 off
	self.force_cancel = false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	self:set_anim('cast')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 오너의 센터 위치
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- ik 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	-- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self:calculate_effect_pos())
	--- 캐스팅 효과음 출력
	self.cast_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.2)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- 보이스 출력
		battle_util.play_voice_in_args(self.cs_action, 1, character_voice_type.skill_2, character_voice_type.special_3)
	else
		--- 보이스 출력
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove animation
	self:remove_anim()
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	-- 캐스팅 이펙트 해제
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.cast_fx)
	self.cast_fx = nil
	-- 본 해제
	self.weapon_bone = nil

	-- 캐스팅 효과음 할당이 남아있다면 fade_out
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.cast_sfx_holder, 0.5)
	self.cast_sfx_holder = nil

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	-- 방향 갱신
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 오너의 센터 위치
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- ik 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner, center + self.dir_vector, center)

	-- 이펙트 갱신
	if self.cast_fx then
		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx, self:calculate_effect_pos())
	end

	-- 사출 타이밍 순회
	for idx = 1, self.shoot_count do repeat
		-- 타이밍 성립 체크
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 투사체 유형
		local proj_type = projectile_type.proj

		-- 초회 처리
		if idx == 1 then
			--- set animation
			self:set_anim('attack')
			-- 초회 처리
			proj_type = projectile_type.first

		-- 마지막은 장판이 동반됨
		elseif idx == self.shoot_count then
			-- 캐스팅 효과음이 fade_out되지 않도록 할당 해제 함
			self.cast_sfx_holder = nil
			-- 마지막 처리
			proj_type = projectile_type.field
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		-- 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, center)
		-- 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)
		-- 투사체 유형 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, proj_type)
		-- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

	until true end

	-- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system_util.publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:set_anim(key)
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)
		return
	end

	local fallback_key = self.fallback_keys[key]
	if not fallback_key then
		fallback_key = key .. 'fallback'
		self.fallback_keys[key] = fallback_key
	end

	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, fallback_key)
end

function action_state_class:remove_anim()
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
		return
	end

	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action, 0.1)
end

function action_state_class:calculate_effect_pos()
	-- 전용 무기가 아닌 경우는 그냥 바로 앞에 생성되도록 한다.
	if not self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		return bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.5
	end

	if not self.weapon_bone or character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner) ~= self.prev_look_dir then
		self.prev_look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
		-- 본 가져옴
		self.weapon_bone = spine_util.get_slot(self.owner, '[base]weapon1').Bone
	end

	--- 보는 방향에 따른 회전 각 계산
	local euler_y = self.prev_look_dir == direction_util.left and
		-- left의 경우 flip되어있기 때문에 이를 감안하여 책정한다.
		self.weapon_bone.WorldRotationX - 45 or
		self.weapon_bone.WorldRotationX + 45

	-- 이펙트 생성 위치, 방향 계산
	local bone_rot = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -euler_y, 0) * vector_util.right
	local init_pos = CS.Oak.UnityObjectPoolExtensions.GetSpineEffectPosition(self.weapon_bone, self.owner)

	local offset = 1

	return init_pos + offset * bone_rot
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 사출 위치
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 투사체 유형
	local proj_type = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info)

	if proj_type == projectile_type.first then
		--- 스크린 이펙트 출력
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 카메라 흔들기
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
	end

	--- shoot projectile
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[proj_type],
		target_pos + dir_vector * self.shoot_offset,
		dir_vector,
		proj_type
	)
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 대상 캐시
	local target = hit_info.target

	-- 대상 공격 가능 여부 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
		--- 대미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		--- 투사체 히트는 메인 스케일로 적용한다.
		self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)
	end

	-- 투사체 만료 시 쉐이킹
	if label ~= projectile_type.field and hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)
	end

	-- 관통형 투사체니 만료하지 않는다.
	return false
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)

	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 폭
	width = nil,
	--- 시작 크기
	base_length = nil,
	--- 최대 크기
	max_length = nil,
	--- 증가할 크기
	expand_length = nil,
	--- 높이
	height = nil,

	--- 딜레이 시간
	hit_delay = nil,
	--- 확장 시간
	expand_duration = nil,
	--- 축소 타이밍
	reduce_timing = nil,
	--- 축소 시간
	reduce_duration = nil,

	--- 판정 정보
	collision_info = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- sub damage scale
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 이 상태가 끝나는 타이밍
	state_end_timing = nil,

	--- 폭발 타이밍
	explosion_timings = nil,
	--- 시작접으로부터 폭발 발생 거리
	explosion_offsets = nil,
	--- 폭발 사운드 키
	explosion_sfx_keys = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 폭
	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 시작 크기
	self.base_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseLength')
	--- 최대 크기
	self.max_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')
	--- 증가할 크기
	self.expand_length = self.max_length - self.base_length
	--- 높이
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 딜레이 시간
	self.hit_delay = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDelay')
	--- 확장 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')
	--- 축소 타이밍
	self.reduce_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceTiming')
	--- 축소 시간
	self.reduce_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ReduceDuration')
	--- 판정 지속 시간
	local attack_time = self.reduce_timing + self.reduce_duration
	--- 총 지속 시간
	self.state_end_timing = self.hit_delay + attack_time

	--- 판정 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- max_hit
	local max_hit = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxHit')

	--- 판정 크기
	local size = vector(self.max_length, self.height, self.width)
	--- 판정 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(size, attack_time, damage_term, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, true, 0, max_hit)

	--- main damage scale
	local main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- sub damage scale
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - main_damage_scale) / max_hit

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성 위치 설정
	local explosion_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionCount')
	local target_index = math.max(explosion_count - 1, 0)
	local begin_offset = self.width * 0.5
	local total = self.max_length - self.width
	local offset_step = total / target_index
	local time_step = self.expand_duration / explosion_count

	self.explosion_timings = {}
	self.explosion_offsets = {}
	self.explosion_sfx_keys = {}
	for idx = 0, target_index do
		table.insert(self.explosion_timings, self.hit_delay + time_step * idx)
		table.insert(self.explosion_offsets, begin_offset + offset_step * idx)
		table.insert(self.explosion_sfx_keys, 'explosion' .. (idx + 1))
	end
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 설치 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 판정 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_delay) then
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 연출
	for idx = 1, #self.explosion_timings do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_timings[idx]) then
			local forward = self.dir_vector * self.explosion_offsets[idx]
			local downward = vector_util.down * self.height * 0.5
			local fx_pos = self.target_pos + forward + downward
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', fx_pos, self.dir_vector)
			battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, self.explosion_sfx_keys[idx], fx_pos)
			local shake_duration = idx == #self.explosion_timings and 0.3 or 0.1
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, shake_duration)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 동작 중 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 딜레이를 제외한 현재 프레임의 time_passed
		local attack_time_passed = time_passed - self.hit_delay

		--- 진행도 계산
		local expand_progress = math.min(attack_time_passed / self.expand_duration, 1)
		local reduce_progress = math.min(math.max((attack_time_passed - self.reduce_timing), 0) / self.reduce_duration, 1)

		--- 거리 계산
		local expend_dist = self.base_length + self.expand_length * expand_progress
		local reduce_dist = self.max_length * reduce_progress

		--- 충돌체 계산기 갱신
		local calc_pos = self.target_pos + reduce_dist * self.dir_vector
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, calc_pos)
		self.collision_info.Size = vector(expend_dist - reduce_dist, self.height, self.width)

		--- 데미지 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
		for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)) do
			--- 폭발은 서브 스케일로 적용한다.
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 처리 완료했으면 상태를 이탈한다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_end_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)

	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	-- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)
	-- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end
	-- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)
	-- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	-- 시전중이 아니었다면 생략한다.
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end
	-- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	-- publish cancel event
	message_system_util.publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	-- 강제 취소된 이후면 처리하지 않도록 함
	if not self.action_state or self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	-- 일단 action_state는 싱크를 진행하고 본다.
	self.action_state:sync(info)

	-- 장판 유형 투사체인 경우엔 field_state도 싱크한다.
	if trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info) == projectile_type.field then
		self.field_state:sync(info)
		self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	-- 이미 해제된 이후엔 처리할 필요가 없다.
	if not self.action_state then return end
	-- 강제 캔슬 플래그 on
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true
	-- field_machine 초기화
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 미래 기사(future_knight) 양손검 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpFutureKnight2BattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)

	return obj
end

	--- set locked direction

	--- set animation
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		--- set time scale
		self.action.animation_info['action'].timescale = 0

		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(

	)
	--- 캐스팅 사운드 재생

		--- 위치 정보 추가

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = 1 - self.main_damage_scale

	--- 확장 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')
	--- 확장 시간 이후 폭발까지 지연 시간
	local delay_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DelayDuration')
	--- 폭발 타이밍
	self.explosion_timing = self.expand_duration + delay_duration

	--- 짧은 변
	self.short_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShortBase')
	--- 긴 변
	self.long_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LongBase')
	--- 최대 높이
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MaxLength')

	--- 사다리꼴 벡터
	local points = {
		0, self.short_base * 0.5,
		self.length, self.long_base * 0.5,
		self.length, -self.long_base * 0.5,
		0, -self.short_base * 0.5
	}

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.info = collision_info_util.create_polygon_cube(points, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, nil, 0)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info)
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function area_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 최대 높이 기준 보정
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.length * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 바닥 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.position), self.dir_vector)

	--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.position)
	--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, self.expand_duration * 1.2)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number del
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 확장 시간 동안
	if old_time_passed < self.expand_duration then
		--- current modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 현재 프레임의 진행도
		local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.expand_duration, 1)

		--- 짧은 높이
		local short_length = 0
		--- 긴 높이
		local long_height  = progress * self.length

		--- loop ifo
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
			--- 영향을 준 타겟 체크
			if self.hit_targets[target] then
				break
			end

			--- 대상 Entity 가 공격 불가한 경우
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
				break
			end

			--- 대상 바운드
			local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(target)

			local a = vector(target_bounds.min.x, 0, target_bounds.min.z) - self.position
			local b = vector(target_bounds.min.x, 0, target_bounds.max.z) - self.position
			local c = vector(target_bounds.max.x, 0, target_bounds.max.z) - self.position
			local d = vector(target_bounds.max.x, 0, target_bounds.min.z) - self.position

			--- projection vector
			local ad = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(a, self.dir_vector))
			local bd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(b, self.dir_vector))
			local cd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(c, self.dir_vector))
			local dd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(d, self.dir_vector))

			--- 해당 프레임의 사다리꼴 형태에 판정되어야하는지 체크
			if short_length <= ad and ad <= long_height or short_length <= bd and bd <= long_height or
				short_length <= cd and cd <= long_height or short_length <= dd and dd <= long_height then
				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.main_damage_scale)

				--- 영향을 준 타겟 체크
				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			end
		until true end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		if self.expand_duration <= time_passed then
			--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 폭발 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.explosion_timing) then
		--- current modifier
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		--- 범위 내의 ifo
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

		--- loop ifo
		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, self.sub_damage_scale)
		end

		--- PooledSortedList dispose
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 폭발 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.2)

		--- 판정 스테이트 종료
		self.action.area_state_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)

	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부 & 스테이트 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.area_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_state_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 종료
	self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_state_machine then self.area_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

		battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 암전 제거
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.is_force_canceled == true then
		return
	end

	--- 방향을 가지고 있으면, 발사 시퀀스, 없으면 폭발 시퀀스
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		local dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:on_shoot_proj(pos, dir, 1)
	else
		local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self:on_explosion(pos)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	local old_time_passed = self.current_state.time_passed
	self.current_state.time_passed = self.current_state.time_passed + dt

	-- 현재 스테이트 업데이트
	self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_state.time_passed, dt)
end

--- 배틀 액션 관련 변수들 모두 해제
function local_class:dispose()
	self.cs_shooter = nil
	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.collision_calculator = nil

	self.fire_fx = nil
	self.shoot_sfx_holder = nil

	self.shoot_infos = nil

	-- 싱크된 데이터 해제
	self.locked_target = nil
	self.locked_dir = nil

	--- 스테이트 관련 해제
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	--- Json 기반 변수들 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	--- 변수 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- Cast State

function local_class:enter_cast_state(_)
	--- 애니메이션 실행
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- VFX 실행
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.character.Position, nil,
		self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character)

	--- SFX 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 화면 암전
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.65, 0.2)

	--- 카메라를 흔들어준다.
	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.2)

	--- 캐릭터를 특정 방향으로 고정시켜줌.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.locked_dir)
end

function local_class:exit_cast_state(_)

end

function local_class:update_cast_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 타겟에 시선 고정
	self.locked_target, self.locked_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.locked_target,
		self.locked_dir)

	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.character, bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.locked_dir,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	)

	--- ActionDuration이 끝나면 배틀액션을 종료시킨다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.fire)
	end
end

--- Fire State

function local_class:enter_fire_state(_)
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')
	self.shoot_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'shoot')
end

function local_class:exit_fire_state(_)
	--- 애니메이션 제거
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 발사하고 있는 Fire 이펙트 제거
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fire_fx)
	self.fire_fx = nil

	sfx_util.fade_out(self.shoot_sfx_holder, 0.1)
	self.shoot_sfx_holder = nil

	--- 캐릭터 방향 고정시키던 것 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_fire_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 타겟에 시선 고정
	self.locked_target, self.locked_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.locked_target,
		self.locked_dir)

	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.character, bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.locked_dir,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	)

	for idx = 1, #self.shoot_infos do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_infos[idx].term) then
			--- 캐릭터 반동
			--character_util.recoil_type_1(self.character, self.locked_dir, 0.03, 0.02, 0.12)
			character_util.shake(self.character, 0.075, 0.12)

			--- 프로젝타일 발사 시퀀스 생성
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

			local shoot_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, self.shoot_infos[idx].offset, 0) * self.locked_dir
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, shoot_dir)

			--- 첫 타일 때 생성, 마지막에 제거, 중간에는 위치 업데이트만
			if idx == 1 then
				local pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.shoot_offset * shoot_dir
				self.fire_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', pos, shoot_dir,
					self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform)
			elseif idx == #self.shoot_infos then
				effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fire_fx)
				self.fire_fx = nil

				--- 마지막 발에서 암전 제거
				battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.35)
			else
				local pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + self.shoot_offset * shoot_dir
				if self.fire_fx then
					effect_util.update_object(self.fire_fx, pos, shoot_dir)
				end
			end

			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end
	end

	--- ActionDuration이 끝나면 배틀액션을 종료시킨다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.fire_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일 발사 싱크 실행
function local_class:on_shoot_proj (pos, dir, label)
	local shoot_pos = pos + self.shoot_offset * dir

	--- 탄피 배출
	local random_angle = (random_util.get_random_value() - 0.5) * 10
	local bounce_dir_vector = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_angle, 0) * dir

	CS.Oak.ActionEffectHelper.RequestCartridgeBounce(pos, bounce_dir_vector, self.preset_info['cartridge'])

	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper[label], shoot_pos, dir, label)
end

--- 폭발 싱크 실행
function local_class:on_explosion(pos)
	--- 카운터 증가
	self.explosion_counter = self.explosion_counter + 1

	--- FX 실행
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', pos)

	--- 마지막 발에만 폭발 실행
	if self.explosion_counter == #self.shoot_infos then
		battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', pos)
	end

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, 0)
	local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action,
		self.attack_modifier, #self.shoot_infos)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
			self:apply_damage(target, dps)
		end
	end

	ifo_list:Dispose()
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
end

--- 프로젝타일 충돌 판정 위치
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 타겟(적 only) 히트 & 시간이 다 되서 없어질 때만
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or hit_info.target ~= nil and
		battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, hit_info.target) then
		--- 폭발 Sync
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)

		--- 충돌한 곳에 폭발 일으킴
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 실제로 데미지를 적용하는 부분
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	-- 히트 이펙트 사운드
	local hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo()
	hit_sfx_info.hitSfxName = self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = hit_sfx_info

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1 / #self.shoot_infos)

	-- 데미지 전달 커맨드 실행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

---- parsing option data
function local_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.character)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 전무 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true
			--- 공증 버프 정보
			self.atk_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'CwpBuff')
		end

	until true end
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	return self.current_state.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id
end

--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id
end

--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부

end

function local_class:trigger()

	-- 방향을 가지고 있을 경우, Projectile을 날리는 것으로 가정한다. 없을 경우에는 폭발
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		local shoot_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, shoot_dir_vector, 1)
	else
		local explosion_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		explosion_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(explosion_pos)

		self:on_explosion(explosion_pos)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	character_util.hide_weapon(self.character, false, 'cwp')

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 현 State의 Update를 부름
	func_util.call_if(self.current_state.update, self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id,
		self, old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dt)

	-- 폭발 Update
	func_util.call_if(self.update_explosion, self.explosion.is_exploded, self, dt)
end

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	-- 애니메이션 및 FX 등 실행
	local spine = self.character.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', spine.position, self.locked_dir, spine)

	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'fire')
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6, 0.2)

	-- 점프
	self.character.SpineController:Jump(self.jump_height, self.jump_duration, self.aerial_duration, false);

	--- 전무 옵션에 의한 공증 아군 뿌리기
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		self:apply_ally_buff()
	end
end
--- [3.14][리밸런싱] 무기기술 시전 즉시 아군들에게 공증 버프
function local_class:apply_ally_buff()
	--- 스테이지 멤버
	local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.character)
	--- 아군 순회하며 적용
	for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
		if character_util.is_dead(member) then break end

		buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.character, member, self.atk_buff_info)

		--- 소환수도 적용
		for _, summonee in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.character, summonee, self.atk_buff_info)
		end
	until true end
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	-- 방향 고정
	self.fire_target, self.locked_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.fire_target,
		self.locked_dir)

	-- 발사 대상이 죽기 전까지의 위치를 계속 업데이트
	if self.fire_target then
		self.fire_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.fire_target.Position)
	end

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 싱크 커맨드 제작
	func_util.call_if(self.on_fire, battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time), self)

	-- 다음 스테이트로
	func_util.call_if(self.change_state, time_passed >= self.action_duration, self, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	-- 애니메이션 및 FX 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	-- 무기 다시 나타남
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.character, false, 'cwp')

	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

-- 무기 투사체 발사를 위한 싱크 커맨드 생성
function local_class:on_fire()
	-- 던질 때는 무기를 숨긴다.
	character_util.hide_weapon(self.character, true, 'cwp')

	-- 던지는 사운드 추가
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	-- 어디에서, 어느 방향으로 쏠 것인지를 결정
	local shoot_pos = nil
	local shoot_direction = nil
	-- 타겟이 바뀌게 될 경우
	local shoot_target = nil

	shoot_pos = self.character.Position
	shoot_pos.y = shoot_pos.y + self.jump_height

	-- 타겟이 없을 때 direction을 결정
	local set_locked_shoot_dir = function()
		local target_pos = shoot_pos + self.locked_dir * projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
		shoot_direction = (battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos) - shoot_pos).normalized
	end

	-- 타겟에 쏠 수 있는지 판별
	if self.fire_target ~= nil and not shoot_helper_util.is_hittable(self.shoot_helper[1], self.fire_target) then
		set_locked_shoot_dir()
	else
		shoot_direction = (self.fire_pos - shoot_pos).normalized
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, shoot_pos)
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, shoot_direction)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)
end

-- 프로젝타일이 어딘가에 충돌하거나 했을 때
function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 어떤 이유로든 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_force_canceled then return true end

	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local sync_info = CS.Oak.BattleActionTriggerInfo.CreateDefault(self.character)

	sync_info:AppendPosition(hit_info.position)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	local cmd = CS.Oak.SyncBattleActionCommand.CreateWithInfo(
		self.character, self.cs_action.HandleName, sync_info)

	command_util.publish_cmd(self.character.Owner, cmd)

	return true
end

-- 실제 데미지 처리
function local_class:on_damage(target, modifier, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, 1 / self.collision_calculator.MaxNumHits)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.2)
end

-- 프로젝타일이 터져서, 폭발 생성
function local_class:on_explosion(explosion_pos)
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	-- 폭발 초기화
	self.explosion.is_exploded = true
	self.explosion.time_passed = 0

	-- 폭발 FX 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', explosion_pos)
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'explosion')

	stage_camera:Shake(0.65, 0.1)

	-- 폭발 판정 업데이트
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, explosion_pos)
end

-- 폭발 중의 로직 처리
function local_class:update_explosion(dt)
	--- 지난 프레임
	local old_time_passed = self.explosion.time_passed
	self.explosion.time_passed = self.explosion.time_passed + dt

	--- 최대 판정
	local max_hits = self.collision_calculator.MaxNumHits

	for index = 0, max_hits - 1 do
		--- 판정 타이밍
		local timing = self.explosion_damage_term * index

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, self.explosion.time_passed, timing) then
			--- 폭발 범위 확장
			local radius = CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear(
				timing, self.explosion_min_radius, self.explosion_max_radius,
				(max_hits - 1) * self.explosion_damage_term
			)

			radius = unity_class.mathf.Clamp(radius, self.explosion_min_radius, self.explosion_max_radius)

			self.collision_info.Radius = radius

			area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

			--- 폭발 데미지 처리
			if not self.is_force_canceled then
				local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
					self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier, max_hits
				)

				for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
					if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
						local dir = (target.Position - self.character.Position).normalized
						self:on_damage(target, modifier, dir)
					end
				end

				ifo_list:Dispose()
			end

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)
		end
	end

	-- 폭발 종료
	func_util.call_if(self.end_explosion, self.explosion.time_passed > self.explosion_duration, self)
end

function local_class:end_explosion()
	self.explosion.is_exploded = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--변수 해제
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.fire_target = nil
	self.fire_pos = nil

	self.explosion = nil
	self.collision_calculator = nil
	self.collision_info = nil

	self.shoot_helper = nil
	self.proj_spec = nil
	self.cs_shooter = nil

	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
