--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 가람 2차 (garam2) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpGaram2BattleAction')

--region state
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 단일 적중시 피해 배율
	single_hit_scale = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그
	force_cancel = false,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 데미지 정보
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.damage_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 직격 대상/폭발 범위내 대상 피해 배율
	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainScale')
	self.sub_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')

	--- 확산탄 후 재탐색 거리
	self.spread_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SpreadRange')
	self.spread_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'SpreadCount')
	--- 폭발 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	self.attack_anim_timing = self.shoot_timing - 0.1

	--- 투사체	1번만 사용
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

	--- 확산 판정
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.spread_range, height, nil, nil, nil, nil)
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	local explosion_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_sphere(self.radius)
	self.explosion_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, explosion_collision_info)

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	self.main_label = -1

	self.hit_target_table = {}

	self:apply_option(param)

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_table_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- loop option id
	for index = 1, #option_id do repeat
		--- 옵션 유효성 확인
		local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id[index], self.owner)

		--- 옵션이 활성화 여부 확인
		if activate_option == false then break end

		--- 특수 능력 여부 확인
		local is_special = cs_util.get_bool_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IsSpecial')

		if is_special then
			--- 특수 능력 발동 여부
			self.activate_special_option = true
		else
			--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
			self.activate_cwp_option = true

			--- 메뉴얼 객체가 아니고 파티 리더가 아닌 경우 (계수 보정 해줘야함)
			if not CS.Oak.LuaBattleExtensions.CheckDefaultSuperActionCondition(self.owner) then
				--- 공격력 계수 스케일
				local modifier_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'ModifierScale')
				--- 공격력 계수 갱신
				self.damage_modifier = self.damage_modifier * modifier_scale

				--- 상태 이상 스케일
				local ailment_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'AilmentScale')
				--- 상태 이상 게이지 갱신
				self.ailment_info.AilmentGauge = self.ailment_info.AilmentGauge * ailment_scale
			end

			self.single_hit_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'SingleHitMultiplier')
		end

	until true end
end

function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return self.shoot_helper == nil or battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 항상 캔슬 가능
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지의 거리
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 초기화
	self.force_cancel = false

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local anim_key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'fallback'

	--- 캐스트 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, anim_key)

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 연출 처리
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 공격 시점 이전에 캔슬되었을때
	if self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

function action_state_class:reset_hit_targets()
	for target, _ in pairs(self.hit_target_table) do
		self.hit_target_table[target] = false
	end
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 전무 일때만 같은 애니메이션을 조금 빠르게 이어서 재생
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_anim_timing) then
		if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
		end
	end

	--- 공격 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 투사체 발사 효과 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 최초 주 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, self.main_label)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	local shoot_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local shoot_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	--- 발사 사운드 재생
	---projectile_spec_util.play_shoot_sfx(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 투사체 발사
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, shoot_dir, 2, nil, nil, false)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')
end

function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 대상 캐시
	local hit_target = hit_info.target

	--- 대상을 공격 여부 체크
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_target) == false then return false end

	local is_main = label == self.main_label

	--- 메인 투사체의 최초 적중이면 히트 타겟 리셋
	if is_main then self:reset_hit_targets() end

	if self.hit_target_table[hit_target] then return false end

	self.hit_target_table[hit_target] = true

	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.damage_modifier)
	local scale = is_main and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale
	local fx_key = is_main and 'explosion_main' or (hit_info.direction.x > 0 and 'explosion_sub' or 'explosion_sub_rev')
	local hit_scale = 1
	local shake_scale = 1
	local sub_proj_count = 0

	--- 주 투사체만 확산 처리
	if is_main then
		--- 발사 위치 (적의 위치에서 발사)
		local shoot_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(hit_target), hit_info.position.y)

		--- 재탐색 대상
		local targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, shoot_pos)

		--- 범위내 내상이 있으면 확산 처리
		if #targets > 0 then
			--- ifo 순회
			for _, target in pairs(targets) do
				if sub_proj_count >= 3 then break end

				repeat
					--- 같은 대상은 제외
					if lua_helper.reference_equals(target, hit_target) then break end

					--- 계산된 대상 방향
					local shoot_dir = vector_util.normalized(character_util.get_position(target) - shoot_pos)

					--- 새로운 대상이 있다면
					if shoot_dir then
						--- 싱크 정보 생성
						local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
						--- 새로운 발사 위치
						trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, shoot_pos)
						--- 새로운 발사 방향
						trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, shoot_dir)

						--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
						command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

						sub_proj_count = sub_proj_count + 1
					end

				until true
			end
		end

		-- 단일 대상 적중시에는 별도 처리를 진행한다.
		if self.activate_cwp_option and sub_proj_count <= 0 then
			hit_scale = self.single_hit_scale
			shake_scale = 1.2
			fx_key = 'explosion_main_single'
		end
	end

	local explosion_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.explosion_calculator, hit_info.position)

	--- 범위내 내상이 있으면 확산 처리
	if #explosion_targets > 0 then
		--- ifo 순회
		for _, target in pairs(explosion_targets) do
			--- 주 대상이면 main 배율, 폭발 범위내 다른 대상이면 sub 배율
			local damage_scale = lua_helper.reference_equals(target, hit_target) and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale

			--- 단독 적중이면 hit_scale이 1.5배 들어옴
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier * hit_scale, damage_scale)
		end
	end

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, fx_key, hit_info.position, hit_info.direction)

	local magnitude = is_main and 0.2 or 0.05
	local duration = is_main and 0.14 or 0.15
	if is_main then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.25)
	end

	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, magnitude, duration)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	return true
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil

	self.owner = nil

end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지

	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	--- 판정 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보

--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

function local_class:start(info)
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self.locked_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	self.locked_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(self.locked_dir)

	-- 타겟은 처음에 정함
	self.fire_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)

	self.time_passed = 0

	-- 이미 생성된 경우 해제하고 초기화 시켜줌
	func_util.call_if(self.destroy_proj, self.proj ~= nil, self, true)
	table_util.each_pair(function(key) self.hit_target_table[key] = nil end, self.hit_target_table)
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.aoe_collision_calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.aoe_collision_calculator)
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if trigger_info_util.contains_direction(info) then
		trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		self.fire_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_position(info) then
		trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.fire_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	end

	self:fire_proj()
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	self.destroy_proj(self, true)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.time_passed
	self.time_passed = self.time_passed + dt

	-- 배틀액션 업데이트
	func_util.call_if(self.update_action_state, self.current_state.id == self.state.action.id and self
		.cs_action.IsActive == true, self, old_time_passed, self.time_passed, dt)

	-- 프로젝타일 업데이트 (프로젝타일 이펙트 기준으로)
	func_util.call_if(self.update_proj, self.proj ~= nil and self.proj.fx ~= nil, self, dt)

	-- 장판 업데이트 (장판 데미지 충돌 판정기 시작 여부에 따라)
	func_util.call_if(self.update_aoe, area_collision_util.is_started(self.aoe_collision_calculator), self, dt)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	-- state 해제
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	self.fire_dir = nil
	self.fire_pos = nil
	self.fire_target = nil
	self.locked_dir = nil

	self.hit_target_table = nil
	self.proj = nil

	self.aoe_collision_info = nil
	self.aoe_collision_calculator = nil

	-- Json 기반 변수들 해제
	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	--변수 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
	self.params_dict = nil
end

-- 스킬 캐스팅

function local_class:enter_action_state()
	-- 이펙트 및 사운드 재생
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.character.Position, nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, self.target_darken, 0.2)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_direction(self.locked_dir))
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	self.fire_target, self.locked_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.fire_target,
		self.locked_dir)

	-- state 끝
	func_util.call_if(self.change_state,
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration), self, self.state.none)

	-- 천둥새 발사 애니메이션 실행
	func_util.call_if(battle_util.set_anim, battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time
		- 0.066), self, self.cs_action, 'fire')
	func_util.call_if(battle_util.set_emotion,
		battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time - 0.066), self,
		self.cs_action, 'fire')

	-- 천둥새 발사
	func_util.call_if(self.on_fire, battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time), self)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state()
	-- 방향 제거 및 화면 밝기 조정
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.8)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.character)
	-- 애니메이션은 데이터로 일정 시간 지난 후에 제거

	-- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

--- 발사 싱크 담당
function local_class:on_fire()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	self.fire_target, self.fire_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.fire_target,
		self.locked_dir)

	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.fire_dir)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)
end

--- 발사체 처리, 장판도 일부 처리
function local_class:fire_proj()
	-- 이펙트 및 애니메이션 처리
	character_util.recoil_type_1(self.character, self.locked_dir, 0.2, 0.1, 0.3)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', self.fire_pos, self.fire_dir)
	--- 활을 놨다가 생기는 반동에 의한 카메라 쉐이크
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.35, 0.2)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	-- 발사체 생성
	self.proj = {
		time_passed = 0,
		fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.fire_pos), self.fire_dir),
		trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'trail', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.fire_pos), self.fire_dir)
	}

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'aoe', battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.fire_pos), self.fire_dir)
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character)

	-- 장판 판정 시작
	self:start_aoe()
end

function local_class:update_proj(dt)
	-- 프로젝타일FX & 프로젝타일 충돌 위치 처리
	self.proj.fx.transform.position = self.proj.fx.transform.position + self.fire_dir * self.proj_speed * dt
	self.proj.trail.transform.position = self.proj.fx.transform.position

	-- 프로젝타일 제거 처리
	func_util.call_if(self.destroy_proj, self.proj.time_passed > self.proj_life_time, self, false)

	self.proj.time_passed = self.proj.time_passed + dt
end

function local_class:destroy_proj(destroy_all)
	-- 발사체만 제거, destroy_all이 true면 모든 데이터 제거
	-- 발사체가 제거된 후에도 이 정보가 쓰일 수 있기 때문에, 정보를 완전히 제거하는 것은 aoe 판정이 끝나고 해제해준다.
	if self.proj ~= nil then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.fx)
		self.proj.fx = nil

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.trail)
		self.proj.trail = nil

		if destroy_all then
			self.proj = nil
		end
	end
end

-- 장판 데미지 관련
function local_class:start_aoe()
	self.aoe_time_passed = 0

	-- 장판 충돌체 업데이트
	local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.character)
	center.y = self.character.Position.y + self.aoe_height * 0.5
	self.aoe_collision_info.Center = center
	self.aoe_collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.proj_size * 0.5, self.aoe_height, self.aoe_width)
	self.aoe_collision_info.Direction = self.fire_dir

	area_collision_util.start(self.aoe_collision_calculator)
end

function local_class:update_aoe(dt)
	-- 장판 충돌 크기 증가 처리
	if self.proj ~= nil and self.proj.fx ~= nil and self.aoe_time_passed < self.proj_life_time then
		local dist = vector_util.distance(self.proj.fx.transform.position,
			self.aoe_collision_info.Center) + self.proj_size * 0.5
		self.aoe_collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(dist, self.aoe_height, self.aoe_width)
	end

	-- 장판 충돌 크기 감소 처리
	if self.aoe_time_passed > self.aoe_shrink_time then
		local current_size = self.aoe_collision_info.Size
		current_size.x = current_size.x - self.aoe_shrink_speed * dt

		-- 음수 사이즈 방지용
		local move = math.max(unity_class.mathf.Sign(current_size.x), 0)

		self.aoe_collision_info.Size = current_size * move

		-- 사이즈에 대응해서 움직여줄 것
		local current_pos = self.aoe_collision_info.Center
		current_pos = current_pos + (self.fire_dir * self.aoe_shrink_speed * dt) * move
		self.aoe_collision_info.Center = current_pos


	end

	-- 장판 데미지 처리
	local aoe_targets = area_collision_util.update(self.aoe_collision_calculator, dt)
	local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	for _, target in pairs(aoe_targets) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
			-- 정해둔 히트 수만큼만 때린다
			if self.hit_target_table[target] == nil or self.hit_target_table[target] < self.max_num_hits then
				local dir = self.fire_dir

				-- 히트 수 기록 및 데미지
				if self.hit_target_table[target] == nil then
					self.hit_target_table[target] = 1
					self:on_damage(target, dps, self.proj_damage_modifier, dir)
				else
					self.hit_target_table[target] = self.hit_target_table[target] + 1
					self:on_damage(target, dps, self.aoe_damage_modifier / (self.max_num_hits - 1), dir)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	aoe_targets:Dispose()


	-- 데미지 사이클 끝
	func_util.call_if(self.end_aoe, self.aoe_time_passed > self.aoe_life_time, self)

	self.aoe_time_passed = self.aoe_time_passed + dt
end

function local_class:end_aoe()
	self.destroy_proj(self, true)

	-- 히트 기록하는 테이블 초기화
	table_util.each_pair(function(key) self.hit_target_table[key] = nil end, self.hit_target_table)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.aoe_collision_calculator)

end

-- 실제 데미지 처리
function local_class:on_damage(target, dps, modifier, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = dps * modifier
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 전용 피격음이 있다면 교체한다.
	if self.sfx_info['hit'] then
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)
	end

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, modifier)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 히트마다 잔 진동 추가. 투사체가 긁으면서 발생하는 진동같은 느낌
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.character, 0.08, 0.15)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 뿔 사냥꾼 토가 (goat_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpGoatGirlBattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level

	self.main_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainScale')
	self.sub_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')

	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	self.back_dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'BackDashTiming')
	self.last_hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LastHitTiming')

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self.width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	self.length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	self.height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 크기
	local collision_size = vector(self.length, self.height, self.width)
	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info)

	--- 전용무기 착용중인가.
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	self.trigger_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'cast_fallback'

	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self.trigger_pos)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	self.spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	self.delta = 0.05
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 공격 이전 시점
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 타겟, 방향 갱신 및 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing - 0.1) then
		--- 반동 연출
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.2, 0, 0.1)
		battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing + 0.05) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.1)
	end

	--- 토가 돌진 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 0, 0.1)
		--- 충돌체 발사 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)
		local key = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and 'slash' or 'slash_rev'
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, key, self.trigger_pos, self.dir_vector)
		--- 스크린 이펙트 실행
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'dash')
	end

	--- 토가 돌진 공격
	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing, self.back_dash_timing) then
		local progress = math.min((time_passed - self.dash_timing) / (self.back_dash_timing - 0.1 - self.dash_timing), 1)
		if (time_passed - self.dash_timing) % self.delta <= 0.01 then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.07)
		end

		local pos = self.trigger_pos + self.length * progress / 2 * self.dir_vector
		self.collision_info.Size = vector(progress * 7, self.height, self.width)

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), self.dir_vector * math.max(0, progress))

		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, pos)

		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)
			--- 피격 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, self.sub_scale)
			end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.back_dash_timing - 0.1) then
		character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, -self.dir_vector, 0.4, 0, 0.2)
	end

	--- 토가 복귀
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.back_dash_timing) then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
		character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.owner, 1, 0.1)

		battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

		spine_util.set_spine_offset(spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner), vector_util.zero)
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'end', self.trigger_pos, -self.dir_vector)
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, -self.dir_vector)

		local key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'end' or 'end_fallback'
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.back_dash_timing + 0.1) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.3)
	end

	--- 마지막 복귀 히트
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.last_hit_timing) then
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)

		--- 피격 대상 순회
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			self:apply_damage(target, self.main_scale)
		end
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

	--- set next anim
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon and not float_util.almost_close_to(index, #self.hit_timing) then
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, string.format('jingak%d', index + 1))
	end

	--- shake camera
	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)

	local hit_targets = {}

	local collision_pos = pos + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up

	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, collision_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, dir_vector)

	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	--- 계수 계산
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(
		self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier
	)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) and hit_targets[each_target] == nil then
			hit_targets[each_target] = true

			self:on_damage(each_target, pos, modifier, 1 / #self.hit_timing)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()
	ifo_list = nil

	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		collision_pos, self.cast_radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	)

	for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, each_target) and hit_targets[each_target] == nil then
			hit_targets[each_target] = true

			self:on_damage(each_target, pos, modifier, 1 / #self.hit_timing)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- clear table
	for key in pairs(hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[key] = nil
	end

	hit_targets = nil
end

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
--- @param target any IFieldObject 데미지를 가할 대상
--- @param position any Vector3 공격을 한 위치
--- @param modifier number 데미지 계수
--- @param scale number 데미지 스케일
function local_class:on_damage(target, position, modifier, scale)
	local dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position).normalized

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 스케일 수치를 적용한 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 가우리(gourry) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpGourryBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 스피드
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 시간
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 스피드
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')
	--- 공격 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- dispose state
function action_state_class:dispose()
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set action animation
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'actionbackup')
	end

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.3)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- dash timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- short dash
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)

		--- jump character
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 2.5, self.dash_duration)
	end

	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {}
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.position)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing] * 1.3)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.7)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.position, self.radius)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					break
				end

				local scale = self.hit_targets[target] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)

				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- reset state
			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				self.action.area_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_machine = nil

		self.action_state:dispose()
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.action_state.dash_speed * self.action_state.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
	)

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <=
		min_dist + self.action_state.offset + self.area_state.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소

function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 캔슬
	self.area_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_machine then self.area_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 천계의 검 엔지 (guardian_angel) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpGuardianAngelBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 최대 거리
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 싱크 타이밍
	sync_timing = nil,

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,

	--- 공격 가능한 거리
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, _)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 최대 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')
	--- 싱크 타이밍
	self.sync_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SyncTiming')

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end
--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	self.force_cancel = false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- back 방향으로 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.back)
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback')
	--- set emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + spine_util.get_spine_total_offset(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'castfallback')

	--- 스크린 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 카메라 쉐이킹
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	--- 점프 연출
	character_util.jump(self.owner, 1, self.action_duration, 0.2)
	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.play_voice_in_args(
		self.cs_action, 1, character_voice_type.skill_1, character_voice_type.skill_2, character_voice_type.special_1
	)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 점프 연출 캔슬
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.current_time_passed < self.sync_timing then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 공격 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.sync_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 대상이 유효하고 거리 내에 있다면 대상의 위치로 설정함
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) and battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then
			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target)))
		else
			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(
				info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
			)
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍
	last_hit_timing = nil,

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,

	--- 첫 타 체크를 위한 해시셋
	hit_targets_set = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 위치
	target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing
	--- 마지막 판정 타이밍
	self.last_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[self.max_hit]

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 원형 실린더 판정
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)

	--- 첫 타 체크를 위한 해시셋
	self.hit_targets_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상의 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 이펙트 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)
	--- 효과음 출력
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

	--- 판정 위치 세팅
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < self.last_hit_timing - 0.1 then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- 첫 타 대상자 초기화
	self.hit_targets_set:clear()
end

function field_state_class:dispose()
	if self.hit_targets_set then self.hit_targets_set:dispose() end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 첫타 분기
		if idx == 1 then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.15)
		else
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.12)
		end

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			local damage_scale = self.hit_targets_set:add(fo) and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, damage_scale)
		end

	until true end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.last_hit_timing - 0.1) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 판정이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.last_hit_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.action_state or self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	self.field_state:sync(info)
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.field_machine then return end

	self.action_state.force_cancel = true
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end
