--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 하프 뱀파이어 프리실라(half_vampire) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpHalfVampireBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- ailment info
	ailment_info = nil,
	--- 공격 최대 거리
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 기본 판정 범위
	radius = nil,
	--- 폭발 범위
	explosion_radius = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 발동 여부
	activate_cwp_option = nil,
	--- 무기 옵션 힐 비율
	cwp_heal_ratio = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 공격 최대 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)

	--- 기본 판정 범위
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 폭발 범위
	self.explosion_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExplosionRadius')

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)

	if self.target then
		self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	else
		self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector
	end
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'actionbackup')
	end

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- 캐스팅 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- play default voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.2)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 캔슬되었을때
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fire_fx, true)
	self.fire_fx = nil

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.hit_timing[1] then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			if index == 1 then
				local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
				local dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(self.target_pos - owner_pos))

				if dist > self.attack_range then
					self.target_pos = owner_pos + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector
				end

				self.fire_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'fire', self.target_pos)

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.3)
			end

			--- 마지막 판정
			local last_hit = index == #self.hit_timing

			if last_hit then
				self.fire_fx = nil

				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.27, 0.25)
			end

			local current_radius = not last_hit and self.radius or self.explosion_radius

			local scale = not last_hit and self.sub_damage_scale or self.main_damage_scale

			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier) * scale

			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.target_pos, current_radius)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					break
				end

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점 (스테이트 종료는 하지 않음)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 액션 종료
		self:exit(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	--- 판정 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing]) then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부 & 스테이트 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 콤보 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

	self.loop = 3
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local direction = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 상황에 맞는 dist 계산
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_obj = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner),
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	closest_obj = closest_obj or target

	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)
	local closest_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(closest_obj)

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_bounds, direction), dash_dist)

	return distance <= min_dist + self.offset + self.radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 현재 루프
	self.loop = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

	--- 첫번째 루프
	if self.loop == 1 then
		local key = (look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up) and 'action1' or 'action4'

		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)

	--- 세번재 루프
	elseif self.loop == 3 then
		if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right or look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
			spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(-360, (self.dash_duration + self.dash_timing) * 0.8)
		end

		--- set action animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action3')
	end

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- cancel jump
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)
	--- reset rotate
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):Rotate(0, 0)

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- dash timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- short dash
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
		local spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'cast',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector, spine_container, parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- play cast sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

		--- 두번째 루프
		if self.loop == 2 then
			self.action.animation_info['action2'].timescale = 1.7
			--- set action animation
			battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action2')
		--- 세번재 루프
		elseif self.loop == 3 then
			--- character jump
			character_util.jump(self.owner, 2, self.dash_duration, self.dash_duration * 0.5)
		end
	end

	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		--- hit timing
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- explosion pos
			local pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.offset * self.dir_vector

			if index == 1 then
				--- instantiate screen effect
				battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

				local key = string.format('hit%d', self.loop)

				--- instantiate hit effect
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, key, pos + 0.03 * vector_util.up, self.loop == 1 and self.dir_vector or nil
				)

				--- play hit sfx
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, key)

				--- shake camera
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.3)
			end

			--- calculate modifier
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
				pos, self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
			)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if not battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					break
				end

				local scale = self.hit_targets[target] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)

				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	if self.loop ~= 1 then
		--- 기본 사운드 mute
		damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)
	end

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 목표 루프
	trigger_info_util.append_number(info, (self.action_state.loop) % 3 + 1)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- H.E.R.O.S KAI (hero_ai) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpHeroAiBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 첫 타 타이밍
	first_hit_timing = nil,
	--- 공격 가능한 거리
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	local hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 시작 타이밍
	self.first_hit_timing = hit_timing[1]

	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')
	--- 적중 가능한 거리
	self.hittable_dist = self.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- attackrange 기준으로 대상과 적중이 가능한지 판단한다.
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return target_dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
	self.force_cancel = false
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캐스팅 애니메이션은 좌우만 있음으로 방향을 치환 후 적용한다.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 시전자 위치에서의 시전 fx 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
	--- 시전 타이밍에 카메라 쉐이크
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	--- 시전 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 시전 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- 카메라 살짝 암전
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.current_time_passed < self.first_hit_timing then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 공격 전까지 방향을 갱신한다.
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.first_hit_timing then
		if is_unity_null(self.target) or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self.target = nil
		else
			--- 방향 획득
			local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)

			--- 방향이 유효하면
			if not float_util.is_almost_zero(vector_util.magnitude(dir_vector)) then
				--- 해당 방향으로 결정하고, 바라보도록 세팅
				self.dir_vector = dir_vector
				battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, vector_util.to_side_dir(self.dir_vector))
			end
		end
	end

	--- 판정이 필요한 시점이 되었다. (첫타)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.first_hit_timing) then
		--- 시전자 위치
		local owner_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)
		local target_pos = nil

		--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
		if self.target then
			--- 시전자의 위치 획득
			target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
			--- 대상과 시전자의 거리 산출
			local dist = vector_util.magnitude(vector_util.get_x0z(target_pos - owner_pos))

			--- 사거리를 벗어났다면
			if dist > self.attack_range then
				--- 공격 위치는 대상방향으로 공격 거리로 제한
				target_pos = owner_pos + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector
			end
		else
			--- 타겟이 유효하지 않을 땐, 공격 위치는 바라보는 방향으로 시전
			target_pos = owner_pos + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 목표 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos))
		--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 시간 만료. 배틀액션이 종료되었음을 알린다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 액션 스테이트를 종료시켜준다.
		self.machine:change(nil)
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너

	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type

	--- 상태이상 정보

	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 첫 타 타이밍
	first_hit_timing = nil,

	--- 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 위치
	target_pos = nil,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 판정 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 판정 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)
	--- 첫 타 타이밍
	local first_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[1]

	--- "첫타" 시점에 해당 state가 생겼음으로 hit_timing을 보정해준다.
	for idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		self.hit_timing[idx] = self.hit_timing[idx] - first_hit_timing
	end
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 충돌체 계산은 시작시 한번만 세팅. 업데이트중 세팅할 필요 없음.
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.target_pos)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 홀로그램 폭풍 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.target_pos)

	--- 홀로그램 전개 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	if self.current_time_passed < 0.6 then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.6) then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.35)
	end

	--- 판정 처리
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		--- hit 판정 테이블 - 첫타시간 만큼 빼서 체크를 한다. (fieldState 시작이 첫타시간만큼 늦게 시작되기 때문)
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local is_last_hit = idx == #self.hit_timing

			--- 데미지 배율 획득
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
			--- 첫타와 다단히트에 맞는 데미지 추가 보정
			local scale = is_first_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

			--- 범위 충돌 계산 시작
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 범위내 대상들에게 피해를 적용한다.
			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
			end

			--- 범위 충돌 계산 종료
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			--- 막타 판정
			if not is_last_hit then
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.2)
			else
				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.35)
				self.machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action
	)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 스테이트용 머신 추가
	self.action_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.action_machine

	--- 판정 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	--- 대상 탐색 최대 거리. AttackRange는 ActionState에서 처리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.action_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	do
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.field_state)

		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.action_machine and self.action_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 콤보 타겟 중 SearchRange 기준으로 타겟을 넘긴다.
	--- 실 생성 판정은 AttackRange로 제한.
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.action_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.action_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then
		return
	end

	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.field_state:sync(info)
	--- 판정 머신 동작
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.action_machine then self.action_machine:update(dt) end
	--- 판정 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 이누이트 소녀 코코 (innuit) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpInnuitBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}

function action_state_class:apply_option(param, level)

	--- 승급 적용 확인

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.screen_effect_timing) then
		--- 스크린 이펙트 생성 및 재생
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')
		--- 승급 적용 전에만 스크린 효과음 재생
		if not self.activate_ascent_option then
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'tornado', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, character_util.get_transform(self.owner))

		--- 사이클론 효과음 재생
		self.tornado_sfx = battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'tornado')
		--- 승급 아닐때만 fadeout 되도록 함
		if self.activate_ascent_option then
			self.tornado_sfx = nil
		end

		--- 판정 위치 설정
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	end

	--- 콜라이더 판정 업데이트
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 위치 세팅
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 판정 체크
		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier)
			end
		end

		--- 카메라를 흔들어주기 적당한 타이밍
		local prev_factor = math.max(old_time_passed - self.attack_timing + self.damage_term, 0) % self.damage_term
		local next_factor = math.max(time_passed - self.attack_timing + self.damage_term, 0) % self.damage_term
		if prev_factor > next_factor then
			--- 카메라 흔들기 강도
			local shake_magnitude = old_time_passed < (self.attack_timing + (self.attack_duration) / 2) and 0.2 or 0.1
			--- 승급 적용 전이면 0.7배로 적용한다.
			shake_magnitude = self.activate_ascent_option and shake_magnitude or shake_magnitude * 0.7
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, shake_magnitude, 0.2)
		end

		--- 판정 종료
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 대상으로의 방향
	local damage_dir = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)
	--- 대상과의 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.direction = damage_dir

	--- 메인 적용 여부
	local is_main = dist < self.main_scale_radius
	--- 이 타격이 부여할 데미지 스케일
	local current_scale = is_main and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
	--- modifier 설정
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * current_scale
	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, current_scale)

	--- 메인 계수 적용 시
	if is_main then
		--- 스턴 부여
		damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
		damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	end

	--- 넉백 거리 안에 있다면 넉백 추가
	if dist <= self.knock_back_radius then
		damage_info.knock_back_dir = damage_dir
		damage_info.knock_back_factor = knock_back_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
		damage_info.knock_back_force = knock_back_constants.standard_force * 0.75
	end

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c

	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

		dash_dist * direction
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, direction), dash_dist
	)

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + self.offset + self.length * 0.4
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 길드성 등에서 어색한 연출을 없애기 위해 적당히 서치함
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(
		self.cs_action, battle_constants.default_search_range
	)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 타겟 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.action)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	if trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
		local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
		local speed = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, 0)

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, target, dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, speed, speed,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)
	else
		for key in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
			self.hit_targets[key] = nil
		end

		self.explosion_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
		self.explosion_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.explosion)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for key, _ in pairs(self.state_machine) do
		if self.state_machine[key] and self.state_machine[key].update then
			local old_time_passed = self.state_machine[key].time_passed
			self.state_machine[key].time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

			self.state_machine[key].update(self, old_time_passed, self.state_machine[key].time_passed, dt)
		end
	end
end

--region action state

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set cast anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, self.owner.SpineController.SpineContainerTransform
	)

	--- 개화 적용중일땐 날개 이펙트를 별도로 붙여준다.
	if self.activate_myth_option then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self,
			'wing',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			self.sync_dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
			parent_follow_flag.position
		)
	end

	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- jump
	self.owner:Jump(0.7, self.hit_timing[1] - 0.1, false)
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner):CancelJump();

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	self.sync_target = nil
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		if self.dash_timing <= time_passed then
			local dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5

			if self.sync_target then
				dist = math.min(battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, self.sync_target), dist)
			end

			local speed = dist * 2 / self.dash_duration

			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

			if self.sync_target then
				trigger_info_util.append_target(sync_info, self.sync_target)
			end

			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)
			trigger_info_util.append_number(sync_info, speed)

			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[1]) then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.sync_dir_vector)
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.sync_dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 차지 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region explosion state

--- Explosion 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_explosion_state(_)
	--- instantiate explosion fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'explosion', self.explosion_pos, self.explosion_dir_vector)

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'explosion', self.explosion_pos)
	--- 추가 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'add', self.explosion_pos)

	--- 충돌체 계산기 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.explosion_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.explosion_dir_vector)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)
end

--- Explosion 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_explosion_state(_)
end

--- Explosion 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_explosion_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		local timing = self.hit_timing[index] - self.hit_timing[1]

		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, timing) then
			stage_camera:Shake(0.08, 0.3)

			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					self:apply_damage(target, self.explosion_pos)
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

			if index == #self.hit_timing then
				--- state reset
				self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
			end
		end
	end
end
--endregion

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)
	local scale = self.sub_damage_scale

	if self.hit_targets[target] == nil then
		self.hit_targets[target] = true

		scale = self.main_damage_scale
	end

	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 비취 주술사 타샤 (jade_shaman) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpJadeShamanBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 대시 속도
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 지속시간
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')
	--- 대시 거리
	local dash_dist = 0

	--- 대시 거리 총합
	for idx = 1, #self.dash_speed do
		dash_dist = dash_dist + self.dash_speed[idx] * self.dash_duration[idx] * 0.5
	end

	--- 판정 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 판정 범위
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- attack duration
	local attack_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackDuration')
	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, height, attack_duration)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- attack timing
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = #self.attack_timing

	--- hitabble distance
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * 2 * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack')
	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	self.fx_screen = battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 초기 대시방향 초기화
	self.dash_dir_vector = self.dir_vector
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 액션이 끝나기 전에 캔슬된거면 스크린 end 를 따로 재생
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_screen, true)
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen_end')
	end

	--- screen fx 해제
	self.fx_screen = nil

	--- play screen_end sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen_end')
	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- set animation
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'attack' .. idx)

		--- slash effect
		self.action.field_state:start_slash('slash'..idx, self.dir_vector)

		--- 대상이 타격이 가능하면 대상으로 추적
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) then
			self.dash_dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target)
		end

		--- set locked direction
		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dash_dir_vector)

		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dash_dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration[idx],
			self.dash_speed[idx],
			self.dash_speed[idx] * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			nil,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)
	until true end

	--- 카메라 쉐이킹을 위한 별도의 타이밍 체크
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing[idx] + 0.1) then
			break
		end

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.2)
	until true end

	--- 판정 동작 중에는 판정 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_started(self.calculator) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator, dt)

		--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
		if #hit_targets > 0 then
			--- 계수
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

			--- 판정된 대상 순회
			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, 1 / self.max_hit)
			end
		end

		--- 판정 종료될 상태라면 종료 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	self.fx_table = {}
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	self:clear()
end

function field_state_class:start_slash(effect_key, dir_vector)
	local slash_info = {}

	slash_info.timer = 0.2

	slash_info.name = effect_key

	slash_info.dir_vector = dir_vector

	local fx_slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		effect_key,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		dir_vector,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play attack sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, effect_key)

	--- 이펙트의 flip 을 해치지 않고 랜덤하게 rotation
	fx_slash.transform.rotation = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(
		fx_slash.transform.eulerAngles.x,
		random_util.get_random_value() * 360,
		fx_slash.transform.eulerAngles.z
	)

	slash_info.fx = fx_slash

	table.insert(self.fx_table, slash_info)
end

function field_state_class:clear()
	for idx = #self.fx_table, 1, -1 do
		local fx_info = table.remove(self.fx_table, idx)
		self:on_end_fx(fx_info, true)
	end
end

function field_state_class:on_end_fx(slash_info, is_immediately)

	--- 즉시 지워야 하는 거라면 (캔슬 등)
	if is_immediately then

		--- slash end 이펙트를 생성해줘야 한다.
		local fx_slash = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			slash_info.name .. '_end',
			bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			slash_info.dir_vector,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 기존 slash 의 rotation 을 그대로 넣어줌
		fx_slash.transform.rotation = slash_info.fx.transform.rotation

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(slash_info.fx, true)
	end

	slash_info.fx = nil

end

--- field state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	for idx = #self.fx_table, 1, -1 do
		self.fx_table[idx].timer = self.fx_table[idx].timer - dt

		--- 타이머가 다 되었으면 제거해줌
		if self.fx_table[idx].timer <= 0 then
			local fx_info = table.remove(self.fx_table, idx)
			self:on_end_fx(fx_info, false)
		end
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.field_state, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	self.field_state:exit()

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}
