local local_class = newclass('CwpLeafFairyBattleAction')

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 풀잎 요정 아오바(leaf_fairy) 전용 무기 기술
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, params)

	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 시간
	local life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'LifeTime')
	--- 판정 텀
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 충돌체 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(
		self.radius, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y, life_time, damage_term
	)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.num_hits = battle_util.get_number(self.calculator.MaxNumHits)

	--- 겹침 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MainDamageScale')

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.sync_target = nil
	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.sync_dir_vector = nil
	--- 싱크된 판정 위치
	self.sync_pos = nil

	--region state members region

	--- 내부 스테이트 정의
	self.state = {
		--- 아무것도 안하는 상태
		none = {
			id = 1,
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end,
			time_passed = 0
		},
		--- 액션 상태
		action = {
			id = 2,
			enter = self.enter_action_state,
			exit = self.exit_action_state,
			update = self.update_action_state,
			time_passed = 0
		},
		--- 판정 상태
		area = {
			id = 3,
			enter = self.enter_area_state,
			exit = self.exit_area_state,
			update = self.update_area_state,
			time_passed = 0
		}
	}

	self.state_machine_key =
	{
		current = 'current',
		collision = 'collision'
	}

	self.state_machine = {
		current = self.state.none,
		collision = self.state.none
	}

	--endregion

	--- 강제 캔슬 되었는가
	self.is_force_canceled = false
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--- 싱크 정보 해지
	self.sync_target = nil

	--region state 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.state_machine)

		for key in pairs(self.state) do
			for inner_key in pairs(self.state[key]) do
				self.state[key][inner_key] = nil
			end

			self.state[key] = nil
		end

		self.state_machine = nil
		self.state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(
			self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec, self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info
		)

		self.shoot_helper = nil
		self.proj_spec = nil
		self.cs_shooter = nil

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(state_key, new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state_machine[state_key]
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.state_machine[state_key] = new_state

	--- 시간 리셋
	new_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine.current and self.state_machine.current.id == self.state.none.id
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local proj_dist= projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= proj_dist + self.radius * 0.8
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	local targets, dir_vectors = battle_util.get_closest_target(
		self.cs_action, self.search_range
	)

	if #targets then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, targets[1])
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vectors[1])

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 캔슬 여부 리셋
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 타겟 Sync
	self.sync_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	--- 방향 Sync
	self.sync_dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.action)
end


function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	self.sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.area)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true
	--- [GT-1888] 발사 직후 폭발 직전 사이 강제 캔슬 시 암전 해제 안되는 현상 개선
	--- FIXME: state 구조 개선이 병행 필요. 해당 캐릭터가 개편이 있을 때 다시 수정하기로 결정
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for key, _ in pairs(self.state_machine) do
		if self.state_machine[key] and self.state_machine[key].update then
			local old_time_passed = self.state_machine[key].time_passed
			self.state_machine[key].time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

			self.state_machine[key].update(self, old_time_passed, self.state_machine[key].time_passed, dt)
		end
	end
end

--region action state

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
	self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
		self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
	)

	--- set ready anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	character_util.shake(self.owner, 0.05, 0.1)
	character_util.pulse_fade_color(self.owner, unity_class.color.white, 0.7, 1, 0.2)

	--- instantiate cast fx
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', self.owner.Position + self.sync_dir_vector, nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)
	end

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.75, 0.1)
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	--- TimeLimit 타입 이어서 알아서 사라지도록 냅둠
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- 발사되지 않은 상태에서 캔슬시 어두워지는 효과를 없앰
	if self.state_machine.current.time_passed < self.shoot_timing or self.is_force_canceled then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		effect_util.update_object(self.cast_fx,self.owner.Position + self.sync_dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- set shoot anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		self.cast_fx = nil
	end

	--- update IK
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 차지 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 지속 시간 만료이면 그냥 만료 시키도록
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction or
		hit_info.target ~= nil and battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target)  then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		local pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(hit_info.position)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- area 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_area_state(_)
	--- instantiate area fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'area', self.sync_pos)
	--- play area sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx_and_replace_position(self, 'area', self.sync_pos)

	--- set calculator position
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.sync_pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.5, 0.2)
end

--- area 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_area_state(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- area 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_area_state(old_time_passed, _, dt)
	--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			local scale = self.main_damage_scale

			if old_time_passed ~= 0 then
				scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.num_hits - 1)
			end

			self:apply_damage(target, self.sync_pos, scale)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.calculator) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 전설의 용사 에리나(legendary_hero) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpLegendaryHeroBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	attack_range = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 적중할 거리
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')
	--- set emotion
	battle_util.set_emotion(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	local spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	local init_pos = spine_container.position + bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y * 0.5 * vector_util.up
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'ready', init_pos, nil, spine_container, parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- play ready sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'ready')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- play voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.1)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 중간에 캔슬되었을 경우
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- remove emotion
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration - 0.05) then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', self.owner.Position, nil, self.owner.Transform)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, self.target) and
			battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, self.target) <= self.attack_range then

			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target.Position))
		else
			--- 위치 정보 추가
			trigger_info_util.append_position(
				info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.owner.Position + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
			)
		end

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 이번 sequence 에 영향을 준 대상들
	hit_targets = {},
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	position = nil,
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param)
	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 처리의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

function area_state_class:force_cancel()
	self.forced_cancel = true
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing] * 0.8)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do repeat
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			--- 판정 높이
			local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
			--- 판정 위치
			local calc_pos = self.position + height * 0.5 * vector_util.up

			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(calc_pos, self.radius, height)

			--- loop ifo
			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) == false then
					break
				end

				--- 상황에 맞는 계수
				local scale = self.hit_targets[target] and self.sub_damage_scale or self.main_damage_scale

				--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
				self.action:apply_damage(target, scale)

				--- 영향을 준 타겟 체크
				self.hit_targets[target] = true
			until true end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()

			if index == 1 then
				--- 발사 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.position)

				--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

				--- play cast sfx
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			--- 판정 시간이 끝났을때
			elseif index == #self.hit_timing then
				self.action.area_state_machine:change(nil)
			end
		end
	until true end
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parse myth option
	self:apply_myth_option(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params)

	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:apply_myth_option(param)

	-- 개화 옵션 파싱
	local myth_option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'MythOptionId')
	local myth_activate_option, myth_option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(myth_option_id, self.owner)

	if not myth_activate_option then
		return
	end

	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_option_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return dist <= self.action_state.attack_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_state_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 캔슬
	self.area_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_state_machine then self.area_state_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function local_class:apply_damage(target, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	--- 카메라 연출
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 란 (librarian) 2차 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpLibrarian2BattleAction')

--region state machine
local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end
--endregion

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
	force_cancel = false,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 프로젝타일 슈터
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper_table, self.proj_spec_table = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 총 투사체의 수 (4개)
	self.proj_spec_count = #self.proj_spec_table
	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 총 발사 횟수 (6회, 발사횟수 > 투사체 수. 따라서 중복 투사체 2개를 아래 셔플로직에서 추가해준다)
	self.max_shoot_count = #self.shoot_timing

	--- 각 타격당 비율
	self.each_shoot_scale = 1 / self.max_shoot_count

	--- 최대 사거리
	self.hittable_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec_table[1]) * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 투사체 발사 순서에 대한 테이블
	self.shoot_sequence = { 1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3}
end

function action_state_class:on_equipment_change()

end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	--- 투사체 로드 여부 확인
	return battle_util.is_shoot_helper_loaded(self.shoot_helper_table)
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

function action_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 발사 방향
	local dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)
	--- 발사 위치
	local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	--- 발사 위치
	local label = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 0)

	--- 투사체를 발사한다.
	self:shoot_projectile(pos, dir, label)
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
	self.force_cancel = false
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 시전 vfx 출력
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', character_util.get_position(self.owner),
		nil,spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- 캐스팅 사운드 추가
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 애니메이션 실행
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 대상을 바라보도록 시선 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.17, 0.2)

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- 투사체 발사 순서를 섞는다.
	self:shuffle_shoot_sequence()
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 애니메이션 삭제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 캐릭터 방향 고정시키던 것 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_fire, true)
	self.fx_fire = nil

	if self.current_time_passed < 0.7 then
		--- camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 기 모으기 이펙트 시작
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed,time_passed,0.3) then
		--- 애니메이션 실행
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'loop')
	end

	--- 대상에게 시선 고정
	--- 발사 중 대상이 유효하지 않다면 마지막 방향 지속 유지 (미래기사 무기기술과 동일 스펙)
	self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
		self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector
	)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.7) then
		--- camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
	end

	--- 발사 타이밍 마다 체크하며 발사 (0.4초부터 1.15초)
	for idx = 1, self.max_shoot_count do
		--- 발사 타이밍을 지나쳤는지 여부 검사
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[idx]) then
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1

			--- 첫 발사 연출
			if is_first_hit then
				--- 시전 먹을 휘두르는 vfx 출력
				self.fx_fire = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
					self.action, 'fire', character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector
				)

				--- 스크린 먹물 vfx 출력
				battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
				--- 스크린 사운드 출력
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'screen')
			end

			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.13, 0.14)

			--- 바닥에 튀는 먹물 vfx 출력
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(
				self.action, 'ink', character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector
			)

			--- 발사 위치와 방향 동기화 -> sync 받아서 발사처리
			local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
			--- 발사 위치
			trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
			--- 발사 방향
			trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)
			--- 발사 해야할 투사체 번호도 넘겨준다. 1 ~ 6
			trigger_info_util.append_integer(sync_info, self.shoot_sequence[idx])

			--- 커맨드 발행
			command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
		end
	end

	if self.fx_fire ~= nil then
		effect_util.update_object(self.fx_fire, character_util.get_position(self.owner), self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝났으니 종료 처리 (1.2초동안 발사)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 상태 초기화를 시킨다
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사 순서를 섞어준다
function action_state_class:shuffle_shoot_sequence()
	--- 발사 순서를 적당히 섞어준다. (Knuth shuffle)
	for index = #self.shoot_sequence, 2, -1 do
		local j = random_util.get_random_int(1, index)
		self.shoot_sequence[index], self.shoot_sequence[j] = self.shoot_sequence[j], self.shoot_sequence[index]
	end
end

--- 투사체 발사
function action_state_class:shoot_projectile(pos, dir, label)
	--- 애니메이션 실행
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 해당 방향으로 투사체를 쏜다
	shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
		self.shoot_helper_table[label], pos, dir, label)
end

--- 투사체 충돌 후처리
function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, label)
	--- 타겟이 유효한 경우
	if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target) then
		--- modifier 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 적용
		self:apply_damage(hit_info.target, modifier)

		--- 카메라 흔들기
		--- battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.03, 0.12)

		--- 힛 이펙트 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_hit_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], bounds_util.get_center(hit_info.target))
		return false
	end

	--- 투사체 자연 소멸인 경우
	if hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction then
		--- 투사체 소멸 이펙트 출력
		--- 투사체 이펙트 관련 슬롯이 부족하여 폭발 이펙트에 할당하여 사용함
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec_table[label], hit_info.position, hit_info.direction)
		--- 프로젝타일 만료
		return true
	end

	return false
end

--- 데미지 적용
function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	--- 데미지 배율에 대해 각 투사체 마다 균등 분배 처리
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * self.each_shoot_scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 별도 히트 사운드 추가
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'hit')
	--- 기본 피격음 음소거
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(true)

	--- CC를 적용 (각 투사체마다 균등 분배)
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, self.each_shoot_scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local_class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)

	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 투사체 적중시 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @param label number 프로젝타일의 식별하기 위한 일종의 ID
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if not self.action_state then return true end
	--- 액션 상태 on_hit 호출
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 라이프 가드 유즈(lifeguard_yuze) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpLifeguardYuzeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- state name
	name = nil,
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 대시 타이밍
	dash_timing = nil,
	--- 대시 속도
	dash_speed = nil,
	--- 대시 길이
	dash_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 오프셋
	offset = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

function action_state_class:new(parent_class, action_duration, dash_timing, dash_speed, offset)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.action_duration = action_duration
	obj.dash_timing = dash_timing
	obj.dash_speed = dash_speed
	obj.dash_duration = action_duration - dash_timing
	obj.offset = offset
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return self.current_time_passed >= self.dash_timing
end

function action_state_class:set(target, dir_vector)
	self.target = target
	self.dir_vector = dir_vector
end

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- set cast anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- 캐스팅 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	--- shake and play voice
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 트레일 이펙트 해지
	if self.trail_fx then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.trail_fx)
		self.trail_fx = nil
	end

	--- 강제 캔슬
	if self.current_time_passed <= self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove lock dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상 방향 갱신
	if self.target then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 고정할 방향
		local dir_toward = self.target and battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, self.target) or self.dir_vector

		--- 고정할 방향
		local be_locked = dir_toward.x > 0 and
			CS.Oak.Direction.Right or
			(dir_toward.x < 0 and
				CS.Oak.Direction.Left or
				direction_util.to_side_dir(vector_util.to_direction(dir_toward)))

		battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, be_locked)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대상 방향으로 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector,
			0, self.dash_duration, self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed, CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop, false, 0
		)

		--- 점프 요청
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 3, self.dash_duration, 0.1, false)

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'jump', self.owner.Position)

		--- 점프 사운드 재생
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'jump')

		--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
		self.trail_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'trail', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
			nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position
		)

		--- sync 데이터 비워줌
		self.target = nil
	end

	--- 액션이 끝나는 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 오너의 위치를 기준으로 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position + self.offset * self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

		--- state reset
		self.action.action_state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region sub state

local sub_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 판정 시간
	hit_duration = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	attack_modifier = nil,
	--- 최대 히트 수
	max_hits = nil,
	--- 대미지 처리 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 처리 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 판정 확장 시간
	expand_duration = nil,
	--- 데미지 간격
	damage_term = nil,
	--- 판정 최소 반지름
	min_radius = nil,
	--- 판정 최대 반지름
	max_radius = nil,
	--- 판정 높이
	height = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 바닥 위치
	ground_pos = nil,
	--- 판정 중심 위치
	center_pos = nil,
	--- 이번 trigger 에 영향을 준 대상들
	hit_targets = {},
	--- 이번 trigger 에 대상을 히트한 수
	count_targets = {}
}
sub_state_class.mt = { __index = sub_state_class }

function sub_state_class:new(
	parent_class, hit_duration, attack_modifier, max_hits, main_damage_scale, expand_duration, damage_term, radius
)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj.hit_duration = hit_duration
	obj.attack_modifier = attack_modifier
	obj.max_hits = max_hits
	obj.main_damage_scale = main_damage_scale
	obj.sub_damage_scale = (1 - main_damage_scale) / (max_hits - 1)
	obj.expand_duration = expand_duration
	obj.damage_term = damage_term
	obj.min_radius = radius[1]
	obj.max_radius = radius[2]
	obj.height = bounds_util.get_size(parent_class.owner).y
	return obj
end

function sub_state_class:apply_option(params)
	--- 전용 옵션 발동
	self.activate_cwp_option = true
	--- 범위내 아군에게 적용할 버프
	self.buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(params)

	--- 무기 옵션 힐 비율
	self.cwp_heal_ratio = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HealRatio')
end

function sub_state_class:set(ground_pos)
	self.ground_pos = ground_pos
	self.center_pos = ground_pos + self.height * 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.up
end

--- sub state enter
function sub_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')
	--- 시작 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'start', self.ground_pos)

	--- 필드 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'field')

	--- 카메라 쉐이크
	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.14, 0.5)
	end
end

--- sub state exit
function sub_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
		self.count_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- sub state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function sub_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 필드 이펙트를 조금 늦게 생성
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.05) then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'field', self.ground_pos)
	end

	--- 확장 시간을 기준으로 프로그래스 계산
	local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.expand_duration, 1)
	local radius = self.max_radius

	--- 최대 확장 시간에 도달하지 못했을때
	if progress < 1 then
		radius = (self.max_radius - self.min_radius) * progress + self.min_radius
	end

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(self.center_pos, radius, self.height)

	--- 데미지 계수
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	--- 전투 중인지
	local is_in_battle = battle_util.is_in_battle(self.owner)

	--- 범위 내 대상 루프
	for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
		--- 최대 히트수 조건 체크
		if self.count_targets[t] and self.count_targets[t] >= self.max_hits then
			break
		end

		--- 데미지 간격 이내일 경우
		if self.hit_targets[t] and self.hit_targets[t] + self.damage_term > time_passed then
			break
		end

		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, t) then
			--- 상황에 맞는 스케일
			local scale = self.hit_targets[t] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self.action:apply_damage(t, modifier, scale)

			--- hit target 체크
			self.hit_targets[t] = time_passed
			self.count_targets[t] = (self.count_targets[t] or 0) + 1

		--- 대상이 아군인 경우
		elseif self.activate_cwp_option and battle_util.can_apply_heal(self.owner, t, false) then
			if is_in_battle then
				self:apply_heal(t)
			end

			--- 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, t, self.buff_info)

			--- hit target 체크
			self.hit_targets[t] = time_passed
			self.count_targets[t] = self.max_hits
		end
	until true end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_duration * 0.5) then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, self.hit_duration * 0.5)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_duration) then
		self.action.sub_state_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 힐 커맨드 발행
function sub_state_class:apply_heal(t)
	--- 힐 정보 생성
	local heal_info = CS.Oak.HealInfo()
	heal_info.type = heal_type.normal
	heal_info.sender = self.owner
	heal_info.target = t
	heal_info.heal = math.floor(character_util.get_max_hp(t) * self.cwp_heal_ratio)

	--- 힐 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_heal(heal_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	local attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- get action duration
	local action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 대미지 처리 메인 계수
	local main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'MainDamageScale')

	--- 대시 타이밍
	local dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashTiming')
	--- 대시 속도
	local dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DashSpeed')
	--- 대시 길이
	local dash_duration = action_duration - dash_timing
	--- 대시 거리
	self.dash_dist = dash_speed * dash_duration * 0.5

	--- 판정 오프셋
	local offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'Offset')

	--- 판정 시간
	local hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'HitDuration')
	--- 판정 확장 시간
	local expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ExpandDuration')
	--- 데미지 간격
	local damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 최대 히트 수
	local max_hits = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxHits')

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(params, 'Radius')
	--- hittable scale 이 고려된 반지름
	self.hittable_radius = radius[#radius] * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, action_duration, dash_timing, dash_speed, offset)
	--- 판정 스테이트
	self.sub_state = sub_state_class:new(
		self, hit_duration, attack_modifier, max_hits, main_damage_scale, expand_duration, damage_term, radius
	)

	--- 액션 스테이트 머신
	self.action_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신
	self.sub_state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 전용 옵션 관련 파싱
	self:apply_option(params)
end

function local_class:apply_option(params)
	--- 옵션 아이디를 가져옴
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'OptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.sub_state:apply_option(option_param)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.action_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.sub_state_machine:change(nil)
		self.action_state_machine = nil
		self.sub_state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.dolphin_state)
		self.action_state = nil
		self.dolphin_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.action_state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state_machine:is_nil_state() == false and self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 오너의 bounds
	local owner_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(self.owner)

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		owner_bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		self.dash_dist * dir_vector
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local min_dist = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(owner_bounds, closest_object.Bounds, dir_vector), self.dash_dist
	)

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= min_dist + self.hittable_radius
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	local target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	local dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self.action_state:set(target, dir_vector)
	self.action_state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.action_state_machine:change(nil)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 대상 위치
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	self.sub_state:set(target_pos)
	self.sub_state_machine:change(self.sub_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.sub_state_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.action_state_machine then self.action_state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.sub_state_machine then self.sub_state_machine:update(dt) end
end


--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 리나(lina) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpLinaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 공격 타이밍
	attack_timing = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 공격 타이밍
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')

		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special2)
		end
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'actionbackup')

		--- play default voice
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	end

	local container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)

	--- instantiate cast effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', container.position, nil, container, parent_follow_flag.position)

	--- instantiate blade effect
	self.blade_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'blade', container.position, nil, container)

	--- 어태치먼트 세팅
	local attachment = self.blade_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachment))
	attachment.SpineController = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, self.attack_timing * 0.35)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- cancel jump
	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)

	--- 어태치먼트 해지
	local attachment = self.blade_fx:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.WeaponAttachment))
	attachment:ResetVariables()

	--- dispose blade fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.blade_fx)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.attack_timing then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.25) then
		character_util.jump(self.owner, 2, 0.45, 0.35)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.owner.Position)
		--- 방향 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

local area_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- aliment info
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 시간
	hit_duration = nil,
	--- 판정 간격
	damage_term = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 가능 횟수
	max_hits = nil,
	--- 짧은 변
	short_base = nil,
	--- 긴 변
	long_base = nil,
	--- 높이
	height = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil,
	--- 영향을 준 대상
	hit_targets = {}
}
area_state_class.mt = { __index = area_state_class }

--- create area state
function area_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function area_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 시간
	self.hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')
	--- 판정 간격
	self.damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DamageTerm')
	--- 최대 판정 가능 횟수
	self.max_hits = math.floor(self.hit_duration / self.damage_term) + 1

	--- 짧은 변
	self.short_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShortBase')
	--- 긴 변
	self.long_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LongBase')
	--- 높이
	self.height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')

	--- 확장 시간
	self.expand_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ExpandDuration')

	--- 사다리꼴 벡터
	local points = {
		0, self.short_base * 0.5,
		self.height, self.long_base * 0.5,
		self.height, -self.long_base * 0.5,
		0, -self.short_base * 0.5
	}

	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.info = collision_info_util.create_polygon_cube(points, bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y)
	--- 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.info)
end

function area_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <= self.height * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function area_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 판정 시작 위치
	self.position = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- area state enter
function area_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 충돌체 위치 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.position)
	--- 충돌체 방향 갱신
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator, self.dir_vector)

	--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.position + self.dir_vector, self.dir_vector)

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- play stomp sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'stomp')

	--- play explosion sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.27, 0.35)
end

--- area state exit
function area_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 영향을 준 타겟 리셋
	for each_target in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[each_target] = nil
	end
end

--- area state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param dt number del
function area_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 충돌체 계산기 시작
	area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier, self.max_hits)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, dt)

	--- 지난 프레임의 진행도
	local last_progress = 0
	--- 현재 프레임의 진행도
	local progress = math.min(time_passed / self.expand_duration, 1)

	--- 짧은 높이
	local short_height = last_progress * self.height
	--- 긴 높이
	local long_height  = progress * self.height

	--- loop ifo
	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do repeat
		if self.hit_targets[target] and self.hit_targets[target] + self.damage_term > time_passed then
			break
		end

		--- 대상 바운드
		local target_bounds = bounds_util.get_bounds(target)

		local a = vector(target_bounds.min.x, 0, target_bounds.min.z) - self.position
		local b = vector(target_bounds.min.x, 0, target_bounds.max.z) - self.position
		local c = vector(target_bounds.max.x, 0, target_bounds.max.z) - self.position
		local d = vector(target_bounds.max.x, 0, target_bounds.min.z) - self.position

		--- projection vector
		local ad = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(a, self.dir_vector))
		local bd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(b, self.dir_vector))
		local cd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(c, self.dir_vector))
		local dd = vector_util.magnitude(unity_class.vector3.Project(d, self.dir_vector))

		--- 해당 프레임의 사다리꼴 형태에 판정되어야하는지 체크
		if short_height <= ad and ad <= long_height or short_height <= bd and bd <= long_height or
			short_height <= cd and cd <= long_height or short_height <= dd and dd <= long_height then
			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier)

			self.hit_targets[target] = time_passed
		end
	until true end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 충돌체 계산기 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_duration) then
		self.action.area_machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function area_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, 1 / self.max_hits)

	--- 사운드 정보 추가
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = CS.Oak.HitSfxInfo(false, self.action.sfx_info['hit'].sfxName)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.area_state = area_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.area_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.area_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.area_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.area_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.area_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.area_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 장판 정보 동기화
	self.area_state:sync(info)
	--- 장판 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.area_machine:change(self.area_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 판정 스테이트 캔슬
	self.area_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.area_machine then self.area_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 콜라보 마암 (maam) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpMaamBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보

	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

function action_state_class:start(info)

	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 방향 고정
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- 애니 설정
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- 이펙트 설정
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner))
	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.6)

	--- 전용 영웅
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
			--- 스페셜 대사 재생
			battle_util.play_voice(self.cs_action, CS.Oak.CharacterVoiceType.Special2)
		end
	else
		--- 기본 대사 재생
		battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
