	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- unset camera darken

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--- 대상이 존재하고 대시 시작 전이면
	if self.target and battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대상 및 대상 방향 갱신과 함께 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2) then
		--- 이펙트 설정
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'tiger', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		--- 스크린 이펙트
		battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
		--- 효과음 출력
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'tiger')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.25, 0.1)
	end

	--- 대시 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(
			self.cs_action,
			self.target,
			self.dir_vector,
			0,
			self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed,
			self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale,
			CS.Oak.ShortDashState.OnBlockType.Stop,
			false,
			0
		)

		--- 애니 설정
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'dash')
		--- shake camera
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, self.dash_duration)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			local center = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
			local is_first_hit = idx == 1
			local damage_scale = self.sub_damage_scale
			--- 초회 한정 처리
			if is_first_hit then
				damage_scale = self.main_damage_scale
				--- 이펙트 출력
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'attack', center, self.dir_vector)
				--- unset camera darken
				battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
			end

			--- 효과음 출력
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'attack')
			--- shake camera
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.27, 0.15)

			area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, center + self.dir_vector * self.offset)
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			for _, target in pairs(area_collision_util.update_v2(self.calculator)) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, damage_scale)
			end

			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end

	--- 어택 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

function action_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 대미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태 이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- charge state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- setup state machine
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부

function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	return self.state_machine and not self.state_machine:is_nil_state() and self.state_machine.state:is_controlling()
end

--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부

	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true

end

--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_target_for_manual_melee(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 커맨드 생성
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.2) then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'summon',
				bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) *
						self.locked_dir * self.summon_pos_offset)

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'summon',
				bounds_util.get_center(self.character) + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) *
						self.locked_dir * self.summon_pos_offset)

		battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'summon')
	end

	--- ActionDuration이 끝나면 배틀액션을 종료시킨다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 레이저 발사 시퀀스를 싱크해서 실행한다
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.locked_dir)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)

		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	end

--- 레이저 생성 코드
function local_class:create_laser(pos, dir)
	--- 발사 위치
	local shoot_pos = pos

	--- 발사 방향 (벡터)
	local shoot_dir = dir

	--- 데미지 가하기 시작하고 레이저 이펙트 생성
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, shoot_pos)
	area_collision_util.start(self.collision_calculator)

	self.laser = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'laser', shoot_pos, shoot_dir)

	self.laser_sfx_holder = battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'laser')

	--- 소환 방향 (Direction)
	local summoned_dir = vector_util.to_direction(shoot_dir)
	local summoned_key = 'emma'

	--- 엠마 스프라이트 방향 별로 소환
	if summoned_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		summoned_key = summoned_key .. '_l'
	elseif summoned_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		summoned_key = summoned_key .. '_r'
	elseif summoned_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Up then
		summoned_key = summoned_key .. '_u'
	elseif summoned_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Down then
		summoned_key = summoned_key .. '_d'
	end

	self.summoned = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, summoned_key, shoot_pos, shoot_dir)

	--- 매 프레임 돌아가는 로직
	return function(dt)
		if area_collision_util.is_started(self.collision_calculator) then
			--- 충돌 판정 이동 및 회전
			local laser_pos = self.collision_calculator.Position + shoot_dir * self.laser_speed * dt

			if self.laser ~= nil then
				self.laser.transform.position = laser_pos
			end

			--- 소환된 스프라이트들 이동
			if self.summoned ~= nil then
				self.summoned.transform.position = laser_pos
			end

			area_collision_util.set_position(self.collision_calculator, laser_pos)
			area_collision_util.set_direction(self.collision_calculator, self.locked_dir)

			--- 충돌 판정 실행
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.collision_calculator, dt)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- 데미지 적용
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
					local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action,
							self.attack_modifier)

					--- 히트 별 공격 계수
					local scale = 1

					--- 첫 히트 시에만 별도 계수 적용
					if self.hit_targets[target] == nil then
						scale = self.main_damage_scale
						self.hit_targets[target] = true
					else
						scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.collision_calculator) - 1)
					end

					self:apply_damage(target, dps, scale)
				end
			end

			ifo_list:Dispose()

			--- 충돌 계산이 끝나면 레이저 루틴을 종료시킨다.
			if area_collision_util.is_finished(self.collision_calculator) then
				--- 화면 암전 제거
				battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

				--- 사라질 때 이펙트 생성
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'summon',
						laser_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0) * shoot_dir * self.summon_pos_offset)

				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'summon',
						laser_pos + unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, -90, 0) * shoot_dir * self.summon_pos_offset)

				battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'exit')

				self:remove_laser()
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 레이저 제거 코드
function local_class:remove_laser()
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.collision_calculator)

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.laser, true)
	self.laser = nil

	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.summoned, true)
	self.summoned = nil

	--- 레이저 효과음 페이드 아웃
	sfx_util.fade_out(self.laser_sfx_holder, 0.1)
	self.laser_sfx_holder = nil

	for target, _ in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[target] = nil
	end

	self.laser_routine = nil
end

--- 실제로 데미지를 적용하는 부분
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'hit', bounds_util.get_center(target))

	-- 데미지 전달 커맨드 실행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,

function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	local dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- 대상 방향
	local dir_vector = battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, target)

	--- extension cache
	local entity_group_extension = CS.Oak.EntityGroupsExtensions
	local bounds_extension = CS.BoundsExtensions

	--- 대상 방향으로 이동시 충돌하는 가장 가까운 대상
	local closest_object = field:GetClosestFieldObjectByLineSegment(
		self.owner.Bounds,
		entity_group_extension.DefaultHittableMask[entity_group_extension.ToIndex(self.owner.EntityGroup)],
		dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale * dir_vector
	)

	--- 이동거리 내에 충돌 대상이 없다면, 일단 타겟을 기준으로
	if closest_object == nil then
		closest_object = target
	end

	--- 충돌할 최소 거리를 구함
	local distance = math.min(
		bounds_extension.GetDistanceOnRay(self.owner.Bounds, closest_object.Bounds, dir_vector),
		dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
	)

	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target) <=
		distance + projectile_spec_util.get_explosion_radius(self.proj_spec[1])
end

	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬되었다면 처리하지 않음
	if self.is_force_canceled then return end

	self.sync_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.area)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)

	self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
end

function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	for key, _ in pairs(self.state_machine) do
		if self.state_machine[key] and self.state_machine[key].update then
			local old_time_passed = self.state_machine[key].time_passed
			self.state_machine[key].time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

			self.state_machine[key].update(self, old_time_passed, self.state_machine[key].time_passed, dt)
		end
	end
end

--region action state

--- Action 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- set locked dir
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.sync_dir_vector)

	--- set ready anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'ready')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	self.cast_fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)

	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')

	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	if battle_util.is_manual_local(self.owner) then
		stage_camera:Shake(0.05, 0.3)
	end
end

--- Action 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	--- TimeLimit 타입 이어서 알아서 사라지도록 냅둠
	self.cast_fx = nil

	--- 발사되지 않은 상태에서 캔슬시 어두워지는 효과를 없앰
	if self.state_machine.current.time_passed < self.shoot_timing or self.is_force_canceled then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

--- Action 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- 타겟 정보, 타겟 방향 갱신
		self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(
			self.cs_action, self.sync_target, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		effect_util.update_object(
			self.cast_fx, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector
		)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- set shoot anim
		battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'shoot')

		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1], bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.sync_dir_vector
		)

		self.cast_fx = nil
	end

	--- update IK
	spine_util.set_aim_point(self.owner,
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.sync_dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 차지 스테이트가 끝난 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.current, self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region area state

function local_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 등의 컨텐츠에서 캐릭터가 교체되어 게임이 터지는 것을 방지
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	local pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(hit_info.position)

	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, pos)

	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

	return true
end

--- area 스테이트 진입
function local_class:enter_area_state(_)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.owner, 'screen')

	--- instantiate explosion fx and play explosion sfx
	projectile_spec_util.instantiate_proj_explosion_fx(self.proj_spec[1], self.sync_pos)

	--- set calculator position
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator, self.sync_pos)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.5, 0.2)

	--- clear table
	for key in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[key] = nil
	end
end

--- area 스테이트 탈출
function local_class:exit_area_state(_)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)

	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
end

--- area 스테이트 업데이트 프레임
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function local_class:update_area_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	for index = 1, #self.hit_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then
			area_collision_util.start(self.calculator)

			--- 충돌체 판정 리스트
			local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.calculator, 0)

			for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
				if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
					--- 효과 배율
					local scale

					if self.hit_targets[target] then
						scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (#self.hit_timing - 1)
					else
						scale = self.main_damage_scale

						self.hit_targets[target] = true
					end

					self:apply_damage(target, self.sync_pos, scale)

				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()


			area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator)
		end
	end


	if self.hit_timing[#self.hit_timing] <= time_passed then
		--- state reset
		self:change_state(self.state_machine_key.collision, self.state.none)
	end
end
--endregion

--- 실제 대상에 데미지 처리
function local_class:apply_damage(target, position, scale)
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	local dir_vector = vector_util.normalized(vector_util.get_x0z(bounds_util.get_center(target) - position))

	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir_vector
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 오르카(mercenary) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpMercenaryBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 재탐색 거리
	second_search_range = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 거리
	max_dist = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- 재탐색 거리
	self.second_search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SecondSearchRange')

	local speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Speed')
	local life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')

	--- 최대 판정 거리
	self.max_dist = speed * life_time

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local distance = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)

	return distance <= self.max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 대상
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 대상 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	--- 대상 위치 초기화
	self.target_pos = nil
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set animation
	if self.is_exclusive_weapon then
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'action')
	else
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'actionbackup')
	end

	local spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	--- 캐스팅 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', spine_container.position, nil, spine_container, parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- play ready sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- play voice
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.12, 0.1)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 중간에 캔슬되었을 경우
	if self.current_time_passed < self.action_duration then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end

	--- remove recoil
	character_util.cancel_recoil_type_1(self.owner)

	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- remove locked dir
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 있는 경우
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing[1] then
		--- set locked direction
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)

		--- 대상이 있는 경우
		if self.target then
			self.target_pos = character_util.get_position(self.target)
		end
	end

	for index = 1, #self.shoot_timing do
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[index] - 0.07) then
			--- 캐릭터 반동
			character_util.recoil_type_1(self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.25, 0.1, 0.09, 20)
		end
	end

	--- check shoot timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[1]) then
		self.target_pos = self:shoot_proj(self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- check second shoot timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing[2]) then
		--- shoot check
		local shoot = false

		if self.target_pos then
			--- 범위 내의 ifo
			local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(self.target_pos, self.second_search_range)

			--- target loop
			for _, t in pairs(ifo_list) do
				--- check hittable target
				--- [재탐색] 부쉬 대응
				if battle_util.is_targetable(self.owner, t) and
					lua_helper.reference_equals(t, self.target) == false then
					--- shoot projectile
					self:shoot_proj(t, battle_util.get_direction_toward(self.owner, t))

					--- flag change
					shoot = true
					--- loop break
					break
				end
			end

			--- PooledSortedList dispose
			ifo_list:Dispose()
		end

		if not shoot then
			self:shoot_proj(nil, self.dir_vector, self.target_pos)
		end
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.action.state_machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- shoot proj
function action_state_class:shoot_proj(t, d, pos)
	--- target pos
	local target_pos = pos and
		pos or
		((t and self.max_dist >= battle_util.distance_xz(self.owner, t)) and
			character_util.get_position(t) or
			character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.max_dist * d)

	--- create sync info
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 발사 위치
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 대상 위치
	trigger_info_util.append_position(info, battle_util.get_ground_pos(target_pos))

	--- publish sync action
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return target_pos
end

--endregion

--region bomb state

local bomb_stat_class = {
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스

	explosion_offset = 0
}
bomb_stat_class.mt = { __index = bomb_stat_class }

--- create bomb state
function bomb_stat_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function bomb_stat_class:init(param, level)
	--- atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')

	--- aliment info
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 데미지 처리의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 처리 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = 1 - self.main_damage_scale

	--- 투사체 이동 속도
	self.speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Speed')
	--- 투사체 생존 주기
	self.life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LifeTime')
	--- 판정 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')

	--- 최대 거리
	self.max_dist = self.speed * self.life_time

	--- 기본 오프셋
	self.offset = 1.2

	--- 폭발 이펙트 가 출력될 y 위치 보정
	self.explosion_offset = 0.5

	--- 폭발 카운트
	self.explosion_count = 0

	self:apply_myth_option(param)
end

function bomb_stat_class:apply_myth_option(param)
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then
		return
	end

	self.is_active_myth_option = true

	--- 개화시엔 보정해줄 필요가 없다.
	self.explosion_offset = 0

	--- 데미지 오버라이드
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
end

--- info sync
function bomb_stat_class:sync(info)
	local start_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	local target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 1)

	local pivot_height = start_pos.y
	local diff = target_pos - start_pos
	local distance = vector_util.magnitude(diff)
	local direction = vector_util.normalized(diff)
	local xz_diff = vector_util.get_x0z(diff)
	local xz_distance = vector_util.magnitude(xz_diff)

	--- 거리에 따라 보정된 오프셋
	local current_offset = self.offset * xz_distance / self.max_dist

	local x1 = distance * 0.5
	local x2 = distance
	local y2 = target_pos.y - pivot_height

	local coefficients_a = (y2 - current_offset * x2 / x1) / ((x2 - x1) * x2)
	local coefficients_b = (current_offset - x1 * x1 * coefficients_a) / x1

	local fx = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', start_pos)
	local trail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'trail', start_pos)

	--- instantiate fire effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'fire', start_pos, -direction)

	--- play shoot sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'shoot')

	table.insert(self.proj.fx, fx)
	table.insert(self.proj.trail, trail)
	table.insert(self.proj.time_passed, 0)
	table.insert(self.proj.life_time, distance / self.speed)
	table.insert(self.proj.start_pos, start_pos)
	table.insert(self.proj.target_pos, target_pos)
	table.insert(self.proj.direction, direction)
	table.insert(self.proj.pivot_height, pivot_height)
	table.insert(self.proj.a, coefficients_a)
	table.insert(self.proj.b, coefficients_b)
end

--- bomb state enter
function bomb_stat_class:enter(_)
end

--- bomb state exit
function bomb_stat_class:exit(_)
	self:reset()

	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
end

--- bomb state update frame
--- @param dt number delta time
function bomb_stat_class:update(_, _, dt)
	for index = #self.proj.fx, 1, -1 do
		local old_time_passed = self.proj.time_passed[index]
		local time_passed = old_time_passed + dt

		local progress = time_passed / self.proj.life_time[index]

		local x = time_passed * self.speed
		local height = self.proj.a[index] * x * x + self.proj.b[index] * x + self.proj.pivot_height[index]
		local current_pos = vector_util.lerp(self.proj.start_pos[index], self.proj.target_pos[index], progress)

		local fx_pos = vector_util.get_x0z(current_pos, height)

		effect_util.update_object(self.proj.fx[index], fx_pos)
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj.trail[index], fx_pos)

		local shadow_setter = self.proj.fx[index]:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.StageShadowSetter))
		shadow_setter.Position = fx_pos

		self.proj.time_passed[index] = time_passed

		if progress >= 1 then
			if not self.screen_fx_checker then
				--- instantiate screen fx
				battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner, 'screen')

				--- flag
				self.screen_fx_checker = true

				--- unset darken
				battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.3)
			end

			--- on explosion
			self:on_explosion(current_pos)

			--- remove proj
			self:remove_proj(index)
		end
	end

	self.current_time_passed = 0
end

function bomb_stat_class:on_explosion(position)

	local rand_dir = nil

	--- 개화가 적용중이라면 랜덤하게 회전을 적용시킨다.
	if self.is_active_myth_option then
		rand_dir = unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, random_util.get_random_value() * 360, 0) * vector_util.forward
	end

	--- instantiate explosion effect
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', position + self.explosion_offset * vector_util.up, rand_dir)

	--- play explosion sfx
	if self.is_active_myth_option and self.explosion_count == 0 then
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion_0')
	else
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
	end

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_radius(position, self.radius)

	for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 대상이 공격 가능한 경우
		if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, target) then
			--- 상황에 따른 scale
			local scale = self.hit_targets[target] == nil and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale

			--- hit check
			self.hit_targets[target] = true

			--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- shake camera
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.075, 0.1)

	--- 카운트 증가
	self.explosion_count = self.explosion_count + 1
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function bomb_stat_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()

	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, scale)
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

function bomb_stat_class:reset()
	--- clear table
	for key in pairs(self.hit_targets) do
		self.hit_targets[key] = nil
	end

	for index = #self.proj.fx, 1, -1 do
		--- instantiate explosion effect
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action, 'explosion', self.proj.fx[index].transform.localPosition + self.explosion_offset * vector_util.up
		)

		--- remove proj
		self:remove_proj(index)
	end

	self.screen_fx_checker = false
	self.explosion_count = 0
end

function bomb_stat_class:remove_proj(index)
	--- dispose proj fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.fx[index])
	--- dispose trail fx
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj.trail[index])

	table.remove(self.proj.fx, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.trail, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.time_passed, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.life_time, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.start_pos, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.target_pos, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.direction, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.pivot_height, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.a, index)
	table.remove(self.proj.b, index)
end

---endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params)
	--- state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- area state
	self.bomb_state = bomb_stat_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- area state machine
	self.bomb_machine = simple_state_machine:new(self.bomb_state, self)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.bomb_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.bomb_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.bomb_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.bomb_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀 액션에 필요한 모든 에셋의 로드 여부
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	--- 프리셋 로드 여부
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀 액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 빈 state 인 경우에 사용 가능
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return false
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 이 배틀 액션은 항상 캔슬 가능함
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비 변경 시 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	--- 타겟 정보 추가
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	--- 폭탄 스테이트 초기화
	self.bomb_state:reset()

	--- 액션 정보 동기화
	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 폭탄 정보 동기화
	self.bomb_state:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 폭탄 스테이트 초기화
	self.bomb_state:reset()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.bomb_machine then self.bomb_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 바다의 만물상 시아 (mermaid) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpMermaidBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 싱크 타이밍
	sync_timing = nil,
	--- 오프셋
	offset = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 싱크 타이밍
	self.sync_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SyncTiming')
	--- 오프셋
	self.offset = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Offset')
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- set anim
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action, 'cast', character_util.get_position(self.owner), nil, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
	)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- play sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- camera shake
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.1)

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove anim
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	if self.current_time_passed < self.sync_timing then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 사출 타이밍 까지는 방향 갱신
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.sync_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 사출 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.sync_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * self.offset)
		--- 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)
		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 판정 반지름
	radius = nil,
	--- 판정 계산기
	calculator = nil,

	--- 판정 시점
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 히트 수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 마지막 히트 시점
	last_hit_timing = nil,
	--- 암전 해제 타이밍
	darken_end_timing = nil,

	--- main damage scale
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- sub damage scale
	sub_damage_scale = nil,

	--- 첫타 보정 처리를 위한 셋

	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간

}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create field state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

--- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 반지름
	self.radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 높이
	local height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y
	--- 개별 판정 길이
	local hit_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'HitDuration')

	--- 판정 타이밍
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')
	--- 싱크 타이밍
	local sync_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SyncTiming')
	--- 판정 수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 판정체 목록
	self.calculator = {}

	--- 동기화 시점에 해당 state가 생겼음으로 hit_timing을 보정해준다.
	for idx = 1, self.max_hit do
		self.hit_timing[idx] = self.hit_timing[idx] - sync_timing
		--- 판정 정보
		local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(self.radius, height, hit_duration, nil, nil, true)
		--- 판정 계산기 생성
		table.insert(self.calculator, area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info, nil, nil, 1))
	end

	--- 마지막 판정 시점
	self.last_hit_timing = self.hit_timing[self.max_hit] + hit_duration
	--- 암전 해제 타이밍
	self.darken_end_timing = self.hit_timing[math.max(self.max_hit - 1, 1)]

	--- main damage scale
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- sub damage scale
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)

	self.hit_targets_set = lua_collection_util.create_hashset()

	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = (self.radius * 2 * self.max_hit) * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- hittable check
function field_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	--- 대상까지 거리
	local dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	--- hittable distance 가 유효한지
	return dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- sync action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 생성 위치
	self.target_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
end

--- field state exit
function field_state_class:exit(_)
	self.hit_targets_set:clear()

	--- 판정 계산기 종료
	for _, calculator in pairs(self.calculator) do
		area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
	end

	if self.current_time_passed < self.darken_end_timing then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- field state dispose
function field_state_class:dispose()
	self.hit_targets_set:dispose()
end

function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	for idx, calculator in pairs(self.calculator) do
		--- 판정 시점이 아니라면 생략함
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[idx]) then
			--- 판정 위치
			local current_offset = self.radius + self.radius * 2 * (idx - 1)
			local calc_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.target_pos + self.dir_vector * current_offset)

			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'tornado', calc_pos)
			--- 처음 한번만 효과음 출력
			if idx == 1 then
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'tornado')
			end

			--- camera shake
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)

			--- 판정 세팅
			area_collision_util.set_position(calculator, calc_pos)
			area_collision_util.start(calculator)
		end

		--- 판정이 동작 중일 경우 처리
		if area_collision_util.is_started(calculator) then
			--- 판정 처리
			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(calculator, dt)

			--- 유효 대상이 없다면 생략함
			if #hit_targets > 0 then
				--- 모디파이어 계산
				local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

				--- 대상 순회
				for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
					local scale = self.hit_targets_set:add(target) and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
					self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
				end
			end

			--- 판정이 종료할 필요가 있을 경우 처리
			if area_collision_util.is_finished(calculator) then
				area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
			end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.darken_end_timing) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 판정 처리를 완료했으면 상태를 이탈함
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.last_hit_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- action state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_state_and_params(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.field_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- field state가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.field_state then return end

	self.field_state:sync(info)
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 별무리 서기장 레나 (milkyway_girl) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpMilkywayGirlBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- set animation
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'cast_fallback')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'cast',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner),
		nil,
		spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner),
		parent_follow_flag.position
	)

	--- cast sound
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- instantiate cast fx
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(
		self.action,
		'shoot',
		bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)
end

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- unset camera darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 1.2)
	--- remove locked direction
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	--- remove animation
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
end

--- action state update

--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 위로 쏘아올리는 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then

		--- 싱크 정보 구성
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 타겟 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, self.target)

		--- 방향 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.dir_vector)

		--- 오너 위치 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end

	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)
	--- 투사체 최대거리
	self.proj_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])

	--- 별똥별 떨어트릴 높이
	self.drop_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DropHeight')

	--- 무기 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

---- parsing option data
function field_state_class:apply_option(param)
	--- 옵션 아이디
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	--- 옵션 적용 확인
	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 옵션 적용시
	if activate_option then
		--- 전용 옵션 발동 여부
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 롤액션 증가할 카운트
		self.increase_count = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'IncreaseCount')
	end
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 최초 떨어질 위치를 조정해준다.
	self.last_sequence_pos = character_util.get_position(self.owner)

	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 싱크 위치 초기화
	self.last_sequence_pos = nil

	if self.current_time_passed < 0.1 then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.1) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 1.2)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.sync_count do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.drop_timing[idx]) then
			break
		end

		--- 트리거 정보 추가
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		--- 이전 위치 캐싱
		local prev_pos = self.last_sequence_pos

		--- 대상 타겟이 너무 멀어졌으면 놓친다.
		if self.target and not character_util.is_dead(self.target)
			and vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(self.target) - self.last_sequence_pos).magnitude > self.refresh_range then

			self.target = nil
		end

		--- 타겟이 없거나 죽으면 재탐색
		if not self.target or character_util.is_dead(self.target) then
			self.target = self:get_closest_target(self.attack_range, prev_pos);
		end

		--- 대상 타겟이 죽지 않았을 때만 싱크 위치를 갱신해줌
		if self.target and not character_util.is_dead(self.target) then

			local target_dir = vector_util.get_x0z(character_util.get_position(self.target) - self.last_sequence_pos)

			--- 대상과의 거리가 attack range 내에 들어오면 대상 위치로, 아니면 그만큼 다가감
			if target_dir.magnitude <= self.chase_range then
				self.last_sequence_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(character_util.get_position(self.target))
			else
				self.last_sequence_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(prev_pos + self.chase_range * target_dir.normalized)
			end

			--- 떨어질 방향도 갱신
			if not vector_util.almost_close_to(self.last_sequence_pos, prev_pos) then
				self.drop_direction = (self.last_sequence_pos - prev_pos).x > 0 and vector_util.left or vector_util.right
			end

		elseif idx == 1 then
			--- 대상 타겟이 없는데 최초 시퀀스일 경우, 적절한 사출위치를 잡아준다.
			self.last_sequence_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(prev_pos + self.attack_range * self.dir_vector)
			self.drop_direction = self.dir_vector.x > 0 and vector_util.left or vector_util.right
		end

		--- 떨어질 위치 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_position(info, self.last_sequence_pos)

		--- 떨어질 방향 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, self.drop_direction)

		--- 히트타이밍 개수 싱크
		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, #self.hit_timing)

		--- 히트타이밍 싱크
		for hit_idx = 1, #self.hit_timing do
			trigger_info_util.append_number(info, self.hit_timing[hit_idx] + self.drop_timing[idx])
		end

		--- 싱크 정보 배포
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	until true end

	for idx = #self.sequence_list, 1, -1 do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍이 아니라면 생략
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.sequence_list[idx].timing) then
			break
		end

		local sequence = table.remove(self.sequence_list, idx)

		local fx_random_pos = sequence.fx_pos

		--- instantiate cast fx
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(
			self.action,
			'explosion',
			fx_random_pos
		)

		--- cast sound
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

		--- 별똥별을 쏴줄 위치를 잡아준다.
		local fx_shoot_pos = fx_random_pos
			+ (vector_util.up + vector_util.forward) * self.drop_height
			+ (sequence.drop_direction * (random_util.get_random_value() + 1))

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(
			self.shoot_helper[1],
			fx_shoot_pos,
			vector_util.normalized(fx_random_pos - fx_shoot_pos),
			nil,
			nil,
			nil,
			false,
			nil,
			fx_random_pos
		)

		--- camera shake
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.17)

		--- 판정 체크
		local fo_list = area_collision_util.calculate_once(self.calculator, sequence.position)

		--- 피격 대상이 없다면 생략함
		if #fo_list == 0 then
			break
		end

		--- 액션 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 데미지 부여
		for _, fo in pairs(fo_list) do
			self:apply_damage(fo, modifier, 1 / 9)
		end

		--- 무옵이 적용중이면 롤액션 카운트를 증가한다.
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			self:increase_hit_count()
		end

	until true end

	--- 예정된 end timing 이 끝나고 들어와있는 시퀀스가 다 끝나야 종료.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.end_timing) and #self.sequence_list <= 0 then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

--- battle_util.get_closest_target 를 참조해 재 작성한 코드
--- 이 cwp 에서 사용하기 위해 다시 작성하였다.
function field_state_class:get_closest_target(range, pos)
	--- 배틀액션의 오너
	local owner = self.owner

	local targets = {}
	local directions = {}

	local count = 1

	--- 범위 내의 ifo
	local ifo_list = battle_util.get_field_objects_in_cylinder(
		pos + (vector_util.up * (owner.Bounds.size.y * 0.5)),
		range,
		owner.Bounds.size.y * 2
	)

	--- ifo 루프
	for _, ifo in pairs(ifo_list) do
		--- 부쉬 상태 체크 / 대상이 공격 가능한 경우 체크
		if battle_util.is_targetable(owner, ifo) then
			table.insert(targets, ifo)
			table.insert(directions, vector_util.normalized(ifo.Position - pos))

			if #targets >= count then
				break
			end
		end
	end

	--- PooledSortedList dispose
	ifo_list:Dispose()

	--- 대상이 없을 경우 바라보는 방향을 넣어줌
	if #targets == 0 then
		table.insert(directions, direction_util.to_vector3(character_util.get_look_direction(owner)))
	end

	return targets[1], directions[1]
end

--- 롤액션 카운트 증가
function field_state_class:increase_hit_count()
	--- 캐싱된 액션이 없으면 탐색한다.
	if self.role_action == nil then
		self.role_action = battle_util.get_role_action(self.owner)
	end

	--- 역할 액션이 있을 때, 별 파편 획득 싱크를 날림
	if self.role_action then
		local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_integer(info, self.increase_count)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.role_action, info)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--- field state 시작 싱크
function field_state_class:sync_start(info)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
	self.owner_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- 각 시퀀스의 시작부분 싱크
function field_state_class:sync_sequence(info)

	--- 이번 시퀀스에서 운석이 떨어질 갯수
	local sequence_count = trigger_info_util.get_integer_at(info, 0)

	local random_angle = random_util.get_random_value() * 360

	for idx = 1, sequence_count do
		local sequence = {}

		--- 이번 시퀀스에서 운석이 떨어질 타이밍
		sequence.timing = trigger_info_util.get_number_at(info, idx - 1)

		--- 이번 시퀀스의 목표 지점
		sequence.position = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0))

		--- 이번 시퀀스의 방향
		sequence.drop_direction = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

		--- 목표지점 중심으로 120도를 계산해 랜덤하게 fx 위치를 정해줌
		local angle = math.rad(random_angle)
		random_angle = random_angle + 120
		sequence.fx_pos = sequence.position + (vector(math.cos(angle), 0, math.sin(angle)) * 0.8)

		--- 시퀀스 리스트에 밀어넣어줌
		table.insert(self.sequence_list, sequence)
	end
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)
	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.action_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if not self.action_state or self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	--- direction 여부에 따라 다른 싱크 로직
	if not trigger_info_util.contains_number(info) then
		self.field_state:sync_start(info)
		self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)

	else
		self.field_state:sync_sequence(info)
	end
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	if not self.field_machine then return end

	self.action_state.force_cancel = true
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- No.9 미스 크롬 (ms_chrome) 라이플 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpMsChromeBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 탐색 거리
	search_range = nil,
	--- cs projectile shooter
	cs_shooter = nil,
	--- shoot helper
	shoot_helper = nil,
	--- projectile spec
	proj_spec = nil,
	--- 발사 타이밍
	shoot_timing = nil,
	--- 발사 오프셋
	shoot_offset = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 전용 무기 여부
	is_exclusive_weapon = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그
	force_cancel = false,
	--- 대상
	target = nil,
	--- 대상 방향
	dir_vector = nil
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, _)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 탐색 거리
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')

	--- 발사 타이밍
	self.shoot_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ShootTiming')

	--- cs projectile shooter
	self.cs_shooter = battle_util.create_lua_shooter(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 파싱된 projectile 데이터
	self.shoot_helper, self.proj_spec = battle_util.parse_projectile_param(self.cs_shooter, param)

	--- 발사 오프셋
	self.shoot_offset = weapon_util.get_shoot_offset(character_util.get_weapon(self.owner)) or 0.5

	--- 투사체 최대 거리
	local projectile_max_dist = projectile_spec_util.get_max_distance(self.proj_spec[1])
	--- hittable distance
	self.hittable_dist = projectile_max_dist * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	--- 전용 무기 여부
	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

--- @return boolean 제어 여부

	--- 항상 제어

end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 항상 캔슬 가능
	return true
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)

	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 초기화
	self.force_cancel = false

	--- 방향 고정 요청
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	--- 캐스트 애니메이션 재생
	battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.19, 0.2)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 공격 시점 이전에 캔슬되었을때
	if self.current_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_upper_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 대상이 존재하고 공격 타이밍 이전일때
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.shoot_timing then
		--- 대상 및 대상 방향 갱신과 함께 방향 고정
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- IK 갱신
	spine_util.set_aim_point(
		self.owner, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	)

	--- 공격 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.shoot_timing) then
		--- 발사 애니메이션 재생
		battle_util.set_upper_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'fire')

		--- 캐릭터 반동
		character_util.recoil_type_1(
			self.owner, self.dir_vector, 0.7, 0.2, (self.action_duration - self.shoot_timing) * 1.2, 5
		)

		--- 발사 위치
		local shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.shoot_offset * self.dir_vector

		--- 투사체 발사 효과 생성
		projectile_spec_util.instantiate_shoot_fx(
			self.proj_spec[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		)

		--- 투사체 발사
		shoot_helper_util.shoot_direction_at_position(self.shoot_helper[1], shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보
--- @return boolean 현재 프로젝타일을 소멸시킬지 여부
function action_state_class:on_hit(_, hit_info, _)
	--- 길드성 dispose 관련 방어
	if self.shoot_helper == nil or self.proj_spec == nil then return true end

	--- 만료된 상태
	local proj_expired = hit_info.hitType == projectile_hit_type.self_destruction
	--- 현재 부딪힌 대상이 유효한지
	local valid_target = battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.owner, hit_info.target)

	--- 투사체가 만료된 상태도 아니고, 대상이 유효하지도 않을 경우
	if not proj_expired and not valid_target then
		--- 전반 처리 없는 상태로 만료되지 않음
		return false
	end

	--- 싱크 정보 생성
	local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
	--- 폭발 위치 싱크
	trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, hit_info.position)

	--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

	--- 투사체 만료
	return true
end

--endregion

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
