	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 데미지 타입
	damage_type = nil,
	--- 공격력 계수
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	aliment_info = nil,
	--- 판정 타이밍
	hit_timing = nil,
	--- 폭발 판정 계산기
	explosion_calculator = nil,
	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	max_hit = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	main_damage_scale = nil,
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	sub_damage_scale = nil,
	--- hittable distance
	hittable_dist = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 폭발 위치
	explosion_pos = nil
}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 데미지 타입
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- 공격력 계수
	self.atk_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase') +
		cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd') * level

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.aliment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param)

	--- 판정 시점
	self.hit_timing = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	--- 판정 반지름
	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Radius')
	--- 판정 정보
	local collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(radius, 3, nil, nil, nil, true)
	--- 폭발 계산기
	self.explosion_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, collision_info)

	--- 최대 판정 횟수
	self.max_hit = #self.hit_timing

	--- 데미지 판정의 메인 계수
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- 데미지 판정의 서브 계수
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale) / (self.max_hit - 1)
end

function field_state_class:sync(info)
	--- 폭발 위치 싱크
	self.explosion_pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info)
end

--- 판정 상태 진입
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)

	--- 폭발 계산기 위치 설정
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.explosion_calculator, self.explosion_pos)
end

--- 판정 상태 탈출
function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- unset darken
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
end

--- 판정 상태 갱신
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 판정 타이밍 순회
	for index = 1, self.max_hit do repeat
		--- 판정 타이밍 검증
		if not battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.hit_timing[index]) then break end

		--- 메인 계수를 적용할 타격인지
		local main_hit = index == 1

		--- 첫 폭발 시점
		if main_hit then
			--- 폭발 이펙트 생성
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explosion', self.explosion_pos)
			--- 폭발 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')

			--- 세고 짧은 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)
		else
			--- 폭발 사운드 재생
			battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'sub')

			--- 약하고 긴 카메라 흔들기
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.2)
		end

		--- 상황에 맞는 스케일
		local scale = main_hit and self.main_damage_scale or self.sub_damage_scale
		--- 데미지 계수 계산
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier) * scale

		--- 폭발 충돌체 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.explosion_calculator)

		--- 충돌체 계산기 갱신
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.explosion_calculator)

		--- 타겟 리스트 순회
		for _, each_target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			--- 데미지 적용
			self:apply_damage(each_target, modifier, scale)
		end

		--- PooledList 해지
		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 폭발 충돌체 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.explosion_calculator)

		--- 마지막 판정인 경우
		if index == self.max_hit then
			--- state reset
			self.machine:change(nil)
		end
	until true end
end

--- 실제 데미지 커맨드 발행
function field_state_class:apply_damage(t, m, s)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = t
	damage_info.modifier = m
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	--- 상태이상 적용
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.aliment_info, s)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
		cs_action, params
	)

	--- 액션 상태
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 판정 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	do

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state, self.field_state)

		self.action_state = nil
		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		--- 데이터 해지
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil

	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()

end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟을 가져옴
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_closest_target_simple(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 유효할 때
	if target then
		--- 대상 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- 방향 정보 추가
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름

	self.action_state:start(info)
	--- 액션 스테이트 머신 동작
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

--- 배틀 액션 캔슬 시 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then
		return
	end

	--- 판정 정보 동기화
	self.field_state:sync(info)
	--- 판정 머신 동작
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	--- 내부 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	--- 판정 스테이트 업데이트
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 프로젝타일이 상대방에게 맞았을 때 불리는 콜백
--- @param move_info any Projectile.MoveInfo 프로젝타일의 움직임 정보
--- @param hit_info any Projectile.HitInfo 프로젝타일의 피격 정보

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)

local local_class = newclass('CwpNecromancerBattleAction')

--필수 구현
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.character = c
	self.level = level

	--- get atk modifier
	self.attack_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierBase') +
			cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ModifierAdd') * level
	--- get damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(params, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- create aliment info
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(params)

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(
			cs_action, params)

	--- get action duration
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 스킬을 실제로 시전하는 타이밍
	self.cast_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'CastTime')

	--- 타겟 찾는 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'SearchRange')

	--- 강제로 종료 되었는지 체크
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	--- 싱크된 타겟
	self.locked_target = nil

	--- 싱크된 방향
	self.locked_dir = nil

	--- 손아귀 데미지 & 상태 이상 계수
	self.proj_damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileModifier')

	--- 손아귀 진행 속도
	self.proj_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileSpeed')

	--- 손아귀의 크기
	self.proj_size = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileSize')

	--- 손아귀 라이프 타임
	self.proj_life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'ProjectileLifeTime')

	--- 장판 판정 라이프 타임
	self.aoe_life_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOELifeTime')

	--- 장판이 줄어들기 시작하는 시간
	self.aoe_shrink_time = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOEShrinkTime')

	--- 장판이 줄어들기 시작하는 속도
	self.aoe_shrink_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOEShrinkSpeed')

	--- 장판 충돌 계산기
	self.aoe_width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOEWidth')
	local aoe_size = unity_class.vector3(0.1, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y, self.aoe_width)
	local aoe_damage_term = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOEDamageTerm')

	--- 때릴 수 있는 최대 히트 수
	local max_num_hits = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(params, 'MaxNumHits')

	self.aoe_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(aoe_size, self.aoe_life_time, aoe_damage_term,
			true)
	self.aoe_collision_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.character, self.aoe_collision_info, true, 0,
			max_num_hits)

	--- 장판 데미지 & 상태 이상 계수
	self.aoe_damage_modifier = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(params, 'AOEModifier')

	--- 장판 딜 들어가는 시퀀스
	self.aoe_routine = nil

	self.state = {
		none = {
			enter = function(prev_state) end,
			exit = function(next_state) end,
			update = function(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt) end,
			time_passed = 0
		},
		action = {
			enter = self.enter_action_state,
			exit = self.exit_action_state,
			update = self.update_action_state,
			time_passed = 0
		}
	}

	self.current_state = self.state.none
end

--- 현재 스테이트를 바꿔준다
function local_class:change_state(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.current_state
	if prev_state.exit then
		prev_state.exit(self, new_state)
	end

	--- 현재 스테이트 갱신
	self.current_state = new_state

	self.current_state.time_passed = 0

	if new_state.enter then
		new_state.enter(self, prev_state)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info)
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.current_state == self.state.none
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 이 배틀액션은 항상 캐릭터를 제어함
	return self.current_state == self.state.action
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.current_state == self.state.action
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.character, target) <=
			self.search_range * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

	local target, dir = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.search_range)

	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir)

	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.character, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 배틀 액션이 실제로 시작하는 부분
function local_class:start(info)
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true
	self.is_force_canceled = false

	self.locked_target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info, 0)
	self.locked_dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:change_state(self.state.action)
end

--- 배틀 액션 실행 도중에 취소가 될 경우에 호출
function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	self:change_state(self.state.none)

	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	if self.is_force_canceled then
		return
	end

	--- 장판 발사
	local pos = trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info, 0)
	local dir = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info, 0)

	self:remove_aoe()
	self.aoe_routine = self:create_aoe(pos, dir)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	self.is_force_canceled = true

	if self.aoe_routine ~= nil then
		self:remove_aoe()
	end
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	local old_time_passed = self.current_state.time_passed
	self.current_state.time_passed = self.current_state.time_passed + dt

	--- 현재 스테이트 업데이트
	self.current_state.update(self, old_time_passed, self.current_state.time_passed, dt)

	--- 장판 루틴 진행
	if self.aoe_routine ~= nil then
		self.aoe_routine(dt)
	end
end

--- 배틀 액션 관련 변수들 모두 해제
function local_class:dispose()
	-- 싱크된 데이터 해제
	self.locked_target = nil
	self.locked_dir = nil

	self.aoe_collision_info = nil
	self.aoe_collision_calculator = nil
	self.aoe_routine = nil

	--- 스테이트 관련 해제
	self.state = nil
	self.current_state = nil

	--- Json 기반 변수들 해제
	battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)
	self.animation_info = nil
	self.emotion_info = nil
	self.preset_info = nil
	self.sfx_info = nil

	self.ailment_info = nil
	self.damage_type = nil

	--- 변수 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.character = nil
	self.level = nil
end

function local_class:enter_action_state(_)
	--- 애니메이션 실행
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'cast')

	--- VFX 실행
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'cast', self.character.Position, nil,
			spine_util.get_spine_container(self.character))
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self, self.character, 'screen')

	--- SFX 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'cast')
	battle_util.default_shake_and_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 화면 암전
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.2)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.03, self.cast_time)

	--- 캐릭터를 특정 방향으로 고정시켜줌.
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.locked_dir)
end

function local_class:exit_action_state(_)
	--- 애니메이션 제거
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_emotion(self.cs_action)

	--- 화면 암전 제거
	battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)

	--- 캐릭터 방향 고정시키던 것 제거
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
end

function local_class:update_action_state(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	self.locked_target, self.locked_dir = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.locked_target,
			self.locked_dir)

	--- 캐스트 타임이 되면 그 때 장판 발사
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.cast_time) then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.character)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.character))
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.locked_dir)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.character, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- ActionDuration이 끝나면 배틀액션을 종료시킨다.
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- 스테이트 리셋
		self:change_state(self.state.none)

		--- 배틀액션 비활성화
		self.cs_action.IsActive = false

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.character, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--- 실제 장판을 만들고 update까지 실행하는 루틴
function local_class:create_aoe(fire_pos, fire_dir)
	---VFX & SFX 생성
	battle_util.set_anim(self, self.cs_action, 'fire')
	battle_util.set_emotion(self, self.cs_action, 'fire')
	--battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'fire', fire_pos, fire_dir)
	battle_util.play_sfx(self, 'fire')

	--battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'aoe', battle_util.get_ground_pos(fire_pos), fire_dir)

	--- 손아귀 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self, 'proj', battle_util.get_ground_pos(fire_pos), fire_dir)

	local proj_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(fire_pos)

	--- 장판 루틴 지난 시간
	local aoe_old_time_passed = 0
	local aoe_time_passed = 0

	--- 충돌 판정 설정
	self.aoe_collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(self.proj_size * 0.5, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y,
			self.aoe_width)
	area_collision_util.set_position(self.aoe_collision_calculator, fire_pos)
	area_collision_util.set_direction(self.aoe_collision_calculator, fire_dir)

	area_collision_util.start(self.aoe_collision_calculator)

	--- 현재 얼마나 히트했는지 체크하는 테이블
	local hit_target_table = {}

	return function(dt)
		aoe_old_time_passed = aoe_time_passed
		aoe_time_passed = aoe_time_passed + dt

		--- 손아귀 이펙트 이동 처리 및 장판 범위 조정
		--- 장판 충돌 크기 증가 처리
		if aoe_time_passed < self.proj_life_time then
			--- 손아귀 이펙트 이동 처리
			proj_pos = proj_pos + fire_dir * self.proj_speed * dt

			local dist = vector_util.distance(proj_pos, self.aoe_collision_calculator.Position) + self.proj_size * 0.5
			self.aoe_collision_info.Size = unity_class.vector3(dist, bounds_util.get_size(self.character).y,
					self.aoe_width)
		end

		--- 장판 충돌 크기 감소 처리
		if aoe_time_passed > self.aoe_shrink_time then
			local current_size = self.aoe_collision_info.Size
			current_size.x = current_size.x - self.aoe_shrink_speed * dt

			--- 음수 사이즈 방지용
			local move = math.max(unity_class.mathf.Sign(current_size.x), 0)

			self.aoe_collision_info.Size = current_size * move

			--- 사이즈 대응해서 위치 업데이트
			local current_pos = self.aoe_collision_calculator.Position
			current_pos = current_pos + (fire_dir * self.aoe_shrink_speed * dt) * move
			self.aoe_collision_calculator.Position = current_pos
		end

		--- 장판 데미지 처리
		local ifo_list = area_collision_util.update(self.aoe_collision_calculator, dt)
		local dps = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.attack_modifier)

		for _, target in pairs(ifo_list) do
			if battle_util.is_hittable_target(self.character, target) then
				--- 히트 수 기록 및 데미지 생성
				if hit_target_table[target] == nil then
					hit_target_table[target] = 1
					self:apply_damage(target, dps, self.proj_damage_modifier, fire_dir)
				else
					hit_target_table[target] = hit_target_table[target] + 1
					local scale = self.aoe_damage_modifier / (area_collision_util.get_max_hit(self.aoe_collision_calculator) - 1)
					self:apply_damage(target, dps, scale, fire_dir)
				end
			end
		end

		ifo_list:Dispose()

		--- 장판 라이프타임 끝나면 제거
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(aoe_old_time_passed, aoe_time_passed, self.aoe_life_time) then
			self:remove_aoe()
		end
	end
end

--- 장판 제거
function local_class:remove_aoe()
	--- 데미지 계산 제거
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.aoe_collision_calculator)
	self.aoe_routine = nil
end

--- 실제로 데미지를 적용하는 부분
function local_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale, dir)
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.character
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.direction = dir
	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	-- 데미지 전달 커맨드 실행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)

	stage_camera:Shake(0.06, 0.15)
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 상급 닌자 나츠메 (ninja_leader) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpNinjaLeaderBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then
		return
	end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- attack timing
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- state 끝나는 타이밍.
	self.state_end_timing = self.action_duration

	self:apply_option(param)
end

function action_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	if activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 무옵이 적용되었을 경우 이 state 가 끝나는 타이밍이 attack timing 이 되어야 한다.
		self.state_end_timing = self.attack_timing
	end
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return false
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	return true
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- set animation
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast_cwp')
	else
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'cast')
	end

	--- set locked direction
	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)
	--- play cast sfx
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.05)
	--- instantiate screen fx
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	--- 끝날 때 방향을 dir vector 으로 돌려줌
	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, vector_util.to_direction(self.dir_vector))
	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	--- 고정 방향 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	if self.current_time_passed < 0.05 then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.05) then
		--- unset camera darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 1)
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.state_end_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--region field state

local field_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- damage type
	damage_type = nil,
	--- atk modifier
	atk_modifier = nil,
	--- 상태이상 정보
	ailment_info = nil,

	--- 분신 스파인 최대치
	mirage_stack = nil,
	--- 분신 스파인 알파
	mirage_alpha = nil,
	--- 분신 스파인 게임 오브젝트
	mirage_objects = {},
	--- 분신 스파인 컨트롤러
	mirage_spines = {},
	--- 현재 분신 스파인 상태
	current_visual_state = {},
	--- 분신 오프셋
	current_move_offset = {},
	--- 분신 외형 상태
	mirage_visual_state = nil,

	--- 분신 스파인 로드 완료 여부

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,

}
field_state_class.mt = { __index = field_state_class }

--- create action state
function field_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	--- 충돌체 길이
	self.attack_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackRange')

	--- 나는 시간
	self.flying_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'FlyingDuration')

	--- attack timing
	self.attack_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AttackTiming')

	--- 비행 끝나는 시간
	self.flying_timing = self.attack_timing + self.flying_duration

	--- slash effect timing
	self.slash_effect_timing = 0.15

	--- 돌아오는 시간
	self.return_duration = self.flying_duration / 2

	--- 돌아올 때
	self.return_timing = self.attack_timing + (self.flying_duration / 2)

	--- 충돌체 폭
	local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Width')
	--- 충돌체 길이
	self.collision_length = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Length')
	--- 판정 높이
	self.collision_height = bounds_util.get_size(self.owner).y

	--- 충돌체 크기
	local collision_size = vector(self.collision_length, self.collision_height, width)
	--- 충돌체 정보
	self.collision_info = collision_info_util.create_rotatable_cube(collision_size, self.flying_duration)

	--- max hit
	self.max_hit = 1

	--- 발사 시 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator_shoot = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)
	--- 회수 시 충돌체 계산기
	self.calculator_return = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, self.collision_info, nil, nil, self.max_hit)

	--- main damage scale
	self.main_damage_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainDamageScale')
	--- sub damage scale
	self.sub_damage_scale = (1 - self.main_damage_scale)

	--- 옵션 적용
	self:apply_option(param)
end

function field_state_class:apply_option(param)
	local option_id = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(param, 'CwpOptionId')

	local activate_option, option_param = battle_util.parse_option_data(option_id, self.owner)

	--- 무옵이 적용중에만 분신을 소환해야 한다.
	if activate_option then
		self.activate_cwp_option = true

		--- 무옵 적용시 버프
		self.cwp_buff_info = buff_util.parse_buff_info(option_param, 'CwpBuff')

		--- 속성 조건
		self.target_elemental = CS.Oak.ElementalType.Ice

		--- 분신 표기 상태
		self.mirage_visual_state = {
			hide = 0,
			show = 1,
			fade = 2
		}

		--- 분신 스파인 알파
		self.mirage_alpha = 0.8

		--- 분신 스파인 최대치
		self.mirage_stack = cs_util.get_int_from_dictionary(option_param, 'OverrideMirageStack')

		--- 무옵 적용시 늘어날 크기
		local width = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(option_param, 'OverrideCollisionWidth')

		self.collision_info.Size = vector(self.collision_length, self.collision_height, width)

		--- 분신 스파인 생성
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(self.owner, util.cs_generator(self.create_mirage_spine, self))
	end
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function field_state_class:start(info)
	--- 목표 방향
	self.dir_vector = vector_util.get_x0z(trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info))
	--- 발사 포지션
	self.shoot_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner) + self.dir_vector * 0.5

	--- 무옵 적용시 왼쪽에 한개 더 만들어줘야 하는 위치
	self.left_additional_pos = vector(-self.dir_vector.z, 0, self.dir_vector.x)
	--- 무옵 적용시 오른쪽에 한개 더 만들어줘야 하는 위치
	self.right_additional_pos = vector(self.dir_vector.z, 0, -self.dir_vector.x)
end

--- field state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)
	local ground_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(self.shoot_pos)
	local look_dir = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)

	--- 무옵 적용중이면
	if self.activate_cwp_option then

		--- 수속성 아군들 버프적용
		local stage_members = party_util.get_stage_members(self.owner)

		--- 파티원 순회
		for _, member in pairs(stage_members) do repeat
			--- 사망 여부 체크
			if character_util.is_dead(member) then
				break
			end

			--- 속성 조건 체크
			if character_util.get_elemental_type(member) ~= self.target_elemental then
				break
			end

			--- 버프 적용
			buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, member, self.cwp_buff_info)

			--- 소환된 소환수 순회
			for _, summonable in pairs(summonable_util.get_summmoned(member)) do
				--- 속성 조건 체크
				if character_util.get_elemental_type(summonable) == self.target_elemental then
					--- 버프 적용
					buff_util.apply_buff_info(self.owner, summonable, self.cwp_buff_info)
				end
			end

		until true end

		--- 분신 3개 소환
		self:change_mirage_show(1, look_dir, 'sword_attack', ground_pos + self.left_additional_pos)
		self:change_mirage_show(2, look_dir, 'sword_attack', ground_pos)
		self:change_mirage_show(3, look_dir, 'sword_attack', ground_pos + self.right_additional_pos)
	end
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function field_state_class:is_loaded()
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		return self.is_mirage_loaded
	end

	return true
end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 판정 종료
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_shoot)
	area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_return)

	--- proj 이펙트 초기화
	--- 초기화 시 end 이펙트 생성 필요
	if self.proj then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj_end', self.proj.transform.position)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj)
		self.proj = nil
	end

	if self.proj_left then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj_end', self.proj_left.transform.position)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_left)
		self.proj_left = nil
	end

	if self.proj_right then
		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj_end', self.proj_right.transform.position)
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.proj_right)
		self.proj_right = nil
	end

	--- contrail 이펙트 초기화
	if self.contrail then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.contrail)
		self.contrail = nil
	end

	if self.contrail_left then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.contrail_left)
		self.contrail_left = nil
	end

	if self.contrail_right then
		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.contrail_right)
		self.contrail_right = nil
	end

	--- 무옵 적용시 분신 3기 해제
	if self.activate_cwp_option then
		self:change_mirage_hide(1)
		self:change_mirage_hide(2)
		self:change_mirage_hide(3)
	end
end

--- 현재 생성되어있는 이펙트 투사체, contrail 위치를 업데이트 해줌
function field_state_class:update_shuriken_pos(pos)
	effect_util.update_object(self.proj, pos)

	if self.proj_right then
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_right, pos + self.right_additional_pos)
	end

	if self.proj_left then
		effect_util.update_object(self.proj_left, pos + self.left_additional_pos)
	end

	effect_util.update_object(self.contrail, pos, self.dir_vector)

	if self.contrail_right then
		effect_util.update_object(self.contrail_right, pos + self.right_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if self.contrail_left then
		effect_util.update_object(self.contrail_left, pos + self.left_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end
end

--- field state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)

	--- slash effect timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.slash_effect_timing) then

		local slash_pos = self.shoot_pos - self.dir_vector * 0.2

		--- 무옵이 적용중이면 슬래시 이펙트 위치를 조정해주고, 양 쪽에도 같이 생성해준다.
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			slash_pos = self.shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * 0.2
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', slash_pos + self.left_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
			battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', slash_pos + self.right_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
		end

		battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'slash', slash_pos, self.dir_vector)
	end

	--- attack timing
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing) then
		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_shoot, self.shoot_pos)
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator_shoot, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_shoot)

		--- 콜라이더 판정 체크
		self:check_calculator_collision(self.calculator_shoot, dt, self.sub_damage_scale)

		--- play throw sfx
		battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'throw')

		--- instantiate proj fx
		self.proj = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', self.shoot_pos)

		--- 무옵 적용시 2개의 이펙트 추가 제작
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			self.proj_left = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', self.shoot_pos + self.left_additional_pos)
			self.proj_right = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'proj', self.shoot_pos + self.right_additional_pos)
		end

		--- instantiate contrail fx
		self.contrail = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'contrail', self.shoot_pos, self.dir_vector)

		--- 무옵 적용시 2개의 이펙트 추가 제작
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			self.contrail_left = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'contrail', self.shoot_pos + self.left_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
			self.contrail_right = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'contrail', self.shoot_pos + self.right_additional_pos, self.dir_vector)
		end

		--- camera shake
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)
		end

	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.attack_timing, self.return_timing) then

		--- ease graph 를 통해 progress 산출
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutCubic(time_passed - self.attack_timing, 0, 1, self.return_duration)

		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress, 0, 1)

		--- 목표 위치 지정
		local target_pos = self.shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range * progress

		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_shoot, target_pos)

		--- 수리검 위치 지정
		self:update_shuriken_pos(target_pos)

		--- 콜라이더 판정 체크
		self:check_calculator_collision(self.calculator_shoot, dt, self.sub_damage_scale)
	end

	--- 발사가 끝나고 돌아올 시간
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_timing) then
		--- 발사 콜라이더 판정 종료
		area_collision_util.calc_end(self.calculator_shoot)

		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_return, self.shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range)
		--- 판정 방향 설정
		area_collision_util.set_direction(self.calculator_return, self.dir_vector)
		--- 판정 시작
		area_collision_util.start(self.calculator_return)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_between(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.return_timing, self.flying_timing) then

		--- ease graph 를 통해 progress 산출
		local progress = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseInCubic(time_passed - self.return_timing, 0, 1, self.return_duration)

		progress = unity_class.mathf.Clamp01(progress, 0, 1)

		--- 목표 위치 지정
		local target_pos = self.shoot_pos + self.dir_vector * self.attack_range * (1 - progress)

		--- 판정 위치 초기화
		area_collision_util.set_position(self.calculator_return, target_pos)

		--- 수리검 위치 지정
		self:update_shuriken_pos(target_pos)

		--- 콜라이더 판정 체크
		self:check_calculator_collision(self.calculator_return, dt, self.main_damage_scale)
	end

	--- 예정된 fly timing 이 끝나면 종료
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.flying_timing) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:check_calculator_collision(calculator, dt, scale)
	--- 판정 동작 중에는 판정 처리
	if not area_collision_util.is_started(calculator) then
		return
	end

	local hit_targets = area_collision_util.update_v2(calculator, dt)

	--- 판정된 대상이 하나라도 있다면
	if #hit_targets > 0 then
		--- 계수
		local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)

		--- 판정된 대상 순회
		for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
			self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
		end

		--- camera shake
		if self.activate_cwp_option then
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.1, 0.1)
		else
			battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.07, 0.1)
		end
	end

	--- 판정 종료될 상태라면 종료 처리
	if area_collision_util.is_finished(calculator) then
		area_collision_util.calc_end(calculator)
	end
end

function field_state_class:create_mirage_spine()
	local already_loaded = self.is_mirage_ready

	self.is_mirage_loaded = false
	self.is_mirage_ready = false

	local res_holder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
	local bundle_name = self.owner.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetBundleName
	local asset_name = self.owner.CharacterInfo.AssetName.assetName
	local prefab = nil

	yield_return_func(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync, res_holder, bundle_name, asset_name, function(result)
		prefab = result
	end)

	if prefab == nil then
		self.is_mirage_loaded = true
		return
	end

	if not already_loaded then
		self.prev_position = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner).position
		self.prev_direction = character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner)
	end

	for idx = 1, self.mirage_stack do
		local new_object = CS.UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(prefab)
		local new_controller = new_object:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.SpineController))

		--- 이미 생성된 오브젝트가 있다면 대체한다.
		if already_loaded and idx <= #self.mirage_spines then
			self.mirage_spines[idx]:SwitchSpineController(new_controller)
			--- 새로 생성이 필요한 경우 셋팅해서 등록한다.
		else
			new_object.name = prefab.name .. '_mirage_spine_' .. idx
			new_object.transform.position = self.prev_position
			new_controller.Direction = self.prev_direction
			new_controller:AddColor(self.cs_action.HandleName, unity_class.color(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), 1, 0)
			new_controller:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
			new_controller.SkinName = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName
			new_controller:Hide(true)

			if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
				CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(new_controller, self.owner)
			else
				CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(new_controller, self.owner.Weapon1, self.owner.Weapon2)
			end

			table.insert(self.mirage_objects, new_object)
			table.insert(self.mirage_spines, new_controller)
			table.insert(self.current_visual_state, self.mirage_visual_state.hide)
			table.insert(self.current_move_offset, vector_util.zero)
		end
	end

	res_holder:Dispose()

	self.is_mirage_loaded = true
	self.is_mirage_ready = true
end

function field_state_class:on_equipment_change()
	--- 분신이 준비된 상태가 아니라면 생략한다.
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	--- 웨폰 어테치먼트 세팅
	if self.owner.CharacterInfo then
		for _, mirage_spine in ipairs(self.mirage_spines) do
			CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(mirage_spine, self.owner)
		end
	else
		for _, mirage_spine in ipairs(self.mirage_spines) do
			CS.Oak.SpineControllerExtensions.SetWeaponAttachments(mirage_spine, self.owner.Weapon1, self.owner.Weapon2)
		end
	end
end

function field_state_class:dispose_mirage()
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	--- 제거가 발생하기 때문에 역순으로 순회
	for idx = #self.mirage_objects, 1, -1 do
		CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Destroy(self.mirage_objects[idx])
		table.remove(self.mirage_objects)
		table.remove(self.mirage_spines)
		table.remove(self.current_visual_state)
		table.remove(self.current_move_offset)
	end

	self.is_mirage_loaded = false
	self.is_mirage_ready = false
end

function field_state_class:change_mirage_show(idx, look_dir, anim_name, target_pos)
	--- 분신이 준비된 상태가 아니라면 생략한다.
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	local current_state = self.current_visual_state[idx]

	if current_state == self.mirage_visual_state.show then
		return
	end

	--- 분신을 보여줌
	self.mirage_spines[idx]:Hide(false)
	self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetAlphaFade(self.mirage_alpha, 0.5)
	self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetShadowAlpha(1)
	self.current_visual_state[idx] = self.mirage_visual_state.show

	self.mirage_spines[idx].Transform.position = target_pos + vector_util.up * 0.03
	self.mirage_spines[idx].Direction = look_dir

	--- 분신 생성 이펙트
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'clone', target_pos)

	--- 분신 애니메이션 세팅
	spine_util.set_track_animation(self.mirage_spines[idx], spine_animation_track.base, anim_name, false)
end

function field_state_class:change_mirage_hide(idx)
	--- 분신이 준비된 상태가 아니라면 생략한다.
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	local current_state = self.current_visual_state[idx]

	if current_state == self.mirage_visual_state.hide then
		return
	end

	self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0)
	self.mirage_spines[idx]:Hide(true)
	self.current_visual_state[idx] = self.mirage_visual_state.hide
end

function field_state_class:change_mirage_fade(idx)
	--- 분신이 준비된 상태가 아니라면 생략한다.
	if not self.is_mirage_ready then
		return
	end

	local current_state = self.current_visual_state[idx]

	if current_state == self.mirage_visual_state.fade then
		return
	end

	self.mirage_spines[idx]:SetAlphaFade(0, 0.1)
	self.current_visual_state[idx] = self.mirage_visual_state.fade
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale

	--- 상태이상 수치 추가
	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_param(cs_action, params)

	--- action state
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- action state machine
	self.state_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- field state
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- field state machine
	self.field_machine = simple_state_machine:new(nil, self)

	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine

	self:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self:dispose_message_system()

	--- 분신 스파인 제거
	self.field_state:dispose_mirage()

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil

		self.field_machine:change(nil)
		self.field_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.field_state)

		self.field_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.field_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	--- 변신 여부에 따라 체크
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
	self.field_state:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)

	self.field_state:start(info)
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then
		return
	end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)
	self.field_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then
		self.state_machine:update(dt)
	end

	if self.field_machine then
		self.field_machine:update(dt)
	end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:init_message_system()
end

function local_class:dispose_message_system()
end

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 샤오롱바오 (panda_girl) 전용 무기 기술
--- ref 클로드
local local_class = newclass('CwpPandaGirlBattleAction')

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,

	--- 탐색 범위
	search_range = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,

	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create action state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = battle_state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)

	return obj
end

---- parsing battle action data
function action_state_class:init(param, level)
	--- 탐색 범위
	self.search_range = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SearchRange')
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	self.run_cancelable = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'RunCancelable')
	self.landing_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'LandingTiming')
	self.jump_height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'JumpHeight')

	--- 대시 정보
	self.dash_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashTiming')
	self.dash_speed = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashSpeed')
	self.dash_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DashDuration')

	local radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubRadius')
	local dash_dist = self.dash_speed * self.dash_duration * 0.5
	self.hittable_dist = dash_dist * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale + radius * battle_constants.default_hittable_scale

	self.is_exclusive_weapon = weapon_util.is_exclusive_character(self.owner)

	--- 변신 스펙
	self.origin_skin_name = nil
	self.skin_name = cs_util.get_string_from_dictionary(param, 'TransformSkinName')
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function action_state_class:is_loaded()
	return true
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.current_time_passed <= self.run_cancelable
end

--- hittable check
function action_state_class:is_hittable(target)
	local target_dist = battle_util.distance_between_xz(self.owner, target)
	return target_dist <= self.hittable_dist
end

--- start action (parsing trigger info)
function action_state_class:start(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 리셋
	self.force_cancel = false

	self.trigger_pos = bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)
	self.target = trigger_info_util.get_target_at(info)
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 배틀액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	battle_util.set_locked_dir(self.cs_action, self.dir_vector)

	local key = self.is_exclusive_weapon and 'cast' or 'cast_fallback'
	battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, key)

	local pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dust', pos, self.dir_vector)
	self.fx_spin = battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'spin', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner), self.dir_vector, spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner), parent_follow_flag.position)

	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)

	--- 원본 캐릭터의 스파인 캐싱
	if self.origin_skin_name == nil then
		self.origin_skin_name = spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName
	end
	--- camera darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5, 0.1)
end

function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 배틀액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false

	character_util.set_direction(self.owner, character_util.get_look_direction(self.owner))

	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)
	effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_spin, true)
	self.fx_spin = nil

	character_util.cancel_jump(self.owner)

	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'dust', battle_util.get_ground_pos(bounds_util.get_center(self.owner)), self.dir_vector)
	spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName = self.origin_skin_name

	--- 돌진 전 캔슬 된 경우 암전 해제
	if self.current_time_passed < self.landing_timing then
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action)
	end
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	--print('[#3] cwp: ' .. string.format("%.3f", old_time_passed))
	if self.target and old_time_passed < self.dash_timing then
		self.target, self.dir_vector = battle_util.set_locked_target(self.cs_action, self.target, self.dir_vector)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.dash_timing) then
		--- 대시 요청
		battle_util.melee_short_dash(self.cs_action, nil, self.dir_vector, 0, self.dash_duration,
			self.dash_speed, self.dash_speed * battle_constants.non_manual_speed_scale, nil, false, 0, self.is_exclusive_weapon)

		character_util.jump(self.owner, 6, self.landing_timing - self.dash_timing, self.dash_duration * 0.7)


		spine_util.get_spine_controller(self.owner).SkinName = self.skin_name
		self.spine_container = spine_util.get_spine_container(self.owner)
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'roll')
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.landing_timing - 0.05) then
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.landing_timing) then
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
		trigger_info_util.append_direction(sync_info, self.dir_vector)

		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)

		effect_util.dispose_via_type(self.fx_spin, true)
		self.fx_spin = nil

		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
		battle_util.set_anim(self.action, self.cs_action, 'landing')
	end

	--- 액션이 끝난 상황
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end
--endregion

function field_state_class:init(param, level)
	self.total_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'AOEDuration')

	--- damage type
	self.damage_type = cs_util.get_damage_type_from_dictionary(param, 'BaseDamageType')
	--- atk modifier

	self.sub_scale = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubScale')

	--- 상태 이상 정보
	self.ailment_info = CS.Oak.AilmentInfo.Create(param, level)

	self.hit_timing_table = cs_util.get_float_table_from_dictionary(param, 'HitTiming')

	local height = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'Height')
	local main_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'MainRadius')
	local main_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(main_radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	self.main_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, main_collision_info)

	local sub_radius = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'SubRadius')
	local sub_collision_info = collision_info_util.create_cylinder(sub_radius, height, nil, nil, nil, true)
	self.sub_calculator = area_collision_util.create(self.owner, sub_collision_info)

	self:apply_myth_option(param, level)
end

function field_state_class:apply_myth_option(param, level)
	--전무 개화 분기
	local has_myth_option, myth_param = battle_util.parse_myth_option_data(param, self.owner)
	if not has_myth_option then return end

	--- atk modifier
	local modifier_base = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'OverrideModifierBase')
	local modifier_add = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(myth_param, 'OverrideModifierAdd')
	self.atk_modifier = modifier_base + modifier_add * level
end

--- 판정이 필요한 시점에 trigger 정보 갱신. 대상의 위치로부터 판정을 처리한다.
function field_state_class:sync(info)
	self.target_pos = battle_util.get_ground_pos(trigger_info_util.get_position_at(info))
	self.dir_vector = trigger_info_util.get_direction_at(info)
end

--- action state enter
function field_state_class:enter(_)

end

function field_state_class:exit(_)
	--battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.2)
end

--- action state update
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function field_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, dt)
	for idx = 1, #self.hit_timing_table do
		local hit_timing = self.hit_timing_table[idx]
		if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, hit_timing) then
			local is_first = idx == 1
			local calculator
			if is_first then
				--- 1차 대나무 숲
				calculator = self.main_calculator

				battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.3, 0.2)
				battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'explo', self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
				battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'explosion')
			else
				--- 2차 대나무숲
				calculator = self.sub_calculator
			end

			local hit_targets = area_collision_util.calculate_once(calculator, self.target_pos, self.dir_vector)
			local modifier = battle_util.calculate_attack_modifier_from_dps(self.cs_action, self.atk_modifier)
			local scale = is_first and self.main_scale or self.sub_scale

			for _, target in pairs(hit_targets) do
				self:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
			end
		end
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.32) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.2, 0.15)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, 0.5) then
		battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.15, 0.15)
	end

	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.total_duration) then
		self.machine:change(nil)
	end
end

function field_state_class:apply_damage(target, modifier, scale)
	--- 데미지 정보 생성
	local damage_info = damage_info_util.create_table()
	damage_info.damage_type = self.damage_type
	damage_info.source_type = battle_util.get_source_from_action(self.cs_action)
	damage_info.sender = self.owner
	damage_info.target = target
	damage_info.modifier = modifier * scale
	damage_info.hit_sfx_info = damage_info_util.create_hit_sfx_info(self.action, 'hit')

	damage_info.stun_factor = stun_constants.factor_normal_enhanced
	damage_info.stun_duration = 0.4

	damage_info = damage_info_util.fill_ailment_gauge(damage_info, self.ailment_info, scale)

	--- 데미지 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_damage_v2(damage_info)
end

--endregion

--region local class
function local_class:init(c, level, params, cs_action)
	self.cs_action = cs_action
	self.owner = c
	self.level = level

	--- parsing each info
	self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info = battle_util.parse_action_and_myth_param(cs_action, params)

	--- 액션 스테이트
	self.action_state = action_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 액션 스테이트용 머신 추가
	self.state_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)
	--- 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.action_state.machine = self.state_machine

	--- 판정 상태
	self.field_state = field_state_class:new(self, params, level)
	--- 판정 상태를 돌리기 위한 머신
	self.field_machine = battle_state_machine:new(nil)
	--- 판정 스테이트 머신 지정
	self.field_state.machine = self.field_machine
end

function local_class:dispose()
	--region state 해지
	do
		self.state_machine:change(nil)
		self.state_machine = nil

		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.action_state)

		self.action_state = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--region json 기반 정보들 해지
	do
		battle_util.dispose_action_param(self.animation_info, self.emotion_info, self.preset_info, self.sfx_info)

		self.animation_info = nil
		self.emotion_info = nil
		self.preset_info = nil
		self.sfx_info = nil
	end
	--endregion

	--- 해제
	self.cs_action = nil
	self.owner = nil
	self.level = nil
end

--- 배틀액션에 필요한 모든 리소스들이 로드되어있는지
--- @return boolean 로드 성공 여부
function local_class:is_loaded()
	return battle_util.is_loaded(self.preset_info) and self.action_state:is_loaded()
end

--- 배틀액션이 현재 사용이 가능한 상태인지
--- @return boolean 사용 가능 여부
function local_class:is_available()
	--- 스테이트가 아무것도 안하는 상태일때만 사용이 가능함
	return self.state_machine and self.state_machine:is_nil_state()
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function local_class:is_controlling()
	return self.action_state:is_controlling()
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function local_class:is_run_cancelable()
	return self.action_state:is_run_cancelable()
end

--- 주어진 타겟을 현재 때리는 것이 가능한지
--- @return boolean 때리는 것이 가능한지 여부
function local_class:is_hittable(target)
	return self.action_state:is_hittable(target)
end

--- 장비가 변경되었을 때 호출
function local_class:on_equipment_change()
end

--- 배틀 액션을 시작을 요청. 내부에서 시작이 가능한지 체크 후 문제가 없다면 TriggerBattleActionCommand 를 실행시킴
--- @return boolean battle action trigger 성공 여부
function local_class:trigger()
	--- 트리거 정보 구성
	local info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)

	--- 가장 가까운 타겟 탐색
	local target, dir_vector = battle_util.get_combo_target(self.cs_action, self.action_state.search_range)

	--- 대상이 존재할 경우
	if target then
		trigger_info_util.append_target(info, target)
	end

	--- append direction
	trigger_info_util.append_direction(info, dir_vector)

	--- 트리거 커맨드 발행
	command_util.publish_trigger_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, info)

	return true
end

--- 실제 배틀 액션이 시작. TriggerBattleActionCommand.Execute 에서 이 함수를 부름
function local_class:start(info)
	self.action_state:start(info)
	self.state_machine:change(self.action_state)
end

function local_class:cancel()
	if not self.cs_action.IsActive then return end

	--- state reset
	self.state_machine:change(nil)

	--- publish cancel event
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionCancelledEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
end

--- SyncBattleActionCommand로 동기화되는 루틴
--- 적 판정 및 다음 타겟을 위한 루틴을 실행
function local_class:sync(info)
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 체크
	if self.action_state.force_cancel then return end

	self.field_state:sync(info)
	self.field_machine:change(self.field_state)
end

--- 일반적인 Cancel로 취소되지 않는 부분들까지 전부 강제로 취소
--- 말 그대로 아무것도 남아서 실행되고 있지 않아야 함
function local_class:force_cancel()
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 지정
	self.action_state.force_cancel = true

	--- 판정 스테이트 초기화
	self.field_machine:change(nil)
end

--- 배틀액션 업데이트 프레임
--- @param dt number delta time
function local_class:update_frame(dt)
	if self.state_machine then self.state_machine:update(dt) end
	if self.field_machine then self.field_machine:update(dt) end
end

--- 이벤트 핸들링
function local_class:on_event(e)
	return false
end

function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	--- projectile state가 유효할때만 처리
	if not self.action_state then return false end

	return self.action_state:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
end
--endregion

return {
	create = function(c, level, params, cs_action)
		return local_class(c, level, params, cs_action)
	end,
}

--- Cwp 배틀액션
--- 파티 크래셔 매드 팬더단(party_mad_panda) 전용 무기 기술
local local_class = newclass('CwpPartyMadPandaBattleAction')

local simple_state_machine = {}
simple_state_machine.mt = { __index = simple_state_machine }

function simple_state_machine:new(state, parent_class)
	local obj = {}
	obj.state = state or nil
	obj.local_class = parent_class
	setmetatable(obj, self.mt)
	return obj
end

function simple_state_machine:change(new_state)
	local prev_state = self.state

	if prev_state and prev_state.exit then
		prev_state:exit(new_state)
	end

	self.state = new_state

	if self.state then
		if self.state.current_time_passed then
			self.state.current_time_passed = 0
		end

		if self.state.enter then
			self.state:enter(prev_state)
		end
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:update(dt)
	if self:is_nil_state() or self.state.current_time_passed == nil then return end

	local old_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed
	self.state.current_time_passed = self.state.current_time_passed + dt

	if self.state.update then
		self.state:update(old_time_passed, self.state.current_time_passed, dt)
	end
end

function simple_state_machine:is_nil_state()
	return self.state == nil
end

local state_base = {
	--- enter state
	enter = nil,
	--- exit state
	exit = nil,
	--- update state
	update = nil,
}
state_base.mt = { __index = state_base }

function state_base:new(mt)
	local obj = {}
	setmetatable(obj, mt or self.mt)
	return obj
end

--region action state

local action_state_class = {
	--- 상위 클래스에서 해당 스테이트를 진행할때 사용하는 스테이트 머신
	machine = nil,
	--- 오너
	owner = nil,
	--- 상위 클래스
	action = nil,
	--- CS 클래스
	cs_action = nil,
	--- 액션 길이
	action_duration = nil,
	--- 메카 설치 타이밍
	deploy_timing = nil,
	--- 현재 지나간 시간
	current_time_passed = 0,
	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그
	force_cancel = false
}
action_state_class.mt = { __index = action_state_class }

--- create state
function action_state_class:new(parent_class, param, level)
	local obj = state_base:new(self.mt)
	obj.owner = parent_class.owner
	obj.action = parent_class
	obj.cs_action = parent_class.cs_action
	obj:init(param, level)
	return obj
end

function action_state_class:init(param, _)
	--- 액션 길이
	self.action_duration = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'ActionDuration')

	--- 메카 설치 타이밍
	self.deploy_timing = cs_util.get_float_from_dictionary(param, 'DeployTiming')
end

--- 현재 캐릭터를 배틀 액션이 제어하고 있는지
--- @return boolean 제어 여부
function action_state_class:is_controlling()
	--- 항상 제어
	return true
end

--- 현재 배틀 액션이 달리기로 인해 캔슬될 수 있는지
--- @return boolean 캔슬 가능 여부
function action_state_class:is_run_cancelable()
	--- 항상 캔슬 가능
	return true
end

--- info sync
function action_state_class:start(_)
end

--- action state enter
function action_state_class:enter(_)
	--- 액션 활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = true

	--- 강제 캔슬 플래그 초기화
	self.force_cancel = false

	--- 스크린 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_screen_effect(self.action, self.owner)
	--- 캐스트 이펙트 생성
	battle_util.instantiate_effect(self.action, 'cast', bounds_util.get_center(self.owner))
	--- 캐스트 사운드 재생
	battle_util.play_sfx(self.action, 'cast')

	--- 보이스 출력
	battle_util.default_play_voice(self.cs_action)
	--- 카메라 흔들기
	battle_util.camera_shake(self.owner, 0.19, 0.2)

	--- set darken
	battle_util.set_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.4)
end

--- action state exit
function action_state_class:exit(_)
	--- 설치 이전에 캔슬되었을때
	if self.current_time_passed < self.deploy_timing then
		--- unset darken
		battle_util.unset_cwp_darken(self.cs_action, 0.5)
	end

	--- 애니메이션 해제
	battle_util.remove_anim(self.cs_action)

	--- 방향 고정 해제
	battle_util.remove_locked_dir(self.cs_action)

	--- 액션 비활성화
	self.cs_action.IsActive = false
end

--- action state update frame
--- @param old_time_passed number 지난 프레임의 timePassed
--- @param time_passed number 현재 프레임의 timePassed
function action_state_class:update(old_time_passed, time_passed, _)
	--- 메카 설치 타이밍
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.deploy_timing) then
		--- 싱크 정보 생성
		local sync_info = trigger_info_util.create_default(self.owner)
		--- 설치 위치 정보 추가
		trigger_info_util.append_position(sync_info, character_util.get_position(self.owner))
		--- 싱크 커맨드 발행
		command_util.publish_sync_action(self.owner, self.cs_action, sync_info)
	end

	--- 액션 종료 시점
	if battle_util.check_time_passed(old_time_passed, time_passed, self.action_duration) then
		--- state reset
		self.machine:change(nil)

		--- 배틀액션이 완료됨을 publish
		message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleActionFinishedEvent.Create(self.owner, self.cs_action))
	end
end

--endregion
